| `DatasetRecord` | Layer 1 | Phase 1 | dataset ID, source/citation, task labels, subject/session/run structure, claim-scope tags | Valid source record | Source lineage and grouping for A3 | Missing source identity blocks thesis-ready A3 |
| `WindowRecord` | Layer 1 | Phase 1 | subject/session/trial/window IDs, parent-trial lineage, timing, window role, artifact flags, split membership, preprocessing ID, label budget | Valid source record | Window/trial matching and coverage denominators | Missing trial/window keys downgrade comparisons |
| `SplitRecord` / split manifest | Layer 1 / experiment controller | Phase 1 / Phase 0 support | split ID, split roles, calibration/threshold/evaluation membership, budget, seed, leakage-check status | Hard gate | Split-safe calibration, threshold selection, and evaluation | Leakage or missing split role blocks or downgrades A3 |
| `PreprocessingRecord` | Layer 1 | Phase 1 | preprocessing ID, filtering/resampling/channel policy, fit scope, config hash | Valid source record | Leakage and reproducibility lineage | Illegal fit scope blocks final A3 use |
| `LabelMapRecord` | Layer 1 | Phase 1 | normalized labels, label-map version, class order compatibility, rest/no-action policy | Hard gate | Class-order and metric correctness | Missing/mismatched class map blocks affected records |
| `ArtifactFlagRecord` | Layer 1 | Phase 1 | artifact/channel/missingness flags and severity | Recommended where available | Group-wise limitations and warning tags | Missing flags become limitation, not clean evidence of signal quality |
| `PredictionRecord` | Layer 2 | Phase 2 | prediction IDs, dataset/subject/session/trial/window IDs, split ID/role, label budget, model/decoder IDs, predicted class, probability vector/logits/decision score, score type, class order, evaluation-only label, seed, config hash | Required; score-schema valid or explicitly ineligible | Primary A3 source input | Missing score/class-order/model lineage blocks or downgrades A3 |
| `ModelRegistryRecord` | Layer 2 | Phase 2 | model ID, decoder ID, family/name, implementation/artifact/prediction paths, training split, label budget, hyperparameters, checkpoint, score type, class order, seed, config/environment hash, training status | Required | Model provenance and matched comparisons | Missing registry blocks thesis-ready A3 comparison |
| `Layer2ReadinessReport` | Layer 2 | Phase 2 | readiness status, missing-field warnings, score/class-order/budget compatibility, diagnostic-only reasons | Required gate | Determines eligibility for Phase 3 A3 processing | Missing readiness report forces manual audit or diagnostic-only |
| `CalibrationRecord` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | calibration ID, raw/calibrated probabilities/confidence, calibration method/scope, calibration split ID, reliability bins, source IDs, Brier/NLL components, config hash | Required where calibrated uncertainty is evaluated; otherwise no-calibration mode must be explicit | A1 comparator and calibrated uncertainty source | Missing calibrated lineage limits A3 to raw-score uncertainty or diagnostic mode |
| `UncertaintyRecord` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | linked prediction/calibration IDs, confidence, entropy, normalized entropy, margin, variation ratio, top-1/top-2 classes, top-1/top-2 margin pair, model disagreement if used, conformal set size if used, selective-accept flag, uncertainty profile, config hash | Core A3 source-supported record | A3 uncertainty-feature evidence and downstream Layer 4/6/10 input | Missing `UncertaintyRecord` blocks A3 core claims |
| `SelectivePredictionRecord` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | threshold ID, uncertainty feature, selection split, evaluation split, coverage, rejection rate, retained accuracy/error, risk, high-confidence wrong rate, class/subject/session coverage, calibration budget, operating-point lineage | Core A3 evaluation record | A3 selective-prediction and risk/coverage evidence; also A2 rows when threshold-only | Missing record blocks selective-prediction claims |
| `ThresholdRegistryRecord` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | threshold type, feature, value/rule, selected-on split, selection rule, target constraint, applicable models, allowed consumers, version, leakage status, rationale, fairness note | Required for any threshold/operating point | Legal threshold and operating-point governance | Unregistered thresholds blocked or exploratory-only |
| `ReliabilityAuditReport` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | reliability diagrams, ECE/Brier/NLL summaries, confidence histograms, group audits, risk-coverage summaries, warnings, source-record links | Required for thesis-facing reliability context | A1–A3 reliability and failure interpretation | Missing report weakens A3 and Layer 10 output |
| `SplitIntegrityReport` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | calibration/threshold/test disjointness, leakage warnings, invalid-run flags, nested-CV legality, final-claim eligibility | Hard gate | Claim-safety and split legality | Leakage blocks final A3 claims |
| `LeakageWarningRecord` | Layer 3 or Layer 2 validation when detected | Phase 3 or Phase 2 | source split IDs, offending condition, affected records, severity, required action, final-evaluation block/exploratory-only status | Conditional but blocking when present | Warning/claim block | Affected rows blocked or diagnostic-only until repaired and rerun |
| `CalibrationEligibilityTable` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | per-model/dataset/budget eligibility, missing-class/sparse-budget status, method eligibility, fallback method, invalid-run reason, legal-use status | `normalized_candidate`; exact schema unresolved | Eligibility and sparse-budget audit | Missing table requires explicit eligibility notes; do not promote to final canonical without resolution |
| `HighConfidenceWrongTable` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | confident wrong cases, source IDs, class-pair errors, grouping keys, confidence threshold, correctness source, diagnostic status | `diagnostic_only`; evaluation artifact | Offline failure analysis and negative-result evidence | Cannot be used as decision-time feature; missing table weakens failure analysis |
| `CalibrationDashboardMetricRecord` | Layer 3 dashboard/card exporter | Phase 3 | plot-ready metrics, risk-coverage curves, filters, warnings, card refs, source IDs, metric dictionary IDs, export lineage | `normalized_candidate`; schema unresolved with Layer 10 | Layer 10 dashboard source input | Missing source bundle makes dashboard non-thesis-ready |
| `Layer3MatchedOperatingPointTable` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | matched coverage/cost points, A1–A3 comparison keys, threshold sufficiency/calibration failure notes, high-confidence-wrong summaries, diagnostic flags | Final only if matched keys complete | Fair A0/A1/A2/A3 comparison | Unmatched rows diagnostic-only |
| `MetricDictionaryEntry` / `MetricDictionary` | Evaluation architecture / Layer 10/Layer 0 interface | Phase 0 support; Phase 3/14/15 consumption | metric ID, definition, direction, denominator, aggregation, required records, split role, claim boundary | Required for thesis-facing metrics | Metric legality and reproducibility | Missing entry makes metric diagnostic-only |
| `MatchedComparisonReport` | Evaluation architecture | Phase 3/13/15 context | matched keys, comparator rows, diagnostic-only flags, source IDs, metric IDs | Required for comparative claims | A0/A1/A2/A3 comparison fairness | Missing report blocks improvement/sufficiency claims |
| `NegativeResultNote` | Evaluation architecture / Phase 3 handoff | Phase 3/15 | failure or sufficiency statement, source IDs, metric IDs, affected comparisons, claim boundary | Required when failures/sufficiency occur | Preserve non-positive and baseline-sufficiency outcomes | Hidden negative result blocks claim-safety approval |
| `DiagnosticOnlyFlag` | Evaluation / claim-safety | Any affected phase | reason, affected row, source IDs, downgrade scope | Required when validity incomplete | Prevents overclaiming | Missing flag creates claim-safety risk |
| `ClaimEvidenceManifest` / `ClaimEvidenceMatrix` | Layer 0 / final reporting / Layer 10 interface | Phase 15; placeholders earlier | claim IDs, source records, metric IDs, limitation tags, diagnostic-only status | Required for final thesis claims; alias/schema issue unresolved | Final claim traceability | Missing claim trace blocks final A3 thesis claims |

#### 7.1 Status preservation for candidate or diagnostic artifacts

| Item | Source status | A3 protocol treatment | Can be used as official? | Required confirmation or resolution |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `CalibrationEligibilityTable` | `normalized_candidate` | Use as validation/report table only; preserve candidate status | No, not as final canonical record | Exact schema/path and lifecycle promotion |
| `CalibrationDashboardMetricRecord` | `normalized_candidate` dashboard-readable metric source | Use as Layer 10 source input, not dashboard output | No, not as final dashboard schema | Layer 10 schema/path reconciliation |
| `HighConfidenceWrongTable` | `evaluation_artifact` / `diagnostic_only` | Use for offline failure analysis and negative-result reporting only | No, not decision-time evidence | Evaluation-only partition and metric dictionary linkage if summarized |
| `Layer3MatchedOperatingPointTable` | final if matched keys present | Use as A1–A3 comparison artifact only where complete | Yes, conditionally | Complete matched keys, metric dictionary IDs, source IDs, config/seed lineage |
| `EnsembleControlRecord` | `normalized_candidate` | A4 context only; optional source for disagreement features if source-supported | No, not A3 ordinary-control artifact | Object-class reconciliation; explicit A4 separation |

### 8. Producer Layer and Producer Phase Summary

| A3-required item | Producing layer | Producing phase | A3 use | Producer-consumer note |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Public-data source records (`DatasetRecord`, `WindowRecord`, `SplitRecord`, `PreprocessingRecord`, `LabelMapRecord`, `ArtifactFlagRecord`) | Layer 1 | Phase 1 | Immutable source/protocol lineage | A3 consumes; it does not repair source records |
| `PredictionRecord`, `ModelRegistryRecord`, `Layer2ReadinessReport` | Layer 2 | Phase 2 | Prediction/model/score eligibility for uncertainty extraction | A3 consumes; Layer 2 owns decoder outputs |
| `BaselineMetricRecord`, `LowCalibrationCurveRecord` | Layer 2 | Phase 2 | A0 context and low-calibration budget context | A3 uses as comparator/context only |
| `CalibrationRecord` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | A1 comparator and calibrated source for uncertainty features | A3 may depend on calibration but does not own A1 conclusions |
| `UncertaintyRecord` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | Core A3 uncertainty evidence | A3 evaluation-use metadata references these records |
| `SelectivePredictionRecord` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | Core A3 selective/risk-coverage evidence; also shared with A2 threshold-only rows | Must identify whether row is A2 threshold-only or A3 uncertainty/selective context |
| `ThresholdRegistryRecord` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | Legal operating-point registry and allowed-consumer governance | Required for all thresholded selective behavior |
| `ReliabilityAuditReport`, `SplitIntegrityReport`, `LeakageWarningRecord`, `HighConfidenceWrongTable` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | Reliability, legality, warning, and failure evidence | Diagnostic/evaluation boundaries must remain visible |
| `CalibrationDashboardMetricRecord`, ReliabilityCard source inputs | Layer 3 source exporter; rendered later by Layer 10 | Phase 3 source; Phase 14 rendering | Dashboard source bundle and card input | Layer 10 derives views/cards; it does not create primary evidence |
| `Layer3MatchedOperatingPointTable` | Layer 3 | Phase 3 | Matched A1–A3 operating-point comparisons | Final only if matched keys complete |
| Layer 10 dashboard/cards/exports/manifests | Layer 10 | Phase 14 | Read/export/package A3 records | Derived presentation, not source evidence |
| Claim-evidence package | Layer 0 / final reporting interface | Phase 15 | Final claim traceability | Governance/audit only; not empirical evidence |

A3 comparisons are invalid if they imply that an ablation produces records. The correct formulation is: Phase 3 / Layer 3 produces records used by the A3 evaluation context.

### 9. Baselines and Comparators

#### 9.1 Required comparator matrix

| Comparator | Required source evidence | Required matching | A3 comparison purpose | Failure/downgrade condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A0 raw decoder / accept-all reference | `PredictionRecord`, `BaselineMetricRecord`, model registry, split/source IDs | dataset, subject, session, trial/window, split, preprocessing, label map, model, seed, budget, config | Shows baseline behavior before calibration, thresholding, or uncertainty rejection | Missing raw comparator makes A3 improvement claims invalid |
| A1 calibrated decoder | `CalibrationRecord`, reliability audit, calibration IDs, metric entries | Same prediction/source keys plus calibration method/scope/split | Shows whether uncertainty/selective behavior adds beyond calibration visibility alone | Missing or illegal calibration downgrades calibrated-A3 rows |
| A2 simple registered threshold | `ThresholdRegistryRecord`, A2 threshold rows in `SelectivePredictionRecord`, matched operating points | Same source keys plus threshold feature/value/rule, selection split, target constraint, threshold version | Tests whether A3 adds beyond simple confidence-threshold rejection | Missing threshold registry or test-selected threshold blocks comparison |
| A3 uncertainty/selective variants | `UncertaintyRecord`, `SelectivePredictionRecord`, `Layer3MatchedOperatingPointTable` | Same source keys plus uncertainty feature, feature config, threshold/operating-point ID, metric dictionary | Tests uncertainty-feature and selective-prediction behavior | Missing feature config, label leakage, or unmatched coverage/cost downgrades |
| A4 ordinary controls | `EnsembleControlRecord` or Phase 2 ordinary-control summaries where compatible | Same source keys plus aggregation rule, model-family membership, delay burden, aggregation unit | Nearby ordinary-control comparator for later A4 section; may supply optional disagreement feature context | Must remain A4; reclassified or unmatched controls diagnostic-only |
| A5+ IHARQ/policy/stress/embodiment sections | Downstream records with A3 source IDs and threshold versions | Downstream-specific matched keys plus A3 IDs | Later proof of added value beyond uncertainty/selective prediction | Missing A3 source lineage blocks fair downstream improvement claims |

#### 9.2 Baseline-sufficiency interpretation

A3 may produce four broad outcomes:

| Outcome | Interpretation | Required reporting |
|---|---|---|
| A3 clearly improves over A0/A1/A2 under matched coverage/cost | Uncertainty/selective prediction provides source-supported added offline/proxy reliability evidence | Report metric definitions, matched keys, coverage/rejection burden, limitations, and claim boundaries |
| A3 is similar to A2 | Rich uncertainty/selective prediction may not add beyond simple registered thresholding for the declared protocol | Preserve as negative/sufficiency result; do not hide A2 sufficiency |
| A3 improves retained accuracy but collapses coverage | Result is not a clean reliability improvement unless coverage/cost burden is acceptable and predeclared | Report coverage collapse and downgrade if misleading |
| A3 fails or is unstable under low-calibration budgets | Evidence supports limitation/failure analysis and motivates downstream mechanisms, but does not prove those mechanisms will succeed | Produce `NegativeResultNote`, diagnostic flags, and limitation tags |

#### 9.3 Forbidden comparisons

A3 must not be compared using different datasets, split roles, preprocessing IDs, label maps, seeds, label budgets, model families, calibration splits, threshold-selection splits, or metric definitions unless the mismatch is explicitly declared and the row is diagnostic-only. It must not compare test-tuned uncertainty thresholds against validation-selected A2 thresholds. It must not compare A3 uncertainty features against A4 ordinary controls while calling A4 behavior selective prediction. It must not compare A3 against downstream policy/stress/embodiment metrics without the downstream section’s own matched keys and simulation/proxy boundaries.

### 10. Matched-Comparison Key Requirements

#### 10.1 Required A3 matched-key envelope

A3 comparisons must preserve the following keys wherever available:

```text
dataset_id
subject_id
session_id where available
run_id
trial_id where available
window_id
split_id
split_role
preprocessing_id
label_map_id
label_budget_id
model_id
decoder_id
model_family
score_type
class_order
seed
schema_version
config_hash
prediction_record_id
calibration_id where applicable
calibration_method where applicable
calibration_scope where applicable
calibration_split_id where applicable
uncertainty_record_id
uncertainty_feature
uncertainty_feature_config_id
selective_prediction_record_id
threshold_registry_id where applicable
threshold_selection_split_id where applicable
threshold_version where applicable
operating_point_id where applicable
metric_dictionary_id or metric_dictionary_entry_id
matched_comparison_key
coverage_or_cost_target_id where applicable
claim_safety_tags
validation_status
diagnostic_only_flag where applicable
layer10_export_id where exported
```

#### 10.2 Feature-specific matching requirements

| Feature/comparison family | Additional matching requirement | Diagnostic-only trigger |
|---|---|---|
| Confidence-based A3 rows | Same confidence source: raw or calibrated; same calibration lineage if calibrated | Mixing raw and calibrated confidence without labeling |
| Entropy / normalized entropy | Same probability vector source, class order, normalization rule, calibration lineage where used | Missing class order or probability vector |
| Margin / top-1-top-2 margin | Same class order, top-1/top-2 derivation rule, label map, calibration source | Mismatched class-order or missing top-2 lineage |
| Variation ratio | Same predicted-class/probability source and feature definition | Undefined variation-ratio denominator or source |
| Model disagreement | Same eligible model-family set, ensemble membership, aggregation rules, and A4 separation | Missing member alignment or rebranding ordinary ensemble controls as A3 |
| Conformal set size if used | Same conformal calibration split, score rule, class set construction, and proxy-only status | Conformal split leakage or unsupported set construction |
| Selective-accept/reject behavior | Same threshold registry, selection split, target constraint, feature, coverage/cost target, metric dictionary | Test-tuned threshold, unregistered threshold, or unmatched operating point |
| Risk-coverage / accuracy-coverage curves | Same curve construction rule, denominator, aggregation unit, metric dictionary entries, and source IDs | Missing metric dictionary or incompatible denominators |

#### 10.3 Handling missing keys

If a required key is missing, A3 must preserve the source record unchanged, record missingness in the relevant manifest/report, mark affected rows `diagnostic_only` or `incomplete`, block thesis-ready improvement/sufficiency claims for those rows, expose the warning through Layer 10 exports, and carry the issue into the final handoff block.

### 11. Metric Families and Metric-Dictionary Status

#### 11.1 A3 metric family table

| Metric family | Metrics or metric groups | Required records | Direction/interpretation | Primary or secondary | Metric dictionary status | Limitation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Uncertainty-feature availability | feature coverage, missing-feature rate, eligible-model rate | `PredictionRecord`, `ModelRegistryRecord`, `UncertaintyRecord`, readiness/eligibility reports | Higher availability supports comparability; missingness weakens A3 | Primary eligibility/context | Required entries or manifest definitions | Availability is not performance or safety |
| Uncertainty-feature behavior | confidence, entropy, normalized entropy, margin, variation ratio, disagreement where supported, conformal set size if supported | `UncertaintyRecord`, `CalibrationRecord` where applicable | Direction must be defined per feature; e.g., higher entropy usually means more uncertainty only if definition confirms | Primary A3 source evidence | Required; exact feature enum may require confirmation | Feature values are proxy evidence only |
| Error-detection association | uncertainty/correctness association, AUROC-style error-detection metric where defined, calibration/uncertainty stratified error | `UncertaintyRecord`, evaluation labels, metric dictionary, source IDs | Higher association may suggest useful uncertainty ranking; not safety proof | Secondary/diagnostic unless metric fully defined | Requires confirmation for exact AUROC/AURC-style definitions | Uses evaluation labels; not decision-time feature |
| Risk-coverage / accuracy-coverage | risk at coverage, coverage at target risk, retained accuracy, retained error, accuracy-coverage curve, AURC-style summary if defined | `SelectivePredictionRecord`, `Layer3MatchedOperatingPointTable`, metric dictionary | Better if lower risk at matched coverage or higher coverage at matched risk, subject to burden | Primary A3 evidence | Required; exact denominators and curve summaries require confirmation | Misleading if coverage collapse is hidden |
| Rejection / coverage burden | coverage, rejection rate, selective-accept rate, class/subject/session coverage, imbalance summaries | `SelectivePredictionRecord`, `WindowRecord`, source grouping keys | Lower rejection burden at matched risk is better; group imbalance is limitation | Primary burden evidence | Required | Rejection can hide hard subjects/classes |
| Wrong-accept / high-confidence-wrong behavior | accepted wrong rate, high-confidence wrong rate, accepted high-confidence wrong count where defined | `SelectivePredictionRecord`, `HighConfidenceWrongTable`, metric dictionary | Lower is better, but labels are evaluation-only | Primary/diagnostic depending metric | Required; high-confidence threshold exact definition requires confirmation | Cannot be used as decision-time oracle |
| Calibration-aware uncertainty context | before/after calibration uncertainty behavior, raw-vs-calibrated risk-coverage | `CalibrationRecord`, `UncertaintyRecord`, `SelectivePredictionRecord` | Shows whether calibration changes selective behavior | Secondary A1/A3 bridge | Required for thesis-facing use | Calibration deltas themselves remain A1 context |
| Matched operating-point fairness | matched coverage/cost rows, threshold sufficiency notes, diagnostic-only rate | `Layer3MatchedOperatingPointTable`, `ThresholdRegistryRecord`, `MatchedComparisonReport` | Complete matched rows enable fair comparison; unmatched rows are diagnostic-only | Primary comparison gate | Required | Missing keys block improvement claims |
| Dashboard/reproducibility completeness | source-record linkage, metric ID coverage, export manifest completeness, config/seed/hash completeness | `CalibrationDashboardMetricRecord`, Layer 10 export manifest, run manifest | Higher completeness supports reproducibility | Secondary audit metric | Required where dashboard/thesis output exists | Dashboard completeness is not empirical success |
| Claim-evidence completeness | limitation tags, diagnostic-only flags, claim-evidence links | `ClaimEvidenceManifest`/`ClaimEvidenceMatrix`, `DiagnosticOnlyFlag`, `NegativeResultNote` | Complete traceability supports claim-safe reporting | Secondary claim-safety metric | Required for final thesis claims | Claim audit does not create evidence |

#### 11.2 Metrics explicitly not A3 metrics

| Metric or metric family | A3 status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Pure A0 decoder accuracy without uncertainty/selective context | `A0_context_only` | Needed as comparator but not owned by A3 |
| Pure A1 calibration ECE/Brier/NLL deltas | `A1_context_only` | Calibration visibility belongs to A1; A3 may use it as context |
| Simple confidence-threshold-only operating point without richer uncertainty/selective framing | `A2_context_only` | A2 is the evaluation context for the simple registered threshold baseline |
| Longer-window delay burden, majority vote, probability averaging, multi-window aggregation, ordinary ensemble performance | `A4_context_only` | A4 is the evaluation context for ordinary controls |
| IHARQ action costs, fallback routes, unsafe events, reason-code distribution, combine/request evidence actions | `A5_plus_context_only` | A3 does not emit IHARQ decisions |
| Evidence-quality estimator target quality | `A6_context_only` | A3 can supply uncertainty features but not estimator validation |
| Temporal trust/regime stability, drift/fatigue/dropout regime scores | `A7_context_only` | A3 does not validate RegimeRisk |
| Policy reward, regret, update traces, transitions, episode metrics | `A8_A11_context_only` | A3 has no learned policy or simulation update loop |
| Stress robustness drop, stress schedule success | `A12_context_only` | A3 does not generate controlled stress |
| Embodiment endpoint error, musculoskeletal outcome, real stimulation control | `A13_or_forbidden_context` | A3 has no embodiment validation; real stimulation/clinical claims are forbidden |

#### 11.3 Metric-dictionary rule

No A3 metric is thesis-ready unless the metric dictionary specifies the metric name, definition, directionality, denominator/unit, aggregation level, required records, split role, matched-comparison requirement, diagnostic-only rule, and claim boundary. If an exact useful metric is not source-fixed, A3 may list it as `inferred_candidate` or `requires_confirmation: true`, but the associated claim remains diagnostic-only.

### 12. Split, Leakage, Calibration, Threshold, Policy, Simulation, Stress, and Embodiment Constraints

| Constraint family | A3 rule | Failure consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Split separation | Calibration, uncertainty feature extraction, threshold/operating-point selection, and final evaluation must respect declared split roles | Leakage warning; final claim blocked or diagnostic-only |
| Label-free decision-time features | `UncertaintyRecord` decision-time fields must not contain correctness, future labels, future outcomes, or high-confidence-wrong labels | Feature invalid; affected rows diagnostic-only or blocked |
| Evaluation-only correctness | Correctness/label fields may be used only for evaluation metrics, reliability audits, and allowed threshold-selection splits | Decision-time leakage blocks A3 claims |
| Calibration boundary | Calibrated uncertainty requires valid `CalibrationRecord` lineage; raw uncertainty must be labeled raw/no-calibration | Missing lineage downgrades calibrated rows |
| Threshold registry | Every selective operating point must map to `ThresholdRegistryRecord` where thresholds are used | Unregistered threshold rows exploratory-only or blocked |
| A2/A3 identity separation | Simple confidence-threshold rows remain A2 unless explicitly part of A3 selective comparison with richer uncertainty-feature context | Identity conflict; row reclassified or diagnostic-only |
| A3/A4 identity separation | Voting, averaging, longer-window, multi-window, and ordinary ensemble controls remain A4; disagreement may be an optional A3 feature only with explicit source lineage | Rebranded ordinary control invalid |
| Low-calibration stability | Sparse calibration/selection budgets must be reported; unstable thresholds/features require limitation or downgrade | Hidden budget instability blocks thesis-ready claim |
| Group coverage | Subject/class/session rejection imbalance must be visible where keys exist | Aggregate-only positive results weakened |
| Policy boundary | A3 cannot be tuned using downstream Phase 6 evidence-quality/adaptive-policy targets, Phase 7 deferral outcomes, Phase 8 simulation outcomes, Phase 10 bandit rewards/regret, or Phase 11 RL rewards/rollouts for final evidence | Downstream contamination; diagnostic-only |
| Stress boundary | Stress-conditioned A3 use belongs to A12 unless explicitly declared as diagnostic replay | Stress claim not allowed in clean A3 |
| Embodiment boundary | A3 outputs are not commands, endpoint predictions, stimulation decisions, or patient-safety evidence | Embodiment/clinical claims forbidden |
| Dashboard boundary | Layer 10 may display/export A3 evidence but cannot create hidden metrics, choose thresholds, repair leakage, or remove limitation tags | Non-thesis-ready dashboard output |

---

### 13. Local Sub-Ablation Policy for A3

No additional top-level ablation ID is introduced. The only official global identifier generated here is `A3`. Local A3 variants may be used only as child labels, row labels, or run-matrix entries if later confirmed by the final protocol/run matrix. In v0.1, the following are candidate local variants and must not be treated as mandatory finalized sub-ablations:

| Candidate local variant | Status | Requires confirmation? | Allowed use |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `A3.confidence_uncertainty_profile` | `source_supported_context` | Yes for exact label/run matrix | Evaluate confidence as uncertainty feature while keeping A2 threshold-only rows separate |
| `A3.entropy_selective_prediction` | `source_supported_context` | Yes | Evaluate entropy or normalized entropy risk/coverage behavior |
| `A3.margin_selective_prediction` | `source_supported_context` | Yes | Evaluate top-1/top-2 margin uncertainty and selective accept/reject behavior |
| `A3.variation_ratio_profile` | `source_supported_context` | Yes | Evaluate variation-ratio uncertainty where probability/class outputs support it |
| `A3.disagreement_feature_optional` | `optional_only` / `source_supported_if_aligned_models_exist` | Yes | Use model disagreement as an uncertainty feature without reclassifying A4 ordinary ensemble controls |
| `A3.conformal_proxy_optional` | `optional_stretch_component` | Yes | Use conformal set size only when source-supported and split-safe; proxy-only |
| `A3.matched_coverage_operating_point` | `source_supported_context` | Yes | Compare A3 features at matched coverage |
| `A3.matched_cost_operating_point` | `source_supported_context` | Yes | Compare A3 features at matched cost where metric dictionary defines cost |
| `A3.groupwise_selective_prediction_audit` | `diagnostic_or_secondary` | Yes | Report class/subject/session coverage and rejection imbalance |

If numeric local labels such as `A3.1` or `A3.2` are later used, the mapping, source support, and confirmation status must be recorded before thesis use. Local sub-ablations must not become A14 or another unofficial global ablation.

### 14. Layer 10 Dashboard, Card, Export, and Reproducibility Obligations

#### 14.1 Required Layer 10 outputs for A3

| Layer 10 output | Required source lineage | Warning/downgrade behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Uncertainty distribution view | `UncertaintyRecord`, feature config, prediction/calibration IDs, model IDs, split IDs, metric dictionary entries where summarized | Warn if feature definitions, class order, or source IDs are incomplete |
| Risk-coverage / accuracy-coverage view | `SelectivePredictionRecord`, curve data, metric dictionary IDs, source IDs, operating-point IDs | Mark diagnostic-only if denominators, metric definitions, or matched keys are incomplete |
| Selective-prediction operating-point table | `Layer3MatchedOperatingPointTable`, `ThresholdRegistryRecord`, coverage/cost targets, split IDs, feature IDs | Block comparative claims if operating points are unmatched or test-selected |
| A0/A1/A2/A3 comparison table | A0 raw records, A1 calibration records, A2 threshold records, A3 uncertainty/selective records, matched keys, metric IDs | Show coverage/rejection burden and preserve A2 sufficiency outcomes |
| Group-wise rejection/coverage view | `SelectivePredictionRecord`, subject/class/session keys, source records | Warn if group keys are absent or sample counts sparse |
| High-confidence wrong / accepted-wrong diagnostic view | `HighConfidenceWrongTable`, `SelectivePredictionRecord`, evaluation-only correctness lineage | Diagnostic-only; never a decision-time feature |
| Reliability card source bundle | `CalibrationRecord`, `UncertaintyRecord`, `SelectivePredictionRecord`, audit reports, diagnostic flags, limitation tags | Rendered `ReliabilityCard` remains derived; source records remain primary evidence |
| Dashboard-readable metric source | `CalibrationDashboardMetricRecord` or equivalent source bundle, metric dictionary IDs, filters, warning flags, source IDs, export lineage | Candidate schema; warn if Layer 10 mapping unresolved |
| Export manifest and reproducibility bundle | source paths, output paths, hashes, metric IDs, config IDs, run IDs, calibration IDs, uncertainty IDs, threshold IDs, limitation tags | Missing manifest makes dashboard/table/figure non-thesis-ready |
| Claim-evidence export | claim IDs, source record IDs, metric IDs, limitation tags, diagnostic-only flags, negative-result notes | Must expose Layer 0 claim boundaries and unresolved claim-evidence schema/alias issues |

#### 14.2 Layer 10 prohibitions for A3

Layer 10 must not create hidden A3 metrics from anonymous arrays, tune uncertainty thresholds, select operating points, recalibrate probabilities, repair split leakage, mutate `UncertaintyRecord` or `SelectivePredictionRecord` rows, drop coverage-collapse cases, hide A2 sufficiency results, remove diagnostic-only flags, rebrand A4 ordinary controls as A3 selective prediction, or convert dashboard/card views into primary empirical evidence.

#### 14.3 Layer 10 not-applicable and downstream-only outputs

| Output family | A3 status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| A4 ordinary-control ensemble card | `nearby_context_only` | A4 is the evaluation context for longer-window, multi-window voting/averaging, and ordinary ensemble controls |
| IHARQ decision-flow card | `downstream_context_only` | A5+ sections evaluate IHARQ decisions and action vocabulary produced by the relevant layers/phases |
| Policy update/reward dashboard | `not_applicable` | A3 has no policy update, reward, regret, or transition records |
| Stress robustness dashboard | `downstream_context_only` | Layer 8 / Phase 9 produce stress evidence used by A12 |
| Embodiment endpoint/outcome dashboard | `downstream_context_only` | Layer 9 produces embodiment-proxy evidence used by A13; A3 provides provenance only |

### 15. Layer 0 Claim-Safety Boundaries

#### 15.1 Allowed bounded A3 claim classes

A3 may support only bounded claims such as:

- uncertainty features were computed from public EEG decoder/calibration records under declared splits and lineage;
- uncertainty/selective-prediction baselines changed retained accuracy, retained error, risk, coverage, rejection rate, high-confidence-wrong behavior, or group coverage under declared metric definitions;
- selective-prediction operating points were evaluated under legal threshold/selection splits and matched comparison keys;
- A3 was sufficient, insufficient, unstable, or diagnostic-only under a declared public-data, offline/proxy evaluation protocol;
- later IHARQ/adaptive mechanisms must be compared against A3 where A3 evidence is valid and matched.

#### 15.2 Forbidden or blocked claim classes

| Forbidden claim class | A3 handling |
|---|---|
| Clinical BCI-FES validation | Blocked |
| Real patient safety or patient outcome improvement | Blocked |
| Medical-device readiness | Blocked |
| Real rehabilitation efficacy | Blocked |
| Real-time deployment safety | Blocked |
| Real muscle stimulation control | Blocked |
| Validated therapeutic effectiveness | Blocked |
| Clinical fatigue diagnosis or physiological stress validation | Blocked |
| Uncertainty equals safety or correctness | Blocked |
| Selective prediction is full IHARQ readiness control | Blocked |
| High-confidence-wrong labels are decision-time features | Blocked except isolated oracle/diagnostic analysis marked non-final |
| Dashboard view is primary empirical evidence | Blocked |

#### 15.3 Required limitation labels

A3 outputs should carry limitation tags such as `public_eeg_only`, `low_calibration_protocol`, `uncertainty_evidence_only`, `selective_prediction_baseline_only`, `evaluation_only`, `proxy_readiness`, `diagnostic_only` where applicable, `not_clinical_validation`, `not_real_patient_safety`, `not_medical_device_readiness`, `not_real_rehabilitation_efficacy`, `not_real_muscle_stimulation_control`, and `not_real_deployment_readiness`.

---

### 16. Negative-Result and Baseline-Sufficiency Interpretation

| A3 result pattern | Required interpretation | Required artifact |
|---|---|---|
| A3 does not improve over A2 under matched coverage/cost | Simple registered thresholding may be sufficient for that declared protocol and comparator set | `NegativeResultNote`, `Layer3MatchedOperatingPointTable`, limitation tags |
| A3 improves retained accuracy by rejecting many windows/trials | Improvement is incomplete without coverage, rejection burden, group coverage, and cost context | Coverage/rejection report, group-wise audit, diagnostic flag if burden unacceptable |
| A3 risk-coverage looks strong only for certain subjects/classes/sessions | Aggregate results hide heterogeneity; thesis claim must narrow to supported groups or mark diagnostic | Group-wise audit and limitation note |
| A3 works only with calibrated probabilities | A1 calibration is a necessary upstream condition; raw-score A3 cannot claim same result | Calibration lineage note and comparator split |
| A3 fails under sparse calibration budgets | Low-calibration limitation is evidence; downstream mechanisms remain hypotheses until compared | Negative-result note and sparse-budget warning |
| A3 curves depend on test-tuned thresholds | Invalid for final evaluation; may appear only as oracle/exploratory diagnostic if isolated | Leakage warning and diagnostic-only flag |
| A3 strong result lacks metric dictionary entries | Scientific observation may be reported as diagnostic but not thesis-ready metric claim | Metric-gap note and handoff item |
| A3 source export lacks Layer 10 lineage | Dashboard/table/figure output is not thesis-ready | Export-manifest warning |

Negative A3 outcomes are not failures of the protocol. They are expected evidence outcomes. A3 sufficiency must narrow later A5+ claims; A3 failure must not be used to imply that later modules automatically solve reliability, safety, or readiness.

---

### 17. Diagnostic-Only Downgrade Triggers

| Trigger | Affected scope | Required downgrade |
|---|---|---|
| Missing `PredictionRecord`, model ID, score type, class order, or probability/logit/score fields | Affected model/split/budget rows | Block A3 or mark limited diagnostic |
| Missing or invalid `CalibrationRecord` for calibrated uncertainty rows | Calibrated A3 rows | Downgrade to raw-score context or diagnostic-only |
| Missing `UncertaintyRecord` | Core A3 evidence | Block A3 uncertainty claim |
| Missing `SelectivePredictionRecord` | Selective-prediction/risk-coverage claim | Block or diagnostic-only |
| Missing `ThresholdRegistryRecord` for thresholded operating points | Operating-point rows | Exploratory-only or blocked |
| Threshold/operating point selected on final test labels | Affected comparison | Invalid final claim; oracle diagnostic only if isolated |
| Label-dependent correctness or high-confidence-wrong indicator included as decision-time feature | Affected feature/run | Block final A3 use |
| Missing matched coverage/cost keys | A0/A1/A2/A3 comparison | Diagnostic-only comparison |
| Missing metric dictionary entry | Affected metric | Diagnostic-only metric |
| Coverage denominator or retained-risk definition unresolved | Risk/coverage curves | Diagnostic-only or requires confirmation |
| Source split, preprocessing, label-map, or class-order mismatch | Affected rows | Invalid or diagnostic-only |
| A3 row mixes A2 threshold-only behavior without labeling | A2/A3 comparison | Reclassify or diagnostic-only |
| A3 row includes A4 ordinary voting/averaging/ensemble behavior as if it were A3 | A3/A4 comparison | Reclassify to A4 or diagnostic-only |
| High-confidence-wrong table used downstream as policy feature | Downstream and affected A3 claim | Block / leakage warning |
| Layer 10 export lacks source IDs, metric IDs, config/seed/hash, diagnostic flags, or limitation tags | Dashboard/figure/table | Non-thesis-ready export |
| Layer 0 claim-evidence linkage absent | Final thesis claim | Claim blocked until trace exists |
| Candidate artifacts promoted silently to official canonical status | Affected record/report | Correct status or block claim |

#### 18.1 v0.1 decisions deferred to v1.0 or later confirmation

The following remain `requires_confirmation: true` for A3 unless a later source fixes them: exact dataset list, exact model-family run list, exact final seed count, exact number of runs, exact statistical test, exact threshold/operating-point grids, exact risk/coverage/cost definitions, exact AUROC/AURC-style summaries if used, exact feature enum names, exact dashboard routes/card IDs, exact table/figure numbering, exact repository commands, exact storage paths, exact metric dictionary schema/path, and exact claim-evidence manifest/matrix relationship.

---

### 19. Handoff to Later Protocol Sections

A3 hands forward an uncertainty/selective-prediction comparator that later sections must respect. A4 should next define ordinary longer-window, multi-window voting/averaging, and ensemble controls without absorbing A3 selective-prediction behavior. A5 should compare IHARQ-lite against A0 raw decoder, A1 calibration visibility, A2 simple registered thresholding, A3 uncertainty/selective prediction, and A4 ordinary controls where matched. A6+ sections should consume A3 records only through source IDs, feature configs, split-safe label-free fields, threshold registry IDs, matched comparison keys, and limitation tags.

| Later section | A3 handoff requirement |
|---|---|
| A4 | Preserve A4 as ordinary controls; keep disagreement feature use separated from ordinary ensemble-control claims |
| A5 | Compare IHARQ-lite against A3 under matched keys and report if A3 is sufficient |
| A6 | If evidence-quality estimator uses A3 features, preserve decision-time/evaluation-only partition and feature legality |
| A7 | Use only past-only/label-free uncertainty summaries where RegimeRisk context is evaluated |
| A8–A11 | Treat A3 as baseline/context for deferral or policy learning; do not tune A3 from downstream rewards |
| A12 | Stress-conditioned replay of A3 requires separate stress schedule/profile keys and A12 claim boundary |
| A13 | Embodiment-proxy use of A3 is provenance/input context only, not real control validation |
| Metric-family section | Must define risk, coverage, rejection, retained accuracy/error, high-confidence wrong, uncertainty-feature, and matched-cost metrics precisely |
| Matched-comparison rules | Must formalize A0–A4 and A5+ comparison key envelopes and diagnostic-only downgrade logic |
| Layer 10 obligations section | Must resolve dashboard source-record/export manifest boundaries without changing A3 source evidence |
| Layer 0 claim-safety section | Must map A3 limitation tags and forbidden claims into final claim-evidence packaging |

### 20. v0.1 Versus v1.0 Boundary for A3

This A3 section defines the v0.1 scientific protocol requirements for uncertainty and selective-prediction evaluation. It intentionally does not finalize v1.0 execution details that the source documents leave unresolved.

| Decision family | v0.1 status in A3 | v1.0 / later confirmation requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Dataset and model-family run list | Defined as source-lineage and matchability requirements only | Exact dataset list, eligible model families, and run inclusion/exclusion list require confirmation |
| Seeds and run counts | Required as reproducibility and matched-comparison keys | Exact seed list and number of runs require confirmation |
| Uncertainty feature set | Source-supported features are listed; exact final enum is not frozen | Exact feature enum/casing and optional feature inclusion require confirmation |
| Threshold/operating-point grid | Registry, split legality, and matched coverage/cost requirements are defined | Exact grids, target coverages, target risks, and cost values require confirmation |
| Metrics | Metric families and dictionary obligations are defined | Exact metric dictionary schema/path, denominators, AUROC/AURC-style summaries if used, and statistical tests require confirmation |
| Dashboard/card routes | Layer 10 output obligations and read-only boundaries are defined | Exact dashboard routes, card IDs, table numbers, figure numbers, and export filenames require confirmation |
| Repository paths and commands | Conceptual records/artifacts and lineage obligations are defined | Exact paths, command lines, and run-matrix scripts require confirmation |
| Claim-evidence packaging | Layer 0 boundary and limitation tags are defined | Exact `ClaimEvidenceManifest` / `ClaimEvidenceMatrix` relationship requires final integration confirmation |

A3 v0.1 is therefore complete as a protocol section, not as a final executable run matrix. Any attempt to use unresolved v1.0 choices as thesis-ready evidence must be marked `requires_confirmation: true` or downgraded to diagnostic-only.

## Cumulative A0–A3 Append Audit and Handoff

This cumulative append preserves the complete supplied A0–A2 protocol body intact and appends the A3 uncertainty and selective-prediction section after the prior A0–A2 handoff. The appended section follows the current prompt target, keeps A3 separate from A2 simple registered thresholding and A4 ordinary controls, preserves Layer 3 / Phase 3 as the source producer of uncertainty/selective records, and maintains Layer 10 and Layer 0 boundaries.

No new top-level ablation IDs are introduced. Candidate, unresolved, diagnostic-only, and normalized-candidate statuses are not promoted. Exact v1.0 run-matrix choices remain deferred unless the supplied sources fix them. A3’s role is to define thesis-grade, source-grounded evaluation requirements for uncertainty features, selective prediction, risk/coverage behavior, matched operating points, negative results, and diagnostic-only downgrades.

### 3. Target Purpose and Scientific Question

#### 3.1 Official A4 identity

A4 defines the protocol for evaluating ordinary aggregation and model-combination controls:

- longer-window decoding controls;
- multi-window voting controls;
- multi-window probability or score averaging controls;
- ordinary model-family or member-model ensemble controls;
- ordinary disagreement summaries where they are derived from matched prediction/member records;
- delay-burden notes when aggregation uses additional windows, time, evidence, or model members.

A4 is deliberately ordinary. It exists so the project can test whether the apparent benefit of later IHARQ-style evidence verification is truly more than simple temporal aggregation, simple voting, simple averaging, ordinary model-family combination, or delay-heavy accumulation.

#### 3.2 Scientific question

A4 answers the following bounded evaluation question:

> Under the same public-data, split, preprocessing, label-map, label-budget, model-family, seed, and metric-dictionary constraints used for the raw and reliability baselines, how much performance or stability can be obtained by ordinary longer-window, multi-window voting/averaging, or ensemble controls, and what delay, coverage, matching, and reproducibility burden do those controls impose?

This is not a claim that longer windows or ensembles are clinically safe, reliable for deployment, physiologically meaningful, or sufficient for BCI-FES use. It is an offline/public-data comparator that prevents IHARQ or downstream readiness claims from being benchmarked only against weak raw decoders.

#### 3.3 A4 contribution to the full protocol

| A4 role | Required interpretation |
|---|---|
| Ordinary-control benchmark | A4 tests whether simple aggregation or ensemble combination is already enough to match or beat later methods under the declared protocol. |
| Anti-confound control | A4 prevents IHARQ from being mistaken for ordinary majority vote, probability average, longer-window smoothing, multi-window accumulation, or ordinary ensemble disagreement. |
| Delay/cost exposure | A4 must report any added temporal window, number of windows, model-member count, aggregation unit, and delay-burden note required by the control. |
| Fairness guard | A4 comparisons are valid only when the ordinary-control output and its A0/A1/A2/A3/later comparator are matched on source records, split roles, budget, class order, seed/config policy, and metric dictionary entries. |
| Negative-result protection | If A4 performs strongly, this result must remain visible and must narrow later novelty claims. If A4 fails or is incompatible, the failure is a baseline sufficiency/ordinary-control limitation, not proof that IHARQ succeeds. |

### 9. Baselines and Comparators

#### 9.1 Comparator matrix

| Comparator | Comparator role for A4 | Required match / boundary |
|---|---|---|
| A0 raw decoder / single decoder | Minimum reference for ordinary-control improvement or degradation | Same dataset, subject/session, split role, preprocessing, label map, budget, model family where applicable, seed/config policy, metric dictionary, and aggregation unit disclosure |
| Single-best declared decoder | Sanity comparator against ordinary ensembles | Must be predeclared or chosen using legal validation logic; no hidden test-set selection |
| Same-window prediction baseline | Isolates the effect of adding longer/multiple windows | Must use the same source trial/window lineage and report whether added windows are past-only, future-inclusive/offline, or delayed |
| Longer-window control | Tests whether a longer input/aggregation window improves stability/performance | Must report window duration, stride/overlap, parent-trial lineage, delay burden, and comparability to shorter-window baseline |
| Multi-window majority vote | Tests simple temporal voting | Must report number of windows, vote rule, tie rule, temporal ordering, overlap group, and delay burden |
| Multi-window probability/score average | Tests simple averaging over windows or members | Must report class-order alignment, score type, calibration status if probabilities are calibrated, and whether raw scores are comparable |
| Ordinary model ensemble / probability average | Tests model-family/member aggregation | Must report member model IDs, family membership, member-selection rule, score type, class-order mapping, seed/config policy, and failed/skipped member visibility |
| Ordinary disagreement summary | Diagnostic/control context | Disagreement must not be treated as IHARQ evidence, clinical risk, or readiness safety; it is ordinary-control uncertainty context only |
| A2 simple registered threshold baseline | Nearby baseline, not A4-owned | Threshold rejection and threshold registry logic remain A2. A4 can compare to A2 under matched coverage/cost/delay keys. |
| A3 uncertainty/selective prediction | Nearby baseline, not A4-owned | A3 is the evaluation context for risk/coverage/selective behavior. A4 can be compared to A3 but cannot rebrand selective prediction as ordinary voting. |
| A5 IHARQ-lite | Downstream method that must compare to A4 | If A5 does not beat or meaningfully differ from A4 under matched keys, IHARQ novelty claims must be narrowed or marked diagnostic. |

#### 9.2 Ordinary-control fairness rules

A4 controls are fair only if:

1. the member models/windows are declared before final test interpretation or selected by split-legal validation logic;
2. all source predictions are traceable to `PredictionRecord` and `ModelRegistryRecord` entries;
3. class order, score type, label map, split role, preprocessing, and label budget are compatible;
4. failed or skipped members are visible rather than silently removed;
5. longer-window or multi-window methods disclose extra time/windows and delay-burden notes;
6. probability averaging does not average incomparable score types unless a validated calibration/normalization path is explicitly documented;
7. any use of calibrated probabilities points to A1/Layer 3 source records rather than pretending A4 is the source of calibration;
8. any coverage/rejection behavior points to A2/A3 records rather than treating A4 as selective prediction;
9. A4 outputs are reported with the same metric dictionary and matched comparison keys as the comparator they are used against.

---

### 10. Matched-Comparison Key Requirements

A4 comparisons require explicit matched keys. Missing keys do not merely weaken the wording; they downgrade the affected comparison to `diagnostic_only` or block final thesis claims.

| Key family | Required A4 fields | Diagnostic-only trigger |
|---|---|---|
| Source identity | `source_record_ids`, `dataset_id`, `subject_id`, `session_id`, `run_id`, `trial_id`, `window_id`, `parent_trial_id` where available | Missing or inconsistent source IDs; standalone trial identity unresolved and not recoverable through `WindowRecord` / `PredictionRecord` lineage |
| Split and budget legality | `split_id`, `split_role`, train/validation/test/calibration/adaptation partition, `label_budget_id`, budget version | Split leakage, hidden budget changes, or threshold/member/window selection based on final test labels |
| Preprocessing and label mapping | `preprocessing_id`, preprocessing version, fit scope, `label_map_id`, `label_map_version`, `class_order` | Silent preprocessing mismatch or class-order mismatch across ensemble members/windows |
| Prediction and model provenance | `prediction_record_id`, `model_id`, `decoder_id`, `model_family`, model config hash, checkpoint/artifact path, training status, failed/skipped reason | Orphan predictions, hidden failed members, or incomplete model registry linkage |
| Aggregation/control identity | aggregation rule, control family, number of windows/members, tie rule, averaging rule, score type, class-order mapping, member-selection rule | Unregistered or ambiguous aggregation rule; hidden member selection; incomparable score types |
| Temporal/delay burden | window duration, stride, overlap group, temporal order, past-only/future-inclusive/offline mode, delay-burden note | Longer-window or multi-window benefit reported without delay/cost disclosure |
| Metric identity | `metric_dictionary_id`, metric name, denominator, aggregation level, split role, CI/seed summary where available | Missing metric dictionary or undefined denominator for thesis-facing metrics |
| Comparison identity | `comparison_key`, comparator A-ID, matched source IDs, matched operating point where applicable, diagnostic-only flag | Comparison report absent, missing keys, unmatched coverage/cost/delay keys |
| Layer 10 export lineage | export manifest ID, source record IDs, config hash, seed, validation status, diagnostic-only flags, negative-result notes | Dashboard/card/export cannot be used as thesis evidence |
| Layer 0 claim lineage | claim-safety tags, limitation labels, claim-evidence entry, forbidden-claim audit status | Claim is unbounded, clinical/deployment-coded, or lacks limitation trace |

---

### 11. Metric Families and Metric-Dictionary Status

A4 may report only metric families supported by the supplied architecture/registry or explicitly marked as requiring metric-dictionary confirmation. Exact v1.0 metric names, denominators, statistical tests, and final table/figure numbering remain deferred unless fixed by the implementation artifacts.

| Metric family | A4 use | Source/status | Required dictionary or confirmation condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Accuracy / balanced accuracy | Baseline and ordinary-control performance where class/task structure permits | Source-supported through `BaselineMetricRecord` | Must link to `MetricDictionaryEntry` for thesis-facing use |
| F1 | Class-imbalance-sensitive baseline/control performance where applicable | Source-supported where applicable | Requires exact averaging mode and denominator in metric dictionary |
| AUC | Score-based binary or applicable multiclass metric where valid | Source-supported where applicable | Requires score-type validity and metric dictionary definition; omit if not applicable |
| Confusion-matrix lineage | Error-structure transparency for ordinary controls | Source-supported through baseline metric lineage | Requires class order and label map; no clinical interpretation |
| Seed summaries / confidence intervals where available | Reproducibility and variability | Source-supported as available | Exact final seed count/statistical test remains `requires_confirmation` |
| Low-calibration / low-label curve values | Budgeted ordinary-control context | Source-supported through `LowCalibrationCurveRecord` when budget lineage is valid | Budget IDs, split roles, and sparse-budget warnings required |
| Disagreement coverage / variation style summaries | Ordinary ensemble/window disagreement context | Source-supported as disagreement features/context; exact metric definitions may be incomplete | Requires metric dictionary confirmation if thesis-facing; must not be called IHARQ reliability or clinical risk |
| Delay burden / added-window burden | Cost/latency/temporal burden of longer-window or multi-window controls | Source-supported as delay-burden notes | Exact units and denominators require confirmation; must be visible whenever added windows/time/models are used |
| Delta versus A0 / A1 / A2 / A3 / A5 | Comparative effect under matched keys | Source-supported only through matched comparison reports | Requires matched keys, same metric dictionary entries, and diagnostic-only downgrade if unmatched |
| Coverage/cost matched operating point | Only when comparing A4 to A2/A3 selective/thresholded behavior | Target-conditional; A4 does not own coverage/rejection metrics | Requires A2/A3 operating-point records and exact denominators; otherwise diagnostic-only |
| Stress, simulation, reward, endpoint, embodiment metrics | Not A4 metrics | `downstream_context_only` | Must not appear in A4 as source evidence; only later A12/A13/simulation sections may define them |

#### 11.1 Forbidden metric interpretations

A4 metrics must not be interpreted as:

- real patient safety;
- medical-device readiness;
- real rehabilitation efficacy;
- real-time deployment safety;
- real muscle stimulation control;
- clinical fatigue diagnosis;
- real physiological stress validation;
- validated therapeutic effectiveness;
- proof that ordinary ensemble disagreement is a safety signal;
- proof that longer-window aggregation is acceptable for real-time control.

---

### 12. Split, Leakage, Aggregation, Calibration, Threshold, Policy, Simulation, Stress, and Embodiment Constraints

| Constraint area | A4 rule | Non-compliance consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Split legality | Model/member/window selection, aggregation rule choice, tie rule, and any control tuning must not use final test outcomes | Affected result blocked or `diagnostic_only` |
| Preprocessing leakage | Longer windows and member models must inherit legal preprocessing fit scope | Affected control invalid or diagnostic-only |
| Trial/window leakage | Multi-window controls must explicitly state whether windows are past-only, future-inclusive/offline, overlapping, or delayed | Future-inclusive/offline controls cannot support real-time or deployment-style claims |
| Label leakage | `label_true`, correctness, high-confidence-wrong status, and future outcomes are evaluation-only | Decision-time or feature use blocks claim |
| Calibration | A4 does not calibrate probabilities. Calibrated probabilities require A1/Layer 3 provenance. | Calibration claims invalid if no matched `CalibrationRecord` exists |
| Thresholding | Threshold rejection belongs to A2. Confidence-threshold linkage inside control records must remain identified as A2-linked. | A4 identity conflict; comparison downgraded or corrected in report |
| Selective prediction | Coverage/rejection/risk-coverage belongs to A3 unless explicitly a matched comparator row | A3/A4 identity conflict; diagnostic-only or open issue |
| Ordinary ensemble membership | Member selection must be predeclared or validation-split legal, and failed/skipped members must be logged | Hidden ensemble optimization blocks thesis-ready comparison |
| Score averaging | Averaging requires compatible score type, class order, and calibration status | Incompatible averages diagnostic-only |
| Delay burden | Added time/windows/model count must be surfaced | A4 result cannot be used as fair comparator if delay burden hidden |
| Policy | A4 cannot learn policy actions, rewards, deferrals, or adaptive readiness | Policy claims blocked; move to A8–A11 where applicable |
| Simulation | A4 is not simulation evidence unless downstream Layer 7 creates simulation records | Simulation claims blocked in A4 |
| Stress | A4 clean records must not be overwritten by stress-conditioned records | Stress claims reserved for A12; clean/stressed lineage required |
| Embodiment | A4 cannot imply real actuation, OpenSim/MyoSuite validity, or muscle stimulation control | Embodiment claims reserved for A13 and remain proxy/simulation-bounded |
| Dashboard | Layer 10 may render/export only from saved source records | Dashboard-derived-only result cannot be primary evidence |
| Claim safety | Strictest source limitation wins | Layer 0 downgrades or blocks unsupported claims |

---

### 13. Local Sub-Ablation Policy for A4

A4 may use local sub-ablation labels only as children of A4 and only for bookkeeping within the v0.1 protocol. They must not be treated as new global ablation IDs, phases, layers, modules, or record owners.

| Local A4 control family | Suggested local label status | Source support | Required handling |
|---|---|---|---|
| Longer-window control | `A4.local.longer_window` / `inferred_candidate` | Source-supported concept; exact local label not source-fixed | Mark exact window length/grid as `requires_confirmation`; report delay burden |
| Multi-window majority voting | `A4.local.multi_window_vote` / `inferred_candidate` | Source-supported concept; exact local label not source-fixed | Report number of windows, tie rule, overlap, temporal mode, matched keys |
| Multi-window probability or score averaging | `A4.local.multi_window_average` / `inferred_candidate` | Source-supported concept; exact local label not source-fixed | Validate score type/class order; calibrated probabilities require A1 provenance |
| Ordinary model-family ensemble / probability average | `A4.local.ordinary_ensemble` / `inferred_candidate` | Source-supported concept; exact local label not source-fixed | Report member IDs, family membership, selection rule, failed/skipped members |
| Disagreement-only diagnostic summary | `A4.local.disagreement_context` / `diagnostic_only_or_inferred_candidate` | Source-supported as disagreement context | Do not claim uncertainty/selective prediction unless A3 records exist |
| Delay-burden comparison | `A4.local.delay_burden` / `required_when_applicable` | Source-supported as delay-burden notes | Must accompany longer-window or multi-window controls |

No A4 local label may be promoted to A14 or to an official top-level ablation. Exact local naming, exact grids, exact run counts, exact hyperparameters, exact statistical tests, and exact table/figure IDs remain v1.0/run-matrix confirmations.

---

### 14. Layer 10 Dashboard, Card, Export, and Reproducibility Obligations

Layer 10 may read, validate, filter, summarize, warn, visualize, render cards, export, and package A4 evidence. It must not retrain models, re-run hidden ensemble logic, tune aggregation membership, repair split leakage, invent metric rows, hide failed controls, erase diagnostic-only flags, or treat dashboard views as primary evidence.

#### 14.1 Required A4 dashboard-readable inputs

| Dashboard-readable input | Layer 10 use | Required lineage |
|---|---|---|
| `PredictionRecord` and `ModelRegistryRecord` | Source prediction/model provenance for ordinary controls | source IDs, model IDs, split IDs, score type, class order, seed, config hash, validation status |
| `BaselineMetricRecord` | A0/A4 metric table source | metric dictionary ID, source predictions, aggregation level, split role, comparison key |
| `EnsembleControlRecord` | A4 ordinary-control card/table source | source prediction IDs, member model IDs, aggregation rule, class-order mapping, delay burden, matched keys, candidate/object-class status |
| A4 ordinary-control summaries | Control comparison views | aggregation rule, control family, matched comparator, metric IDs, diagnostic-only status |
| Disagreement tables | Diagnostic/control views | member/window IDs, disagreement definition, score/class-order compatibility, limitation labels |
| Delay-burden notes | Cost/delay warning surfaces | number of windows/members, temporal mode, additional delay/cost, affected comparisons |
| `FailureCaseIndex` and failed/skipped logs | Failure/missingness panels | failed/skipped reason, affected model/window/control, source IDs, limitation tags |
| `Layer2ReadinessReport` | Downstream compatibility and readiness warning panel | consumer matrix, missing fields, diagnostic-only triggers, source paths |
| `MatchedComparisonReport` | Matched-comparison view/export | matched keys, comparator A-IDs, metric dictionary references, missing-key warnings |
| `NegativeResultNote` / `DiagnosticOnlyFlag` | Warning and limitation panels | affected artifacts, reason, severity, final-claim status |
| Claim-evidence entry | Final trace view | allowed claim, source record IDs, limitation tags, diagnostic-only status |

#### 14.2 A4 Layer 10 outputs

| Layer 10 output | Status | A4 requirement |
|---|---|---|
| A4 ordinary-control card/table | Derived dashboard output | Must show aggregation rule, member/window source IDs, metric dictionary references, matched keys, delay burden, candidate status, diagnostic-only labels |
| Baseline/ordinary-control comparison view | Derived dashboard output | Must compare A4 to A0/A1/A2/A3/A5 only where matched; unmatched rows must be visibly diagnostic-only |
| Delay-burden warning panel | Derived warning output | Required when longer-window or multi-window controls add time/windows/members |
| Ensemble/control incompatibility panel | Derived warning output | Required when class-order/model/window/member alignment fails |
| Reproducibility export package | Derived export output | Must preserve config hash, seed, model paths, source record IDs, metric dictionary IDs, validation status, negative-result notes |
| Thesis figure/table export | Derived export output | Must not omit poor A4 results, strong A4 results, failed/skipped controls, or diagnostic-only labels |

#### 14.3 Layer 10 prohibited A4 actions

Layer 10 must not:

- select the best A4 ensemble using held-out test outcomes;
- recompute unlogged aggregation logic;
- silently alter vote/average/tie rules;
- hide delay burden;
- repair class-order mismatch without a new validated source record;
- erase failed/skipped model members;
- convert ordinary-control disagreement into IHARQ evidence;
- present A4 dashboard summaries as primary empirical records;
- produce clinical, deployment, patient-safety, rehabilitation, or real-control claims.

---

### 15. Layer 0 Claim-Safety Boundaries

#### 15.1 Allowed A4 claim forms

A4 may support bounded claims such as:

- “Under the declared public EEG protocol, ordinary longer-window or multi-window controls achieved the reported offline metric values under matched keys.”
- “Ordinary ensemble/voting/averaging controls provide a non-IHARQ baseline for later evidence-verification comparisons.”
- “A4 performance is sufficient, insufficient, unstable, or diagnostic-only under the declared metric dictionary and matched-comparison status.”
- “A4 controls impose an explicit delay/window/member burden that must be considered when comparing to IHARQ or selective prediction.”
- “A4 strong results narrow later novelty claims unless downstream methods outperform them under matched conditions.”

#### 15.2 Forbidden A4 claim forms

A4 must not support claims that imply:

- clinical BCI-FES validation;
- real patient safety;
- medical-device readiness;
- real rehabilitation efficacy;
- real-time deployment safety;
- real muscle stimulation control;
- validated therapeutic effectiveness;
- real physiological stress validation;
- clinical fatigue diagnosis;
- real embodied control validation;
- ordinary ensemble disagreement as a clinical safety signal;
- longer-window aggregation as a safe real-time controller;
- IHARQ novelty without comparison to A4 where compatible.

#### 15.3 Required A4 limitation labels

```text
public_eeg_only
offline_public_benchmark
low_calibration_protocol_only
ordinary_control_only
decoder_baseline_only
evaluation_only
not_iharq
not_selective_prediction
not_readiness_policy
not_stress_robustness
not_embodiment_validation
not_clinical_validation
not_medical_device_evidence
not_real_patient_safety_evidence
not_rehabilitation_efficacy_evidence
not_real_muscle_stimulation_control
not_deployment_readiness
diagnostic_only_if_missing_metric_dictionary
diagnostic_only_if_unmatched_keys
diagnostic_only_if_incomplete_ensemble_alignment
diagnostic_only_if_hidden_delay_burden
dashboard_derived_not_primary
ensemble_control_not_iharq
```

### 16. Negative-Result and Baseline-Sufficiency Interpretation

A4 negative, weak, strong, or inconvenient results must be preserved. They are part of the scientific control protocol.

| A4 result pattern | Interpretation | Required handling |
|---|---|---|
| A4 outperforms A0 | Ordinary aggregation/control improves the raw baseline under declared conditions | Preserve result; later IHARQ/A5+ claims must compare against A4, not only A0 |
| A4 matches or outperforms A2/A3 | Simple ordinary controls may be sufficient relative to threshold/selective baselines under the declared protocol | Do not hide result; narrow claims about uncertainty/selective prediction or downstream novelty |
| A4 outperforms A5/IHARQ later | IHARQ evidence verification may not add value beyond ordinary controls under the matched protocol | Preserve as negative or limiting evidence; A5+ claims become narrowed or diagnostic-only |
| A4 improves performance but requires high delay/additional windows | Performance gain carries cost/delay burden | Report delay burden; do not present as equivalent to low-latency or real-time readiness |
| A4 fails due to incompatible class order or member alignment | Ordinary-control evidence is not thesis-ready for affected rows | Mark diagnostic-only; do not fabricate compatible ensemble results |
| A4 underperforms raw decoder | Ordinary aggregation can harm performance | Preserve negative result and failure modes; do not assume aggregation is beneficial |
| A4 result is strong on one subject/session but unstable elsewhere | Heterogeneous ordinary-control behavior | Narrow claims by subject/session or mark group-level claims diagnostic-only |
| A4 lacks metric dictionary or matched comparison report | Evidence may be descriptive only | Mark diagnostic-only until metric/matching is resolved |
| A4 uses future-inclusive/offline windows | Offline diagnostic/control only | Block real-time/deployment-style wording and disclose temporal mode |

Baseline sufficiency for A4 does not require every possible ensemble or window grid. It requires enough predeclared, source-traceable, split-legal ordinary controls to prevent downstream IHARQ or reliability claims from being benchmarked only against a weak raw decoder. Missing optional controls must be logged, not invented.

---

### 17. Diagnostic-Only Downgrade Triggers

| Trigger | Affected A4 output | Downgrade / block rule |
|---|---|---|
| Missing `PredictionRecord` lineage | All A4 controls derived from that source | Block or diagnostic-only |
| Missing `ModelRegistryRecord` linkage | Ensemble/member controls | Block thesis-ready comparison |
| Missing class order or incompatible class order | Vote/average/probability aggregation | Diagnostic-only or invalid |
| Missing score type or incompatible scores | Probability/score averaging | Diagnostic-only unless valid transformation/calibration provenance exists |
| Missing `WindowRecord` / trial/window alignment | Longer-window/multi-window controls | Diagnostic-only; cannot claim matched control |
| Hidden future-window use | Longer-window/multi-window controls | Offline/diagnostic-only; no real-time-like claim |
| Hidden delay burden | Longer-window/multi-window controls | Diagnostic-only until burden is surfaced |
| Ensemble membership selected on test outcomes | Ordinary ensemble controls | Block final claim; oracle/diagnostic-only if retained |
| Failed/skipped members hidden | Ensemble controls | Diagnostic-only and negative-result note required |
| Unmatched A0/A1/A2/A3/A5 comparator keys | Comparative rows | Diagnostic-only; no final comparative claim |
| Missing metric dictionary entry | Thesis-facing metrics | Diagnostic-only for affected metrics |
| Split leakage or illegal preprocessing fit | Affected controls and metrics | Block final evidence; `LeakageWarningRecord` required |
| Missing `MatchedComparisonReport` | Comparative A4 claims | Diagnostic-only |
| `EnsembleControlRecord` object class/schema unresolved for a claimed output | A4 record-level claim | Preserve normalized-candidate status; diagnostic-only if schema ambiguity affects interpretation |
| A4 ordinary control called IHARQ | Claim text / dashboard label | Claim-safety block and label repair required |
| Dashboard-generated view used as primary evidence | Dashboard/table/figure claim | Claim downgraded; source lineage required |
| Layer 0 claim-evidence link missing | Final thesis claim | Not thesis-ready |

### 19. Handoff to Later Protocol Sections

| Later section | A4 handoff |
|---|---|
| A5 — IHARQ-lite | Must compare IHARQ evidence verification against A4 ordinary controls where compatible. Strong A4 results narrow A5 novelty claims. |
| A6 — IHARQ + evidence-quality estimator | Must not treat A4 ordinary ensemble disagreement as learned evidence quality unless a downstream source-supported estimator exists. |
| A7 — IHARQ + RegimeRisk | May use A4 as ordinary-control comparator but must not interpret A4 as temporal trust. |
| A8 — Learning-to-defer | Must distinguish deferral decisions from ordinary multi-window delay/aggregation. |
| A9 — Supervised Adaptive-IHARQ | Must compare adaptive readiness gains against A4 ordinary controls where matched. |
| A10/A11 — Bandit/RL policy | May use A4 as frozen ordinary-control baseline in simulation only; no A4 policy updates. |
| A12 — StressForge | May stress-condition A4 controls only through clean-vs-stress lineage and controlled stress profiles. |
| A13 — Embodiment demo | May compare A4 consequences only through proxy/simulation embodiment records, not real actuation claims. |
| Metric-family section | Must finalize A4-compatible metric dictionary entries for performance, confusion lineage, delay burden, disagreement, and matched deltas. |
| Matched-comparison rules | Must include A4 aggregation rule, member/window identity, delay burden, and raw/control matching keys. |
| Diagnostic-only downgrade rules | Must include A4-specific triggers for class-order mismatch, hidden delay burden, hidden member selection, and object-class ambiguity. |
| Layer 10 export/dashboard obligations | Must include A4 ordinary-control cards/tables, warning panels, source IDs, metric IDs, and diagnostic labels. |
| Layer 0 claim-safety boundaries | Must explicitly block ordinary-control-to-IHARQ, ordinary-control-to-safety, and dashboard-derived-as-primary-evidence claims. |

## A5 — IHARQ-lite / Rule-Based Evidence Verification

**Generated target:** `A5`  
**Protocol version:** `v0.1`  
**Generation mode:** append new target section to the supplied cumulative protocol  
**Previous protocol sections provided:** `YES — A0, A1, A2, A3, A4`  
**Output behavior applied:** the supplied A0–A4 protocol body is preserved substantively; this A5 section is appended after the cumulative A0–A4 handoff.

**Target identity:** A5 is the IHARQ-lite / rule-based evidence-verification evaluation context. It is not an implementation phase, layer, module, record owner, learned policy, dashboard, clinical-safety mechanism, or embodiment-validation claim. A5 evaluates source-supported Layer 4 / Phase 4 outputs against matched A0–A4 baselines and controls.

---

### 0. A5 Document-Control Audit and Target Resolution

| Field | Resolved value |
|---|---|
| Protocol document | IHARQ BenchGuard Stretch C — Experiment, Ablation, and Evaluation Protocol |
| Protocol version | `v0.1` |
| Requested target section | `A5` |

| Primary producing layer for A5 source evidence | Layer 4 — IHARQ Evidence Verification |
| Primary producing implementation phase | Phase 4 — IHARQ-lite evidence verification |
| A5 producer status | A5 is **not** the producer. Phase 4 / Layer 4 produce the records used by the A5 evaluation context. |
| Direct upstream evidence dependencies | Phase 1 source/window/split lineage; Phase 2 prediction/model/baseline evidence; Phase 3 calibration, uncertainty, selective-prediction, threshold, and matched operating-point evidence |
| Primary comparators | A0, A1, A2, A3, A4, plus source-supported local Layer 4 submodule ablations |
| Layer 10 role | Read, validate, summarize, warn, render cards/views, export, and package reproducibility from source records; not primary evidence creation |
| Layer 0 role | Claim-safety, limitation, forbidden-claim blocking, diagnostic-only downgrade, and final claim-review governance; not empirical evidence creation |
| Claim boundary | Public EEG proxy evidence, computational evidence verification, proxy readiness-control, and evaluation-only reporting; no clinical, deployment, medical-device, real-safety, real-rehabilitation, real-muscle-stimulation, or real-world closed-loop validation claim |

A5 must be read as the first IHARQ-family ablation/evaluation section after A0–A4 baseline/control sections. It tests whether transparent, reason-coded, rule-based evidence verification adds value beyond raw decoder output, calibration visibility, simple thresholding, uncertainty/selective prediction, and ordinary longer-window/voting/averaging/ensemble controls. It does not claim that IHARQ-lite is a learned adaptive policy, a clinical safety layer, or a real-time assistive controller.
