| `TransitionRecord` | Layer 7 | Phase 8 and Phase 11 runs | transition ID, step index, state hash, validated action, next-state ID, reward trace ID, policy update trace ID where applicable, matched key, stress IDs where active | Validated, reward-linked, action-legal | Delayed-consequence evidence and policy analysis | Missing transition lineage blocks rollout metrics |

| `ClosedLoopSessionRecord` | Layer 7 | Phase 8 and Phase 11 runs | dataset/session/split IDs, policy ID, environment config, reward config, replay mode, stress profile/schedule IDs, seed, update/frozen mode | Validated, manifest-mapped | Session-level reproducibility and matched evaluation | Missing session record blocks session/episode claim |
| `PolicyRolloutRecord` | Layer 7 | Phase 11 | rollout ID, policy ID, frozen/update mode, transition/reward/action pointers, matched key, controller-card ID | Validated and separated by mode | Held-out frozen rollout evaluation and training/adaptation separation | Mixed modes or missing pointers downgrade to diagnostic-only |

| `EnvironmentDiagnosticRecord` | Layer 7 | Phase 8 and Phase 11 runs | diagnostic ID, failed invariant, leakage/action/reward/update warnings, repair action, diagnostic-only flag | Required for every run bundle | Downgrade logic and Layer 10 warning panels | Missing diagnostics weakens or blocks validity assessment |

| `StressProfileRecord` / `StressScheduleRecord` | Layer 8 | Phase 9 | stress profile/schedule IDs, intensity, seed, clean pairing, target fields, schedule linkage | Required only for stress-conditioned A11 claims | Stress-conditioned sequential-policy evaluation | Missing stress lineage blocks stress-conditioned claim |

### 9. Baselines and Comparators

| Comparator | Required status | Comparison purpose | Missingness handling |
|---|---|---|---|
| A0 raw decoder / accept-all reference | Required where simulation replay can include it | Shows value beyond no-readiness-policy reference | If unavailable, disclose and narrow claim |
| A1 calibrated decoder | Required where calibrated probabilities are used | Separates RL gain from calibration-only gain | Missing calibration blocks calibration-conditioned claims |
| A2 simple registered threshold | Required | Static threshold control | Missing or test-tuned threshold invalidates threshold comparison |
| A3 uncertainty/selective prediction | Required when uncertainty/selective features are used | Coverage/wrong-accept and selective-prediction comparator | Missing matched coverage/cost downgrades comparison |
| A4 longer-window/multi-window/voting/ordinary ensemble controls | Required where the same window/session replay supports it | Rules out simple temporal smoothing or ensembling as sufficient | Missing A4 narrows ordinary-control claim |
| A5 IHARQ-lite | Required | Interpretable rule baseline | Missing A5 blocks IHARQ-vs-RL narrative |
| A6 evidence-quality-aware IHARQ | Conditional but expected where implemented | Tests whether learned evidence quality suffices without RL | Missing A6 narrows learned-evidence baseline claim |
| A7 RegimeRisk-aware policy context | Conditional | Tests temporal-trust contribution against RL | Required only if RegimeRisk context is included |
| A8 learning-to-defer | Required where deferral is in action space | Tests deferral/routing sufficiency | Missing A8 narrows deferral-burden interpretation |
| A9 supervised Adaptive-IHARQ | Required where implemented | Strong non-RL learned-policy baseline | Missing A9 narrows adaptive-policy superiority claim |
| A10 contextual bandit | Strongly expected where validated | Immediate-reward adaptation comparator for delayed-consequence RL | Missing/diagnostic A10 means A11 can only claim against available non-bandit baselines |
| Best fixed policy / oracle-like diagnostic comparator | Optional/diagnostic, not policy-deployed | Contextualizes regret/return when source-supported | Must be marked diagnostic if uses hindsight/oracle fields |

A11 may be considered baseline-sufficiently unnecessary if A8, A9, A10, or even A2/A3/A5 matched controls achieve equal or better delayed-consequence performance with lower complexity, lower reward sensitivity, fewer unsafe/proxy events, better interpretability, or more stable seeds.

### 10. Matched-Comparison Key Requirements

#### 10.1 Required key families

A thesis-facing A11 comparison must preserve the following matched-key envelope unless a key is explicitly `not_applicable` and justified:

| Key family | Required A11 key(s) | Required status |
|---|---|---|
| Public-data identity | `dataset_id`, `subject_id`, `session_id`, `trial_id`, `window_id` where available | Required |
| Split and protocol identity | `split_id`, `split_role`, `preprocessing_id`, `label_map_id`, `low_calibration_budget_id` | Required |
| Model and evidence identity | `model_id` or `model_family_id`, `calibration_id`, `threshold_registry_id`, `evidence_quality_id`, `iharq_decision_id`, `regime_state_id` where active | Required if consumed |
| Simulation identity | `simulation_environment_id`, `environment_config_id`, `episode_definition_id`, `replay_mode`, `reward_config_id`, `cost_config_id`, `action_space_version`, `legality_mask_id` | Required |
| Policy identity | `policy_id`, `policy_family`, `policy_config_id`, `policy_artifact_version`, `frozen_or_update_mode`, `policy_training_split_id`, `adaptation_split_id`, `held_out_evaluation_split_id` | Required |
| Update trace identity | `policy_update_trace_id`, `disabled_update_audit_status`, `update_mode`, `update_step` where applicable | Required for update-enabled runs |
| Stress identity | `stress_profile_id`, `stress_schedule_id`, `stress_seed`, clean/stressed pairing ID | Required only for stress-conditioned A11 |
| Embodiment identity | `embodiment_mode_id`, `embodiment_run_id`, command mapping ID | `downstream_context_only` unless Phase 12/13 embodiment-aware A11 is explicitly evaluated |
| Reproducibility identity | seed, run ID, config hash, code/environment hash, manifest ID | Required |
| Evaluation/reporting identity | `metric_dictionary_id`, matched comparison key, dashboard export ID, claim ID, diagnostic flag | Required for thesis-facing reporting |

#### 10.2 Missing key handling

| Missing key condition | Comparison status |
|---|---|
| Missing dataset/split/window/source lineage | Invalid for thesis-facing A11 |
| Missing policy config, reward config, legality mask, or environment config | Diagnostic-only or blocked |
| Missing `PolicyUpdateTrace` for update-enabled mutation | Invalid for update-enabled A11 claim |
| Mutation during held-out frozen evaluation | Invalid |
| Missing disabled-update/no-mutation audit for frozen evaluation | Diagnostic-only until audited |
| Missing A10 comparator | Claim may be against available non-bandit baselines only; no “beyond immediate adaptation” claim |
| Missing stress profile/schedule for stress result | Stress-conditioned A11 claim blocked |
| Missing metric dictionary entry | Metric diagnostic-only |
| Missing dashboard/export/claim ID | Empirical record may exist, but final thesis/dashboard-ready claim blocked |

### 11. Metric Families and Metric-Dictionary Status

| Metric family | Metrics / examples | Required records | Direction / interpretation | Primary or secondary | Metric dictionary status | Limitation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Delayed-consequence return and cost | episode return, discounted/undiscounted return where declared, cumulative cost, component reward/cost decomposition | `RewardTraceRecord`, `EpisodeSummaryRecord`, `PolicyRolloutRecord` | Higher return/lower cost is better only under fixed reward config | Primary | Required; exact formula/denominator may require confirmation | Reward-dependent and simulation-only |
| Wrong-accept and safety-proxy behavior | wrong-accept proxy rate, unsafe/proxy event count, blocked/invalid action rate | `TransitionRecord`, `SafetyEventRecord`, `EnvironmentDiagnosticRecord` | Lower is better, but not real patient safety | Primary | Required | Proxy/simulation warnings only |
| Waiting/request/fallback/deferral burden | wait rate, request-evidence rate, fallback rate, deferral rate, delay cost | `PolicyActionRecord`, `TransitionRecord`, `RewardTraceRecord`, `DeferralRecord` where active | Lower burden is not always better if wrong accepts rise | Primary/secondary depending claim | Required | Must be interpreted jointly with safety and reward |
| Policy stability and seed sensitivity | return variance across seeds, action-distribution drift, instability flags, collapse rate | `PolicyRolloutRecord`, `EpisodeSummaryRecord`, configs/seeds | Lower instability supports stronger claim | Primary for RL robustness | Required; thresholds require confirmation | Exact final seed count deferred |
| Reward sensitivity | ranking changes across reward weights, reward-term ablation, component dominance warning | `RewardTraceRecord`, reward configs, matched reports | Stable ranking is stronger; unstable ranking downgrades claim | Primary for A11 | Required; grid/thresholds require confirmation | Reward arbitrariness risk |
| Baseline comparison | difference vs A2/A3/A5/A8/A9/A10, matched cost/coverage/reward deltas | `MatchedComparisonReport`, source records | Improvement must be matched and limitation-tagged | Primary | Required | Unmatched deltas are diagnostic only |
| Training/adaptation versus held-out frozen performance | learning curve, held-out return curve, no-mutation evidence | `PolicyUpdateTrace`, `PolicyRolloutRecord`, disabled-update audit | Training gains do not equal frozen superiority | Primary | Required | Must separate update/adaptation from evaluation |
| Stress-conditioned behavior | stress-conditioned return, safety-proxy events, burden and action distribution under stress | `StressProfileRecord`, `StressScheduleRecord`, `TransitionRecord`, `RewardTraceRecord` | Valid only under matched clean/stressed conditions | Conditional | Required only for stress claims | Stress-only, not real-world robustness validation |
| Dashboard/reproducibility completeness | card/source completeness, manifest completeness, config/seed/hash availability | `CardRecord`, `ReproducibilityManifest`, `DashboardMetricRecord` | Complete supports reproducibility reporting | Secondary/reporting | Required for dashboard-ready claim | Dashboard-read-only, not empirical improvement |
| Claim-evidence completeness | claim linked to records, limitations, negative notes, diagnostic flags | `ClaimEvidenceManifest` / `ClaimEvidenceMatrix` | Complete supports claim-safe thesis wording | Secondary/final | Required | Claim support only within weakest evidence boundary |

Forbidden metric wording includes `clinical safety score`, `patient safety rate`, `rehabilitation success`, `medical-device readiness`, `real-time deployment safety`, `real stimulation correctness`, and any metric that implies real patient or real BCI-FES validation. Allowed replacements must use `simulation-only`, `proxy`, `public-data`, `controlled-stress`, or `dashboard-read-only` language.

### 12. Split, Leakage, Threshold, Policy, Simulation, Stress, and Embodiment Constraints

| Constraint family | A11 rule | Downgrade if violated |
|---|---|---|
| Split and test lockout | RL training/adaptation, reward tuning, threshold selection, and policy selection must not use held-out evaluation outcomes | Invalid or diagnostic-only |
| Decision-time visibility | `ReadinessContextRecord` must exclude hidden true labels, future correctness, future reward, future next state, future stress outcome, and future embodiment outcome as ordinary policy-visible fields | Invalid if leaked |
| Threshold/calibration freeze | A2/A3/A1 operating points must be selected outside held-out evaluation and preserved through matched replay | Invalid comparator if post-hoc tuned |
| Action legality | Every RL action must pass declared legality mask; invalid actions must be blocked/substituted with warnings | Illegal selected action blocks thesis-ready rollout |
| Reward freeze | Reward/cost config must be versioned and hashed before held-out evaluation | Reward claims diagnostic-only if tuned post hoc |
| Update/frozen separation | Training/adaptation curves and held-out frozen-evaluation curves must be separate; frozen evaluation must have disabled-update/no-mutation evidence | Invalid if mixed |
| `PolicyUpdateTrace` | Every update-enabled mutation must be trace-linked to context/action/reward/next-state and policy artifact/version | Invalid update-enabled evidence if missing |
| Baseline matching | A11 and comparators must share replay sessions, reward config, stress schedule, seed policy, and matched keys | Unmatched diagnostic-only |
| Stress separation | Stress-conditioned A11 requires Phase 9 records and fixed clean/stressed pairing; stress cannot be invented inside Layer 7 or tuned to results | Stress claim blocked if missing |
| Embodiment boundary | Embodiment-aware RL terms are not core A11; they require Layer 9 records and remain simulation/proxy-only | `downstream_context_only` or diagnostic-only |
| Dashboard boundary | Dashboard interactions cannot alter experimental results or hidden records | Claim-safety failure if dashboard repairs evidence |

### 13. Local Sub-Ablation Policy for A11

Local sub-ablations are allowed only as children of A11. They do not create new global A-IDs. The sub-ablations below are v0.1 protocol categories; exact run matrices, algorithm choices, reward-weight grids, and seeds require later confirmation.

| Sub-ablation ID | Parent global ID | Variant definition | Required config difference | Required records | Metric purpose | Claim status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A11.1 | A11 | Minimal RL policy with small declared action space | RL enabled, declared action set, frozen held-out evaluation | `PolicyActionRecord`, `PolicyRolloutRecord`, `RewardTraceRecord`, `TransitionRecord` | Minimum viability vs simpler policies | `source_supported`, exact algorithm `requires_confirmation` |
| A11.2 | A11 | Reward-weight sensitivity | Reward/cost config alternatives fixed before evaluation | reward configs, `RewardTraceRecord`, `MatchedComparisonReport` | Detect reward-dependence/ranking instability | `requires_confirmation` for grid/thresholds |
| A11.3 | A11 | Seed/policy-stability analysis | Multiple seeds / declared seed policy | rollout/episode records, seeds, config hashes | Detect instability or collapse | `requires_confirmation` for final seed count |
| A11.4 | A11 | Update-enabled training versus held-out frozen evaluation | Update trace active during training/adaptation; disabled-update audit in evaluation | `PolicyUpdateTrace`, disabled-update audit, rollout records | Verify no mutation during held-out evaluation | Required for update-enabled claim |
| A11.5 | A11 | Stress-conditioned RL | Adds validated Phase 9 stress profiles/schedules | stress records, transition/reward/rollout records | Test controlled stress sensitivity | Conditional; `diagnostic_only` without stress keys |
| A11.6 | A11 | Embodiment-aware reward or context variant | Adds Phase 12/13 embodiment records and reward terms | Layer 9 records, `Layer9RewardTrace` if active, transition linkage | Optional downstream embodiment-proxy analysis | `downstream_context_only` unless explicitly implemented |

### 14. Layer 10 Dashboard, Card, Export, and Reproducibility Obligations

Layer 10 must render A11 evidence from saved records only. It may validate completeness, summarize metrics, show warnings, generate cards, export tables/figures, and package reproducibility artifacts. It must not train RL, retune reward weights, modify policy artifacts, repair missing traces, mutate clean records, recompute hidden evidence, or suppress negative results.

| Layer 10 output | Required source records | Required warning behavior | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| RL controller/policy card | RL policy artifact, `PolicyActionRecord`, action-space config, legality mask, reward config, limitation tags | Warn if policy config, action-space version, legality mask, or simulation-only tag is missing | Required |
| Reward decomposition view/card | `RewardTraceRecord`, reward/cost configs, episode summaries | Warn if reward config is unversioned, post-hoc, or component sum fails | Required |
| Training versus frozen evaluation view | `PolicyUpdateTrace`, disabled-update audit, `PolicyRolloutRecord` | Warn if training/adaptation and held-out evaluation curves are mixed | Required |
| Matched policy comparison table | `MatchedComparisonReport`, metric dictionary entries, baseline source records | Warn if key families are incomplete or comparator missing | Required |
| Negative-result and diagnostic-only panel | `NegativeResultNote`, `DiagnosticOnlyFlag`, `EnvironmentDiagnosticRecord` | Display failed, flat, unstable, unsafe, reward-sensitive, seed-sensitive, or invalid runs visibly | Required |
| Stress-conditioned view | Stress records plus A11 rollout/transition/reward records | Warn if stress profile/schedule lineage or clean/stressed match is missing | Conditional |
| Safety/proxy event view | `SafetyEventRecord`, `TransitionRecord`, diagnostics | Warn that events are simulated/proxy warnings, not real patient safety | Conditional/required when events exist |
| Reproducibility manifest | configs, seeds, hashes, run IDs, code/environment versions, record manifests | Warn if run cannot be reproduced from saved source records | Required for dashboard-ready claim |
| Claim-evidence view | claim-evidence manifest/matrix, metric entries, limitation tags, cards | Warn if claim wording exceeds simulation-only evidence boundary | Required for final reporting |

### 15. Layer 0 Claim-Safety and Limitation Boundaries

#### 15.1 Allowed bounded A11 claim classes

A11 may support only bounded claims such as:

- simulation-only evidence about delayed-consequence readiness-policy behavior;
- comparison of RL against simpler validated policies under matched public-data/proxy replay;
- reward/cost and wrong-accept/safety-proxy trade-off evidence under declared reward models;
- evidence that RL is unstable, unnecessary, reward-sensitive, seed-sensitive, or weaker than simpler baselines;
- controlled stress-conditioned simulation evidence where Phase 9 stress records are valid;
- dashboard-read/export traceability and reproducibility evidence for saved A11 records.

#### 15.2 Required limitation labels

A11 outputs must carry limitation labels such as:

- `public_eeg_only`;
- `proxy_readiness`;
- `simulation_only_policy_learning`;
- `declared_reward_model_only`;
- `held_out_frozen_evaluation_required`;
- `no_real_patient_safety_claim`;
- `not_clinical_validation`;
- `not_medical_device_readiness`;
- `not_real_rehabilitation_efficacy`;
- `not_real_muscle_stimulation_control`;
- `stress_conditioned_only` where stress is used;
- `embodiment_proxy_only` where optional Layer 9 records are used;
- `diagnostic_only` where any downgrade trigger fires.

#### 15.3 Forbidden A11 claim classes

A11 must not support claims of:

- clinical BCI-FES validation;
- real patient safety;
- medical-device readiness;
- real rehabilitation efficacy;
- real-time deployment safety;
- real muscle stimulation or real assistive-control success;
- real-world embodied control validation;
- clinical fatigue diagnosis or real physiological stress validation;
- RL superiority without matched, held-out, frozen, trace-complete evidence;
- safety guarantee from proxy `SafetyEventRecord` summaries.

### 16. Negative-Result and Baseline-Sufficiency Interpretation

| Result pattern | Required interpretation | Required artifact |
|---|---|---|
| A11 fails to beat A10 contextual bandit | Delayed-consequence RL is not supported beyond immediate adaptation under tested assumptions | `NegativeResultNote`, matched report, limitation tag |
| A11 fails to beat A8/A9 | Deferral or supervised adaptive policy may be sufficient and preferable | `NegativeResultNote`, baseline-sufficiency note |
| A11 beats weak baselines but not A5/A8/A9/A10 | Claim must be narrowed; no broad adaptive-policy superiority | Diagnostic flag or narrowed claim entry |
| Training/adaptation improves but frozen held-out evaluation does not | Training curve is not evidence of deployable/frozen policy benefit | Separate training/frozen plots and negative note |
| A11 increases wrong accepts or safety/proxy events | Positive reward claim is blocked or weakened even if return improves | Safety/proxy warning and Layer 0 downgrade |
| A11 is reward-sensitive | Any superiority claim is reward-model-dependent | Reward sensitivity report and limitation tag |
| A11 is seed-sensitive or unstable | Claim downgraded; stability analysis required | Seed sensitivity note, diagnostic flag if severe |
| A11 overuses wait/request/fallback/deferral | Interpret as burden shift rather than pure improvement | Burden metrics and negative/baseline sufficiency note |
| Stress-conditioned A11 collapses | Controlled-stress weakness is thesis-useful; no real-world robustness claim | Stress diagnostic note and dashboard warning |
| Simulator diagnostics fail | A11 becomes environment limitation/debug evidence, not thesis-ready policy evidence | `EnvironmentDiagnosticRecord`, `DiagnosticOnlyFlag` |

Negative A11 results must be preserved in Layer 10 views and Layer 0 claim-evidence review. The protocol must never imply that RL is expected to outperform simpler baselines.

### 17. Diagnostic-Only Downgrade Triggers

| Trigger | Downgrade |
|---|---|
| Missing or invalid Phase 8/Layer 7 simulation environment | A11 blocked or diagnostic-only |
| Missing clean public-data/split/window/source lineage | Invalid for thesis-facing A11 |
| Hidden true labels, future correctness, future reward, future next state, future stress outcome, or future embodiment outcome visible to policy | Invalid due to leakage |
| Missing action legality mask or unsupported action token | Diagnostic-only or invalid |
| Illegal selected action in thesis-facing evaluation | Invalid affected rollout |
| Reward/cost config unversioned or tuned post hoc on held-out outcomes | Reward claim diagnostic-only or invalid |
| Missing policy config, seed, config hash, or policy artifact version | Diagnostic-only |
| Missing `PolicyUpdateTrace` for update-enabled mutation | Invalid update-enabled A11 evidence |
| Missing transition-to-update trace linkage where applicable | Diagnostic-only or invalid update analysis |
| Mutation during held-out frozen evaluation | Invalid |
| Missing disabled-update/no-mutation audit | Diagnostic-only frozen-evaluation claim |
| Mixed training/adaptation and held-out evaluation curves | Diagnostic-only or invalid |
| Missing strong baselines without claim narrowing | Weakened or diagnostic-only superiority claim |
| Missing `MatchedComparisonReport` | Diagnostic-only comparison |
| Missing metric dictionary entry | Metric diagnostic-only |
| Reward sensitivity or seed instability without limitation tag | Claim-safety failure / diagnostic-only |
| Missing stress profile/schedule for stress-conditioned claim | Stress claim blocked |
| Safety-event alias/linkage unresolved where material | Safety/proxy claim diagnostic-only |
| Missing negative-result note or diagnostic-only flag | Final claim integration blocked |
| Missing Layer 10 source/export lineage | Not dashboard-ready |
| Missing claim-evidence entry or limitation tags | Not thesis-claim-ready |
| Clinical, deployment, real patient safety, rehabilitation, real stimulation-control, or medical-device wording | Forbidden/invalid |

### 18. Open Issues and Requires-Confirmation Items

| Open issue | Status | A11 impact | Required handling |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PolicyUpdateTrace` exact schema/path and shared producer lifecycle | `requires_confirmation` | Update-enabled A11 invalid without trace; exact storage unresolved | Use registry-supported trace fields and manifest mapping until finalized |
| Disabled-update audit exact schema/name/path | `requires_confirmation` | Frozen evaluation needs no-mutation proof | Require disabled-update/no-mutation evidence; preserve naming uncertainty |
| `TransitionRecord.policy_update_trace_id` linkage | `supported_with_lineage_requirement` | Update evidence must link mutation steps to transition/reward context | Require linkage or downgrade update analysis |
| `ReadinessContextRecord` Layer 6/Layer 7 materialization boundary | `unresolved_ownership_nuance` | Simulation-visible variants may be run-specific or adapter outputs | Keep Layer 6 semantic ownership and manifest-map Layer 7 instances |
| `SafetyEventRecord` vs safety-event CSV/log aliases | `unresolved_alias_path_conflict` | Safety/proxy warning summaries may be ambiguous | Use canonical name with storage alias mapping and visible warning |
| `MetricDictionaryEntry` / `MetricDictionary` schema/path | `requires_confirmation` | A11 metrics not thesis-ready without definitions | Require metric dictionary before claims |
| Reward/cost sensitivity grid and downgrade threshold | `requires_confirmation` | Robustness of A11 ranking cannot be finalized | Mark exact grid/threshold as v1.0/final-run item |
| Seed sensitivity and minimum run count | `requires_confirmation` | Stability may be overclaimed | Defer exact final seed count/run count/statistical tests |
| RL algorithm and hyperparameter grid | `requires_confirmation` | v0.1 cannot prescribe final algorithm choices beyond allowed evidence contracts | Treat exact choices as final implementation/run-matrix items |
| Repository paths for RL outputs | `unresolved_path_status` | Artifact discovery may fragment | Use manifest-mapped paths and do not assert unsupported final homes |
| ClaimEvidenceMatrix vs ClaimEvidenceManifest naming | `unresolved_alias_governance` | Phase 15 claim linkage must preserve naming ambiguity | Preserve both names or explicit mapping until final registry resolution |
| Dashboard/export route and ID conventions | `deferred_to_phase14` | A11 can prepare source bundles but not final dashboard routes | Defer exact routes/IDs to Layer 10/Phase 14 |
| Stress pointer/view canonical naming | `requires_confirmation_inherited_from_phase9` | Stress-conditioned A11 may be diagnostic if stress lineage naming unresolved | Preserve candidate status and matched clean/stressed keys |
| Optional embodiment reward terms | `downstream_optional_requires_confirmation` | Core A11 cannot include A13 claims | Defer to Phase 12/13 and Layer 9 records if implemented |

### 19. Handoff to Later Protocol Sections

| Later section / phase | A11 handoff | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| A12 — StressForge stress tests / Phase 9/Layer 8 | Stress-conditioned A11 records, if valid, including stress profile/schedule IDs and clean/stressed matched reports | A12 owns stress-test evaluation; A11 only consumes stress records conditionally |
| A13 — Layer 9 embodiment demo / Phases 12–13 | Optional RL policy/action/reward lineage if embodiment-aware replay is implemented | Layer 9 owns embodiment records; no real-world embodied-control claim |
| Layer 10 / Phase 14 | Dashboard-readable A11 source records, reward traces, update traces, frozen-evaluation reports, matched reports, negative notes, diagnostic flags, controller-card source bundle | Layer 10 renders read-only views, cards, warnings, exports, and reproducibility packages |
| Layer 0 / Phase 15 | Claim-evidence pointers, limitation tags, negative-result notes, diagnostic flags, unresolved issue ledger | Final thesis wording must remain public-data/proxy/simulation-only and bounded by weakest evidence source |
| Full A0–A13 protocol assembly | A11 completion state, open issues, target-conditional exclusions, and next sections | Preserve A11 as evaluation-use metadata, not producer or phase |

### 20. v0.1 Versus v1.0 Boundary for A11

| Item | v0.1 status in this section | v1.0 / final-run status |
|---|---|---|
| Scientific question and comparison structure | Defined | Preserved unless source documents change |
| Required records/artifacts | Defined by source-supported families | Exact paths/schemas finalized where unresolved |
| RL action/reward/simulation contract | Defined at protocol level | Exact field lists, enum values, and validators confirmed |
| RL algorithm families/hyperparameters | Not finalized | `requires_confirmation: true` |
| Reward/cost requirements | Defined | Exact reward weights, sensitivity grid, and downgrade thresholds confirmed |
| Update/frozen separation | Mandatory | Concrete validators and trace/audit schemas finalized |
| Metric families | Defined with metric-dictionary requirement | Exact formulas, denominators, directionality, and dashboard display names confirmed |
| Baselines/comparators | Defined | Missing comparators explicitly documented in final run matrix |
| Matched keys | Defined | Implemented as concrete report schema and validators |
| Statistical tests / run counts / seeds | Not finalized | `requires_confirmation: true` |
| Dashboard routes / figure/table numbers | Not finalized | Phase 14/15 final integration |
| Claim language | Bounded and forbidden classes defined | Final claim-evidence manifest/matrix wording approved by Layer 0 |

### 3. Target Identity and Scientific Purpose

#### 3.1 Official A12 identity

A12 is the StressForge stress-test evaluation context. Its purpose is to test how validated upstream and downstream IHARQ BenchGuard Stretch C components behave under declared, synthetic, reproducible stress profiles. A12 evaluates controlled robustness and fragility; it does not validate real physiology, real rehabilitation, real stimulation, real device safety, or real-world deployment.

A12 is not an implementation phase. The source-supported producer context is Layer 8 in Phase 9, with Phase 0 schema preparation, Phase 1–8 upstream evidence inputs, optional Phase 10–13 downstream policy/embodiment consumers, Phase 14 dashboard/export rendering, and Phase 15 final thesis integration.

#### 3.2 Scientific question

Under public-data, proxy-readiness, and simulation/proxy-only boundaries where applicable, does the IHARQ BenchGuard Stretch C readiness stack maintain better bounded behavior than simpler baselines when exposed to predeclared delay, dropout, noisy-intent, weakness-proxy, drift, fatigue-like, and curated combined-stress profiles, using immutable clean records, versioned stress schedules, matched clean/stressed keys, metric-dictionary-governed metrics, and Layer 0 limitation tags?

#### 3.3 What A12 adds to the cumulative A0–A13 ladder

A12 shifts the protocol from clean-only or ordinary simulation comparison into controlled degradation analysis. It asks not only “which method performs best on clean records?” but also “which method fails, defers, requests evidence, falls back, or becomes unsafe under declared stress, and is that behavior traceable and claim-safe?” Negative results are expected evidence: a robust protocol must expose stress-sensitive failure envelopes rather than hide them.

### 10. Matched-Comparison Key Requirements

A12 clean/stressed comparisons are thesis-ready only when the relevant key envelope is complete. The exact key subset depends on the record family, but the following families must be preserved where applicable:

| Key family | Required keys | Diagnostic-only trigger |
|---|---|---|
| Source identity | `dataset_id`, `subject_id`, `session_id`, `trial_id` where available, `window_id`, `split_id`, `split_role`, `source_record_ids`, `label_map_id`, `preprocessing_id` | Missing source lineage, changed split membership, or unpaired clean source |
| Run/config identity | `run_id`, `clean_run_id`, `stressed_run_id`, `config_hash`, `schema_version`, `producer_layer`, `producer_module`, `phase_id`, `ablation_id`, `validation_status` | Unversioned config, missing run manifest, or ambiguous producer |
| Model/reliability identity | `model_id`, `model_family_id`, `calibration_id`, `threshold_registry_id`, `selective_prediction_id` where applicable | Stress-specific retuning or incomparable operating point |
| IHARQ/RegimeRisk/policy identity | `iharq_decision_id`, `readiness_context_id`, `regime_state_id`, `trust_state_id` where applicable, `policy_id`, `policy_family`, `action_space_version`, `deferral_config_id`, `policy_update_trace_id` where applicable | Policy mutation hidden inside frozen evaluation; future stress outcome leakage |
| Simulation identity | `closed_loop_session_id`, `transition_id`, `episode_id`, `step_id`, `reward_config_id`, `cost_config_id`, `reward_trace_id`, `policy_rollout_id`, `environment_id`, `safety_event_id` where applicable | Missing transition/reward lineage for simulation-stress claim |
| Stress identity | `stress_profile_id`, `stress_schedule_id`, `stress_run_id`, `stress_family`, `stress_intensity`, `stress_target_record_family`, `stress_target_field`, `stress_injection_point`, `stress_seed`, `schedule_hash` | Missing profile/schedule/seed or unregistered stress target |
| Embodiment identity | `embodiment_mode_id`, `embodiment_run_id`, `command_mapping_id`, `demo_manifest_id` where A12.5/A13 bridge is claimed | Missing Layer 9 manifest or unsupported embodiment link |
| Evaluation/reporting identity | `metric_dictionary_id`, `matched_comparison_report_id`, `negative_result_note_id` where applicable, `claim_evidence_manifest_id` or `claim_evidence_matrix_id`, `dashboard_export_id` where exported | Metric or claim not thesis-ready; dashboard view cannot rescue missing source evidence |

If a key is unavailable, A12 must not infer it silently. It must preserve the missingness in the stress validity report, mark the comparison `diagnostic_only` or invalid as appropriate, and include a negative-result or limitation note.

### 12. Split, Leakage, Threshold, Policy, Simulation, Stress, and Embodiment Constraints

| Constraint family | A12 rule | Diagnostic-only or invalid condition |
|---|---|---|
| Clean record immutability | Stress must create derived stressed views/pointers/runs and must not overwrite clean `WindowRecord`, `PredictionRecord`, calibration, IHARQ, RegimeRisk, policy, transition, or embodiment source records | Overwrite or untraceable mutation invalidates affected run |
| Split and test lockout | Stress profiles, intensities, thresholds, policies, and held-out evaluation conditions must be declared without using final test outcomes for tuning | Post-hoc stress selection or retuning downgrades/invalidates claim |
| Calibration/threshold scope | Calibration and threshold selection cannot be silently re-fit on final stressed test labels | Stress-retuned calibration/threshold requires separate declared validation/adaptation context |
| Stress schedule versioning | `StressScheduleRecord` must carry seed, schedule hash, profile ID, active stress state, target record/field, and timing/window/step linkage | Missing schedule seed/hash or irreproducible schedule downgrades comparison |
| Clean/stressed matching | Every robustness comparison must pair clean and stressed runs with matched source/model/policy/config/seed/horizon/metric dictionary keys | Unmatched comparisons are diagnostic-only |
| Policy visibility | Policies may see only declared current/past stress state if the observation schema allows it; future stress outcomes, future rewards, labels, or oracle correctness are forbidden | Future leakage invalidates policy stress claim |
| Frozen/update separation | Held-out frozen evaluation must not mutate policy/model/threshold/calibration/IHARQ/RegimeRisk/stress schedule; update-enabled runs require `PolicyUpdateTrace` and separate reporting | Mixed curves or missing trace downgrades to diagnostic-only |
| Simulation boundary | Transition/reward/safety-event stress claims are simulation-only and require Layer 7 records | Missing Layer 7 records blocks simulation-consequence claim |
| Embodiment boundary | Weakness, endpoint error, safe-hold, and action delay are embodiment-proxy-only and require Layer 9 records | Phase 9 alone cannot support A13 or clinical embodiment claims |
| Dashboard boundary | Layer 10 may filter/visualize/export saved records but cannot invent matched groups, change stress schedules, retune policies, hide failures, or remove limitations | Dashboard-only evidence without source records is invalid for A12 claims |

### 13. Local Sub-Ablation Policy for A12

The architecture source supports local A12 slices. They remain children of A12 and must not become top-level ablation IDs.

| Sub-ablation ID | Parent global ID | Variant definition | Required config difference | Required records | Metric purpose | Claim status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A12.0 | A12 | Clean reference / no-stress condition | Explicit clean marker or no-stress profile | Clean run manifest, metric dictionary, dashboard lineage | Establish baseline for clean/stressed deltas | Required baseline |
| A12.1 | A12 | Single-stressor robustness | One declared family such as delay, dropout, noisy intent, weakness, drift, fatigue-like, or another source-supported single family | Matched `StressProfileRecord`, `StressScheduleRecord`, stressed pointer/view, metrics | Isolate sensitivity by stress family | Thesis-ready only if matched |
| A12.2 | A12 | Combined-stress robustness | Curated combined scenario with component exposure table | Combined profile/schedule, rationale, failure taxonomy | Evaluate multi-stressor envelope | Controlled stress robustness; not full factorial unless declared |
| A12.3 | A12 | Held-out stress generalization | Held-out schedule/profile split where policies learned or selected under stress | Development and held-out stress profiles, update/frozen separation, negative notes | Detect stress overfitting | Required for learned-policy stress claims |
| A12.4 | A12 | Module-under-stress contribution | Stress without IHARQ, without RegimeRisk, threshold-only stress, deferral stress, bandit/RL stress where implemented | Matched module-variant configs and records | Attribute stress benefit/failure to modules | Conditional; missing module records block claim |
| A12.5 | A12 | Stress-to-embodiment bridge | Paired clean/stress Layer 9 links where endpoint/action/weakness evidence is reported | Layer 9 embodiment records, stress schedule, transition/action lineage | Show downstream proxy consequence under stress | Optional/downstream; embodiment-proxy-only |

Additional local stress variants may be introduced only as `A12.x` children with `status: inferred_candidate` and `requires_confirmation: true` unless explicitly supported by future source documents.

### 14. Layer 10 Dashboard, Card, Export, and Reproducibility Obligations

#### 14.1 Required Layer 10-readable A12 inputs

Layer 10 must be able to read the following A12 source artifacts without reverse-engineering hidden logic:

| Input to Layer 10 | Required content | Warning if missing |
|---|---|---|
| `StressProfileRecord` | Profile ID, family, intensity, version, config hash, injection point, affected modules, claim boundary | Missing stress identity or unsupported family |
| `StressScheduleRecord` | Schedule ID, profile ID, stress run ID, per-step/window state, seed, target linkage, schedule hash | Missing seed or irreproducible schedule |
| Stressed pointer/view candidate artifacts | Source clean IDs, target record family/field, pre/post value pointers, stress profile/schedule IDs | Unresolved candidate name without manifest mapping |
| Stress run manifest | Clean/stressed run IDs, configs, seeds, model/policy/env IDs, output paths, limitations | Missing clean run or unmatched run envelope |
| Stress validity report | Guardrail checks, leakage checks, illegal target checks, source-preservation checks | Invalid stress target, source overwrite, leakage |
| Stress metrics and metric dictionary | Metric values plus dictionary IDs and definitions | Dashboard-only metric without dictionary entry |
| Matched stress comparison report | Pairing completeness and failed key list | Missing or failed clean/stressed pairing |
| Negative-result notes and diagnostic-only flags | Weaker, flat, failed, partial, infeasible, or unmatched stress results | Hidden negative result |
| Claim-evidence manifest/matrix entry | Source records, metrics, warnings, limitation tags, claim wording bounds | Missing Layer 0 review input |
| Stress cards/source bundles | Stress purpose, schedule, metrics, failures, limitations, reproducibility paths | Cosmetic card without source lineage |

#### 14.2 Required StressForge views and exports

Layer 10 should render StressForge outputs as read-only derived views, including stress overview tables, stress sensitivity curves, policy-under-stress comparisons, RegimeRisk-under-stress timelines, embodiment stress views only where Layer 9 records exist, failure-taxonomy views, diagnostic-only warning surfaces, stress cards, and reproducibility/export manifests.

Layer 10 must not generate profiles or schedules, alter stress intensities after seeing results, repair pairings silently, retune thresholds or policies, remove negative results, or promote dashboard plots above their source-record limitations.

### 15. Layer 0 Claim-Safety and Limitation Boundaries

| Allowed A12 wording | Required limitation |
|---|---|
| “evaluated under declared synthetic stress profiles” | `synthetic_stress_only`, `stress_conditioned`, `public_eeg_only` where EEG data are used |
| “clean versus stressed behavior changed under delay/dropout/noisy-intent/drift/fatigue-like profiles” | Stress-family-specific, matched comparison, metric dictionary, negative-result visibility |
| “method showed robustness/fragility under controlled stress” | Controlled robustness only; not real-world deployment robustness |
| “RegimeRisk responded to drift/fatigue-like degradation” | Temporal proxy only; no clinical fatigue diagnosis |
| “policy behavior under stress changed in simulated rollout” | `simulation_only`, reward-config disclosed, update/frozen separation preserved |
| “embodiment-proxy outcome changed under stress” | `embodiment_proxy_only`, Layer 9 records required, no real muscle stimulation control |
| “dashboard exposes stress sensitivity and failures” | Dashboard-read/export traceability only; not primary evidence owner |

Forbidden A12 claims include clinical BCI-FES validation, real patient safety, medical-device readiness, real rehabilitation efficacy, real muscle stimulation control, real physiological fatigue or weakness diagnosis, real assistive-control safety, hardware reliability validation, real user adaptation, and deployment readiness. If such wording appears in a table, card, dashboard, thesis paragraph, or figure caption, the result must be corrected or blocked before final claim integration.

### 16. Negative-Result and Baseline-Sufficiency Interpretation

| Result pattern | Correct A12 interpretation | Required handling |
|---|---|---|
| Method degrades under severe or declared-extreme stress | Not automatically a thesis failure; may define a useful failure envelope | Report as stress fragility with limitation and failure taxonomy |
| Method fails under clean or mild stress | Stronger architecture or implementation concern | Attach negative-result note and consider lower-tier claim downgrade |
| IHARQ/RegimeRisk/adaptive policy helps only under certain stress families | Conditional robustness evidence, not universal robustness | Stratify by stress family/intensity and avoid broad claims |
| Threshold-only or ordinary A4 controls match IHARQ under stress | Baseline sufficiency finding; higher-complexity claim weakened | Preserve negative result; do not overclaim IHARQ superiority |
| Learned policy improves development stress but fails held-out stress | Stress overfitting risk | Downgrade learned-policy stress claim; require held-out stress report |
| Stress results improve because method sees future stress outcomes | Leakage, not robustness | Invalidate affected run |
| Combined stress is uninterpretable | Failure-envelope or exploratory evidence only | Use single-stressor baselines and curated rationale; mark diagnostic if needed |
| Missing metric dictionary or matched report | Evidence may be visually useful but not thesis-ready | Mark diagnostic-only until completed |
| Embodiment stress fails or adapter blocks commands | Valid proxy consequence evidence if logged correctly | Do not convert into real safety or clinical claim |

### 17. Diagnostic-Only Downgrade Triggers

| Trigger | A12 status | Required record / note |
|---|---|---|
| Missing or invalid `StressProfileRecord` | Stress claim blocked | Stress validity report, diagnostic-only flag |
| Missing or invalid `StressScheduleRecord` | Clean/stressed reproducibility blocked | Stress validity report, negative-result/limitation note |
| Missing seed or schedule hash | Stochastic or schedule-dependent claim diagnostic-only | Run manifest warning |
| Clean source record overwritten or edited in place | Affected run invalid | Failure note and source-preservation warning |
| Clean/stressed keys unmatched | Comparison diagnostic-only | Matched comparison failure report |
| Unsupported stress family/intensity/target | Run diagnostic-only or invalid depending severity | Stress validity report |
| Stress chosen or tuned after final outcomes | Confirmatory stress claim invalid | Leakage warning and negative-result note |
| Future labels/rewards/stress outcomes visible to policy | Policy stress claim invalid | Leakage audit failure |
| Frozen evaluation mutates policy/model/threshold/stress schedule | Frozen stress claim invalid or diagnostic-only | Update/no-mutation audit |
| Update-enabled stress run lacks `PolicyUpdateTrace` | Adaptive stress claim diagnostic-only | Missing trace note |
| Metric dictionary entry missing | Metric not thesis-ready | Metric-definition gap note |
| Negative result hidden or omitted | Claim-safety gate fails | Negative-result note required |
| Claim-evidence manifest/matrix missing | Final thesis claim blocked | Claim-evidence open issue |
| Layer 10 dashboard output lacks source IDs | Dashboard output diagnostic-only | Export validation warning |
| Required limitation tags missing | Claim blocked until repaired | Layer 0 limitation warning |
| Clinical/deployment/real-safety wording appears | Forbidden claim blocked | Layer 0 claim-safety correction |

### 18. Open Issues and Requires-Confirmation Items

| Issue | Status | A12 impact | Required handling |
|---|---|---|---|
| `StressedRecordPointer` / `StressedRecordView` canonical name | `unresolved_requires_confirmation` | Stress-derived records/views need traceable naming | Preserve candidate status; require source IDs, profile/schedule IDs, and manifest mapping |
| Standalone `TrialRecord` versus trial fields in `WindowRecord` | `schema_conflict / unresolved` | Trial/window matching may affect stress pairing | Use `trial_id` / `window_id` where available; do not require standalone canonical `TrialRecord` unless confirmed |
| `SafetyEventRecord` / safety-event log naming | `unresolved_requires_confirmation` | Stress-induced safety/proxy events may be logged through aliases | Preserve alias status and require manifest mapping |
| Metric dictionary entries for stress metrics | `metric_definition_gap` | Stress metrics are not thesis-ready without definitions | Mark exact metric dictionary enumeration `requires_confirmation: true` |
| Claim-evidence manifest versus matrix naming | `alias_conflict / schema_gap` | Final claim linkage needs stable schema/path | Preserve alias governance; require Phase 15 review |
| Dashboard route/export ID conventions | `requires_confirmation` | Stress dashboard/export lineage may be path-unstable | Mark final routes and IDs deferred |
| Exact stress intensities and run matrix | `requires_confirmation` | v0.1 defines requirements, not final grid | Defer exact v1.0 settings |
| Exact seeds, run counts, statistics, command lines, figures/tables | `requires_confirmation` | No exact final experimental recipe is source-fixed | Defer to v1.0 / implementation-ready protocol |

### 3. Target Identity and Scientific Purpose

#### 3.1 Official A13 identity

A13 evaluates whether readiness, deferral, policy, stress, and embodiment mappings produce interpretable **simulated embodiment consequences** under declared Layer 9 modes. The evaluation is centered on command timelines, safe holds, blocked actions, fallback actions, endpoint-error or replay-outcome summaries where supported, safety-event logs, and demo manifests.

A13 is a simulated consequence layer, not a proof of biological or clinical efficacy. It must remain explicitly bounded to static replay, MyoSuite proxy tasks, OpenSim replay/visualization where available, and declared non-clinical command-mapping assumptions.

#### 3.2 Scientific question

A13 answers the question:

> Under matched public-data lineage, frozen upstream predictions, declared readiness/policy decisions, declared stress context where active, and a declared command-mapping/simulator configuration, how do different readiness gates and policies change simulated command consequences, safety-event burden, delay/hold behavior, and proxy embodiment outcomes?

The question is deliberately narrower than clinical safety, rehabilitation efficacy, or real-time BCI-FES control. A13 asks whether the reliability architecture can be traced into a simulated action-consequence environment without breaking lineage, hiding unsafe actions, or overclaiming real-world embodiment.

#### 3.3 A13 contribution to the full protocol

| A13 role | Required interpretation |
|---|---|
| Simulated consequence test | Shows how readiness decisions affect command/no-command, hold, fallback, unsafe-stop, and endpoint/replay outcomes under a declared proxy mapping. |
| Cross-layer integration check | Verifies that Layer 1–8 records can feed Layer 9 without mutating upstream source, prediction, calibration, IHARQ, regime, policy, or stress records. |
| Stress-conditioned consequence view | When A12 evidence exists, compares clean versus stressed embodiment consequences under matched keys. |
| Dashboard demonstration source | Provides Layer 10-readable embodiment records, cards, timelines, endpoint plots, safety-event tables, manifests, and limitation warnings. |
| Claim-safety boundary | Forces thesis wording to remain simulation/proxy/non-clinical even when visuals or movement-like outputs are produced. |

| `MatchedComparisonReport` / `EmbodimentOutcomeComparisonReport` | Layer-local evaluation exporter / evaluation governance | Stores matched comparator rows and keys for A13 outcome comparisons | Required for comparative A13 claims | Unmatched rows or missing keys make comparison diagnostic-only |
| `NegativeResultNote` | Evaluation / Layer 0-visible artifact | Records null, failed, degraded, simulator failure, or unfavorable outcomes | Required when negative or incomplete results occur | Hidden negative results invalidate thesis-facing claims |
| `DiagnosticOnlyFlag` | Layer 0 / evaluation governance | Marks incomplete, unsupported, unmatched, or diagnostic-only A13 evidence | Required whenever a downgrade trigger is active | Missing downgrade flag risks overclaiming |
| `EmbodimentCard`, dashboard view records, export manifest, reproducibility manifest | Layer 10 / Phase 14–15 | Derived dashboard/card/export/reproducibility outputs | Required for final thesis export if A13 is included | Dashboard-only evidence without source records/manifests is invalid |

---

### 7. Embodiment Mode Ladder and Local A13 Slices

The architecture supports an embodiment maturity ladder. These are local A13 evaluation slices, not new global ablation IDs. They may be named in implementation reports as local mode labels such as `A13.E0` through `A13.E5`, but they must not be promoted to new top-level ablation identifiers outside the official A0–A13 namespace.

| Local mode | Mode name | Required evidence | Evaluation role | Claim status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `A13.E0` | No embodiment / absence manifest | Absence manifest, source limitation, and explanation of why embodiment is disabled | Documents that protocol remains valid without embodiment evidence | No action-consequence claim; A13 not run or not thesis-facing except as absence note |
| `A13.E1` | Static replay / command timeline | Source decisions, command mapping, command/no-command timeline, safety/blocked-event log, replay manifest | Tests mapping and timeline consequences without physics | Replay-only, no musculoskeletal dynamics claim |
| `A13.E2` | MyoSuite simple task | E1 inputs plus MyoSuite task config, simulator seed, state/outcome records, endpoint/reward outputs where enabled | Primary quantitative proxy embodiment demo | Simulation-only MyoSuite proxy; no clinical or real muscle claim |
| `A13.E3` | MyoSuite with declared stress | E2 inputs plus matched StressForge profile/schedule and clean/stressed pairs | Stress-conditioned simulated embodiment consequence | Synthetic stress proxy only; requires A12 linkage |
| `A13.E4` | OpenSim replay/visualization | Selected command timelines, replay/visualization assets, OpenSim or static replay adapter metadata, visualization manifest | Optional qualitative/visual replay or comparison | Non-blocking visualization/replay only; no biomechanics validation claim |
| `A13.E5` | Comparative embodiment report | E0–E4 evidence package, matched comparison report, metric dictionary, negative-result notes, limitation tags | Final A13 comparative packaging | Thesis-facing only if all source manifests, metrics, and claim boundaries validate |

#### 7.1 Mode-selection rule

The final protocol may include the highest validated mode reached, but it must also report lower or skipped modes where their absence affects interpretation. A MyoSuite failure does not invalidate A0–A12. It restricts A13 to E0/E1 or diagnostic-only status unless a valid simulator/outcome package is produced.

---

### 8. Baselines, Comparators, and Matched Evaluation Logic

#### 8.1 Required comparator families

A13 comparisons must be framed as simulated consequence comparisons under matched keys, not as free-standing movement-performance claims.

| Comparator family | A13 interpretation | Required protection |
|---|---|---|
| A0 raw decoder / accept-all command mapping | What happens if raw decoder outputs are mapped to commands without readiness gating? | Must not be described as clinically accepting actions; must include unsafe/wrong-command consequences where measurable |
| A1 calibrated decoder | Whether calibrated confidence changes command outcomes when used by later gating or mapping | Requires calibration lineage and matched prediction/source keys |
| A2 simple registered threshold baseline | Whether registered confidence thresholding reduces wrong/unsafe command burden at a cost to coverage/delay | Requires threshold registry and matched operating point keys |
| A3 uncertainty/selective prediction | Whether uncertainty/selective logic improves command/no-command trade-offs | Requires uncertainty/selective records and matched coverage/cost context |
| A4 ordinary longer-window / voting / averaging controls | Whether ordinary combination controls improve or worsen simulated command outcomes | Must not be credited as IHARQ or readiness policy evidence |
| A5 IHARQ-lite | Whether rule-based evidence verification improves simulated command consequences versus ordinary controls | Requires IHARQ action/reason-code lineage and command mapping |
| A6 evidence-quality estimator | Whether evidence-quality context improves command gating when used in downstream policy | Requires branch/source tags and leakage controls |
| A7 RegimeRisk temporal trust | Whether regime-aware gating reduces high-risk accepted actions, unsafe events, or stress-sensitive failures | Requires regime/trust/stop-loss lineage |
| A8 learning-to-defer | Whether defer/no-action/fallback decisions reduce unsafe/wrong actions and how much delay/burden they add | Requires deferral records, cost context, and explicit treatment of deferred actions |
| A9 supervised Adaptive-IHARQ | Whether supervised policy decisions improve simulated consequence trade-offs under frozen evaluation | Requires policy action records, frozen policy status, and leakage controls |
| A10 contextual bandit | Whether bandit adaptation improves simulated reward/consequence under declared update traces or frozen audits | Requires update trace or disabled-update audit; no silent online adaptation |
| A11 reinforcement-learning policy | Whether RL policy improves simulated reward/consequence under held-out, simulation-only evaluation | Requires frozen/held-out separation, reward config, and safety logs |
| A12 stress-conditioned evidence | Whether stress worsens or changes simulated command/outcome patterns under matched clean/stressed pairs | Requires stress profile/schedule, clean-source immutability, and matched keys |

#### 8.2 Comparison rules

1. A13 comparison rows must use the same source window/trial, split, model, prediction lineage, upstream readiness/policy context, stress context where applicable, command mapping, simulator/replay mode, simulator config, seed, and metric dictionary entry unless the difference is explicitly the factor being tested.
2. Unmatched rows are retained but marked `diagnostic_only` rather than deleted.
3. Deferred, held, fallback, blocked, and unsafe-stop decisions are real simulated outcomes and must not be removed from denominators without a registered metric definition.
4. A13 must never treat dashboard-rendered movement visuals as independent primary evidence. The underlying records and manifests are the evidence.
5. If A13 uses reward, the reward definition must be declared before evaluation and linked to the metric dictionary and reward trace.

---

### 9. Matched-Comparison Key Requirements

A thesis-ready A13 comparison must preserve, at minimum, the following key groups.

| Key group | Required fields or references | Consequence if missing |
|---|---|---|
| Source and protocol keys | dataset ID, subject/session/run IDs, trial/window IDs, split ID, preprocessing ID, label-map ID, source record IDs | Comparison diagnostic-only or blocked |
| Decoder/model keys | model ID, prediction record ID, model-family ID, seed, config hash, raw probability/logit reference where used | Cannot attribute outcomes to matched decoder context |
| Calibration/uncertainty/threshold keys | calibration ID, uncertainty ID, threshold registry ID, selective-prediction ID where applicable | A1/A2/A3-linked A13 comparator restricted or diagnostic-only |
| IHARQ/evidence keys | IHARQ decision ID, action token, reason code, evidence budget, fallback/unsafe/request/wait fields | Readiness-gated A13 claims blocked if absent |
| Regime/trust keys | regime state ID, trust state ID where exported, stop-loss ID, temporal window ID | A7-linked A13 comparator restricted |
| Policy/deferral keys | policy ID, policy version, action record ID, deferral record ID, reward/cost config, frozen/update mode | A8–A11-linked A13 comparator diagnostic-only if absent |
| Simulation/transition keys | transition ID, session ID, timestep/episode ID, environment config, rollout seed | Closed-loop A13 claim blocked if absent |
| Stress keys | stress profile ID, stress schedule ID, clean/stressed pair ID, stress seed, injection point | Stress-conditioned A13 claim blocked if absent |
| Embodiment keys | embodiment mode, command mapping ID, simulator adapter ID, simulator version, task target, initial state, endpoint target, command timeline ID | Quantitative embodiment claim blocked if absent |
| Evaluation/reporting keys | metric dictionary ID, matched-comparison report ID, negative-result note ID where applicable, diagnostic-only flag, dashboard export ID, run ID, config hash | Metric/dashboard/thesis claims diagnostic-only |

---

### 10. Metric Families and Interpretation Rules

Exact final metric IDs, formulas, units, and display names must be registered in `MetricDictionaryEntry` / `MetricDictionary` before v1.0 thesis use. The following A13 metric families are allowed in v0.1 as source-grounded protocol requirements.

| Metric family | Candidate measures | Required interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| Command coverage and burden | command rate, hold/no-command rate, wait/request rate, deferral rate, fallback rate, blocked-command rate | Measures simulated command gating and burden, not clinical usability |
| Unsafe/wrong-action proxy | unsafe-stop rate, wrong-accept-to-command rate where labels support it, high-risk accepted-action rate, safety-event count/rate | Simulation/proxy safety only; cannot be called real patient safety |
| Endpoint/task proxy | endpoint error, target-distance change, command success/failure, task completion proxy, over/under-assist proxy where supported | Valid only under declared MyoSuite/OpenSim/static-replay task assumptions |
| Delay and timing | decision-to-command delay, assistive-action delay, late-assist rate, delayed fallback/no-action burden | Delay is a simulated consequence; not real-time deployment validation |
| Stability and smoothness proxy | command oscillation, repeated fallback/stop, transition instability, smoothness proxy where simulator supports it | Proxy-only; exact formulas require metric dictionary confirmation |
| Reward decomposition | reward total, action cost, unsafe penalty, delay penalty, fallback/no-action penalty, stress penalty where enabled | Requires reward config, reward trace, and frozen/update separation |
| Stress sensitivity | clean/stressed delta, stress-conditioned endpoint degradation, stress-conditioned unsafe/blocked/fallback changes | Requires matched A12 stress records and clean-source immutability |
| Completeness and reproducibility | manifest completeness, missing record rate, schema-validation status, dashboard source-link coverage | Evidence-quality and reproducibility metrics; not performance claims |

#### 10.1 Forbidden A13 metric interpretations

A13 must not report or imply any of the following metric classes:

| Forbidden class | Reason |
|---|---|
| Clinical rehabilitation improvement | No clinical intervention, patient trial, or therapeutic endpoint is present |
| Real patient-safety rate | Layer 9 safety events are simulated/proxy events, not patient-safety events |
| Real BCI-FES control success | The architecture uses public EEG and simulated/replay embodiment, not deployed stimulation |
| Medical-device reliability | The system is not a regulated device validation study |
| Real muscle activation accuracy | MyoSuite/OpenSim/static replay does not validate real muscle stimulation |
| Generalized biomechanics validation | Optional OpenSim replay is not subject-specific biomechanical validation |

---

### 11. Leakage, Mutability, and Frozen/Update Controls

A13 must preserve upstream immutability and frozen/update separation.

| Control | A13 rule |
|---|---|
| Clean-source immutability | Layer 9 must not mutate Layer 1 source records, Layer 2 predictions, Layer 3 calibration/uncertainty records, Layer 4 IHARQ decisions, Layer 5 regime records, Layer 6 policy records, Layer 8 stress records, or Layer 10 summaries. |
| Command mapping registration | The readiness/action-token-to-command mapping must be declared before evaluation. Post hoc remapping to improve endpoint outcomes is not allowed. |
| Label leakage prevention | True labels and outcome/correctness information must not be used to choose commands, update policies, tune thresholds, or select simulator modes during held-out evaluation. |
| Frozen evaluation | Frozen A13 comparisons must verify disabled-update status for policy, command mapping, simulator config, and reward config. |
| Update-enabled evaluation | Any contextual-bandit/RL/policy adaptation that affects A13 must have a `PolicyUpdateTrace`, reward version, source transition, seed, and config hash. |
| Stress separation | StressForge perturbations create stressed views or stressed runs; they do not overwrite clean source records. |
| Dashboard separation | Dashboard views and cards read existing A13 records and manifests; they do not compute hidden source outcomes or repair missing records. |

---

### 12. Layer 10 Dashboard, Card, Export, and Reproducibility Obligations

Layer 10 may display A13 evidence only through source-linked records and manifests.

| Layer 10 output | Required A13 source linkage | Required warning behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Embodiment dashboard page | `EmbodimentStateRecord`, `EmbodimentOutcomeRecord`, command timeline, safety-event log, demo manifest, metric dictionary | Show simulation/proxy-only and non-clinical warnings |
| Command timeline figure | Command mapping ID, source decision/action ID, timestep/session ID, fallback/hold/block status | Mark deferred/held/blocked actions explicitly, not as missing data |
| Endpoint/replay plot | Outcome record ID, simulator/replay mode, task target, simulator config, seed | Mark E1/E4 visual-only modes distinctly from E2/E3 quantitative modes |
| Safety-event table | Safety-event record/log ID, event type, severity, source action, timestep, mode | Warn that safety events are simulated/proxy events |
| Reward decomposition view | Reward trace ID, reward config ID, policy ID, transition/session IDs | Hide or downgrade reward claims if trace/config is missing |
| A13 comparison table | Matched comparison report, metric dictionary IDs, diagnostic-only flags, negative-result notes | Separate matched, unmatched diagnostic-only, failed, skipped, and unsupported rows |
| Embodiment card | Source records, manifest, metric dictionary, limitations, negative results, known missingness | Cannot become a source-free promotional summary |
| Reproducibility export | Run registry, config hashes, source paths, checksums where feasible, environment/simulator versions, command mapping, seeds | Mark conceptual/final path gaps and unresolved registry issues visibly |

Layer 10 must not train models, tune policies, adjust command mappings, change stress schedules, recalculate hidden outcomes, override diagnostic-only flags, or convert A13 into a clinical safety statement.

---

### 13. Layer 0 Claim-Safety Boundaries

#### 13.1 Allowed A13 wording

A thesis-facing A13 claim may say, if supported by records and matched comparisons, that:

- the project evaluated simulated command consequences of readiness-gated low-calibration neural-intent decisions;
- Layer 9 provided a static-replay, MyoSuite, or optional OpenSim proxy demonstration under declared mappings;
- readiness, deferral, policy, stress, or baseline choices changed simulated command burden, endpoint proxy outcomes, delay, fallback, blocked-action, or safety-event proxy rates;
- the A13 evidence is public-data-grounded, offline, simulated, proxy-only, and limited by the declared simulator/replay assumptions.

#### 13.2 Forbidden A13 wording

A13 must not say or imply that:

- the system is clinically safe;
- the system controls real muscles;
- the system validates a medical device;
- the system proves rehabilitation benefit;
- public EEG motor-imagery labels directly validate assistive stimulation;
- MyoSuite/OpenSim replay validates patient-specific biomechanics;
- simulated safety events are real patient-safety events;
- a dashboard visualization proves embodied control.

#### 13.3 Claim downgrade rules

| Issue | Claim consequence |
|---|---|
| Missing source lineage | A13 comparison blocked or diagnostic-only |
| Missing command mapping | No command-consequence claim |
| Missing simulator config / demo manifest | No thesis-ready MyoSuite/OpenSim A13 claim |
| Missing metric dictionary | Metric claims diagnostic-only |
| Missing safety-event log while claiming safety-event rates | Safety-event claims blocked |
| Unmatched clean/stressed keys | Stress-conditioned A13 comparison diagnostic-only |
| Missing `PolicyUpdateTrace` for update-enabled policy | Adaptive/bandit/RL A13 claim diagnostic-only |
| Clinical or real-control wording | Claim blocked by Layer 0 |

---

### 14. Negative-Result and Failure Interpretation

Negative, null, degraded, failed, skipped, or partial A13 results are scientifically meaningful and must be retained.

| Result type | Required interpretation | Required artifact handling |
|---|---|---|
| MyoSuite unavailable or fails | A13 may fall back to E0/E1 or mark MyoSuite as unsupported; A0–A12 remain valid | Record failure in `NegativeResultNote`, demo manifest, and dashboard warning |
| OpenSim unavailable | E4 optional comparison is absent; A13 may still be valid through E1/E2/E3 | Mark OpenSim as optional/missing, not as hidden success |
| Readiness gating increases delay or blocks too many commands | Shows cost/burden trade-off; may weaken policy usefulness but not invalidate protocol | Preserve delay, block, fallback, and no-action metrics |
| Accept-all or simple threshold performs better | Shows ordinary or simple controls may be sufficient under that proxy setting | Report honestly; do not reframe as IHARQ/policy success |
| Stress collapses embodiment outcome | Shows stress sensitivity or limitation under A12/A13 proxy setting | Preserve stress-conditioned negative result and limitation tags |
| RL/bandit unstable | Update-enabled policy evidence is diagnostic or downgraded | Keep trace, reward, and failure diagnostics; do not delete unstable runs |
| Dashboard reveals missing records | Evidence package is incomplete, not dashboard-failed | Keep missingness report and downgrade affected claims |

---

### 15. Diagnostic-Only and Blocking Triggers

A13 evidence must be marked `diagnostic_only`, weakened, or blocked when the following conditions apply.

| Trigger | Required handling |
|---|---|
| Source record, split, trial/window, prediction, decision, transition, or command lineage missing | Block matched A13 comparison or mark diagnostic-only |
| Command mapping absent, ambiguous, or changed after outcome inspection | Block command-consequence claim |
| Simulator/replay mode not declared | Block mode-specific A13 claim |
| `Layer9EmbodimentDemoManifest` missing | Mark all thesis-facing A13 outputs diagnostic-only |
| Metric dictionary entry missing or formula undefined | Mark metric claim diagnostic-only |
| Safety-event event type/severity/source action missing | Block or downgrade safety-event claims |
| Policy update occurred without `PolicyUpdateTrace` | Downgrade adaptive/bandit/RL-conditioned A13 to diagnostic-only |
| Frozen evaluation lacks disabled-update audit | Downgrade frozen policy comparison |
| Clean/stressed pairs unmatched | Downgrade stress-conditioned A13 comparison |
| Dashboard output exists without source records/manifests | Reject dashboard output as primary evidence |
| Simulator tuned on held-out outcomes | Block affected result as leakage-contaminated |
| Clinical/device/real-muscle/patient-safety wording present | Block by Layer 0 claim-safety review |
| Negative results hidden or failed runs omitted from denominators without metric rule | Block or downgrade affected claims |

---

### 16. v0.1 versus v1.0 Boundary for A13

The v0.1 protocol defines the required evaluation logic and evidence contracts. It does not finalize all empirical run details.

| Item | v0.1 status | v1.0 / final-run requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Final dataset/model list | Deferred | Confirm exact datasets, models, and matched lineage before empirical A13 runs |
| MyoSuite task configuration | Requires confirmation | Register task, target, initial state, simulator version, adapter version, and seeds |
| OpenSim replay scope | Optional / requires confirmation | Decide whether E4 is included and define visualization/replay limits |
| Command mapping schema | Requires final confirmation | Register action-token-to-command mapping, hold/fallback/stop behavior, and legality checks |
| Endpoint metrics | Candidate/source-grounded families | Register exact metric dictionary entries, units, denominators, and directionality |
| Reward weights | Requires confirmation if reward is used | Register reward config, trace fields, and update/frozen policy rules |
| Stress-conditioned A13 | Conditional on A12 artifacts | Register clean/stressed pairing and stress injection points |
| Dashboard routes and card layout | Deferred to Layer 10 | Confirm route names, card fields, export filenames, and warnings |
| Thesis tables/figures | Deferred to Phase 15 | Confirm final table/figure numbering and claim-evidence links |
| Statistical tests | Deferred | Register final matched tests, intervals, multiplicity handling, or descriptive-only status |

### 17. Open Issues Carried Forward

| Issue | A13 consequence | Required future handling |
|---|---|---|
| `MC-001` trial-level source representation | Replay and embodiment matching may need trial identity through `WindowRecord` fields rather than standalone `TrialRecord` | Preserve `trial_id` / `parent_trial_id` lineage; avoid promoting standalone `TrialRecord` unless confirmed |
| `MC-008` metric dictionary schema/path gap | A13 metrics cannot become final claims without exact metric dictionary entries | Finalize metric schema/path and A13 metric entries before thesis export |
| `MC-009` repository path/storage-home ambiguity | A13 records can be produced with actual run paths, but conceptual canonical homes must not be overstated | Record actual paths/checksums and mark unresolved conceptual paths where applicable |
| `MC-011` Layer 10 evidence boundary | Dashboard A13 visuals risk being mistaken for source evidence | Enforce read-only dashboard/source-manifest links |
| `MC-012` Layer 0 evidence boundary | Claim audit artifacts may be mistaken for empirical validation | Keep claim-safety audit separate from A13 outcome evidence |
| `ClaimEvidenceMatrix` / `ClaimEvidenceManifest` ambiguity | Final claim trace package may need naming/schema reconciliation | Use existing placeholder wording and preserve ambiguity until resolved |
| Safety-event record/log materialization | Safety-event logs and `SafetyEventRecord` may need schema/path reconciliation | Map logs to source-linked safety records and mark unresolved fields clearly |
| OpenSim optionality | Optional visual/replay results could be over-weighted | Treat E4 as optional and non-blocking unless explicitly included in claims |
| Command mapping exact schema | A13 command-consequence validity depends on a declared mapping | Finalize schema and validator before v1.0 |
