### 3. Purpose and Scientific Question

#### 3.1 Purpose

This section defines how IHARQ BenchGuard Stretch C metrics and comparisons become thesis-usable across A0–A13. It provides a shared rule set for:

1. assigning every metric to a metric family;
2. requiring metric dictionary entries before thesis-facing use;
3. linking metric values to source records, aggregation scope, directionality, limitation tags, and Layer 0 claim boundaries;
4. enforcing matched-comparison discipline before comparative improvement claims;
5. downgrading unmatched, undefined, untraceable, or claim-unsafe outputs to weakened, diagnostic-only, blocked, or invalid status;
6. ensuring Layer 10 dashboards/cards/exports remain read-only derived presentations of saved source/evaluation records.

#### 3.2 Scientific question

> Across the full A0–A13 evaluation ladder, which metric families and matched-comparison keys are required before IHARQ BenchGuard Stretch C may make a bounded, claim-safe thesis statement about baseline reliability, calibration, thresholding, uncertainty, ordinary controls, IHARQ evidence verification, temporal trust, adaptive policy behavior, stress robustness, or simulated embodiment consequences?

#### 3.3 Non-goals

| Non-goal | Handling |
|---|---|
| Finalizing exact v1.0 metric formulas | Deferred unless already source-fixed; each formula must become a `MetricDictionaryEntry` before thesis use |
| Choosing final statistical tests or intervals | `requires_confirmation: true` unless fixed in a later run-matrix document |
| Creating new records or ablation IDs | Forbidden; use canonical records or preserve candidate/unresolved status |
| Allowing dashboards to become primary evidence | Forbidden; Layer 10 outputs must cite source records, metric dictionary entries, configs, seeds, and export lineage |
| Supporting clinical, device, deployment, patient-safety, real FES, or rehabilitation-efficacy claims | Forbidden by Layer 0 |

---

### 4. Architecture Role

| Architecture element | Metric-family role | Matched-comparison role | Boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| Layer 0 — Claim-Safety and Scope Governance | Classifies metric interpretation as supported, weakened, diagnostic-only, optional-only, future-work-only, blocked, forbidden, or invalid | Blocks comparative claims when evidence mode, limitation tag, or matched status is unsafe | Layer 0 audits and governs claims; it is not the primary empirical metric producer |
| Layer 1 — Public-Data and Protocol Anchor | Provides dataset/protocol/split/source-readiness fields and validation summaries | Supplies core source/protocol keys used by all A0–A13 comparisons | Public EEG/protocol evidence only |
| Layer 2 — Decoder Baseline and Ordinary Controls | Produces baseline decoder metrics and A4 ordinary-control records where implemented | Supplies model, prediction, baseline, ensemble, and seed/config keys | Baseline reliability evidence only; no readiness/safety claim |
| Layer 3 — Calibration, Threshold, and Uncertainty | Produces calibration, threshold, uncertainty, selective-prediction, and leakage-readiness artifacts | Supplies calibration, threshold registry, uncertainty feature, and operating-point keys | Reliability/selective-prediction evidence only |
| Layer 4 — IHARQ Evidence Verification | Produces decision/action-token, reason-code, evidence-request, fallback, uncertainty/unsafe decision, and A5/A6/A7-relevant evidence records | Supplies IHARQ config, decision-record, reason-code, evidence-quality, and matched decision keys | Evidence-verification/readiness-proxy only |
| Layer 5 — RegimeRisk | Produces temporal regime/trust/risk records where implemented | Supplies regime config, timeline, transition, trust-state, and temporal matching keys | Temporal trust/proxy degradation evidence, not clinical fatigue diagnosis |
| Layer 6 — Adaptive-IHARQ Policy | Produces readiness context, policy action, learned evidence-quality / supervised Adaptive-IHARQ records, and Layer-6 policy artifacts; architecture-level deferral routes are separated in the execution plan as Phase 7 learning-to-defer evidence | Supplies policy ID/config/cost/reward/update/frozen-mode keys and handoff context for deferral/simulation | Proxy/simulation policy evidence only |
| Layer 7 — Closed-Loop Simulation | Produces transitions, rewards, episodes, rollouts, safety-event proxies, and update traces where implemented | Supplies simulator, transition, episode, reward, horizon, seed, and frozen/update keys | Simulation-only evidence |
| Layer 8 — StressForge | Produces stress profile/schedule/run records and stress-conditioned evaluation outcomes | Supplies clean/stressed pairing, stress profile/schedule, intensity, seed, and stress split keys | Controlled stress robustness only, not physiological validation |
| Layer 9 — MyoSuite/OpenSim/static-replay Embodiment | Produces embodiment state/outcome/demo/command/safety-event proxy artifacts where implemented | Supplies embodiment mode, command mapping, simulator config, demo manifest, and safety-event keys | Simulated embodiment-proxy only |
| Layer 10 — Dashboard, Cards, and Reproducibility | Reads, validates, summarizes, cards, visualizes, exports, warns, and packages metrics | Exposes matched-comparison status, missing-key warnings, export lineage, and reproducibility manifests | Derived/read-only reporting; not hidden empirical computation |

---

### 5. Registry Role and Canonical Artifact Requirements

| Canonical artifact / record | Role in metric governance | Role in matched comparison | Producer / owner status | Protocol status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MetricDictionaryEntry` / `MetricDictionary` | Required definition object for every thesis-facing metric: name, family, formula, direction, units, required fields, aggregation unit, split role, A-context, diagnostic-only rule, and claim boundary | Provides `metric_dictionary_id` required in every matched comparison that reports metrics | Evaluation/configuration scripts; exact schema/path unresolved | Required; `MC-008` remains open |
| `MatchedComparisonReport` | Records whether comparison is fully matched, partially matched, unmatched diagnostic, invalid, or not applicable | Stores matched source-record IDs, key envelope, missing-key warnings, diagnostic-only downgrade status, and metric references | Evaluation scripts and Layer 10 exports as derived/reporting artifacts | Required for thesis-facing comparative claims |
| `EvaluationOutcomeRecord` | Stores layer-local or cross-layer metric outputs with source records, metric dictionary IDs, diagnostic flags, negative-result notes, and claim pointers | Carries `matched_comparison_key` and comparison IDs | Produced by layer-local evaluation exporters | Required where empirical evaluation exists |
| `ExperimentSummaryRecord` | Aggregates experiment identity, evaluated layer/slice, ablation step, matched group, metric references, and diagnostic status | Summarizes match status across groups | Evaluation scripts; consumed by Layer 10 | Required for aggregate reporting |
| `AblationComparisonTable` | Presents A0–A13 comparisons with metric IDs and status | Must be backed by `MatchedComparisonReport` rows | Evaluation/reporting artifact | Required for thesis-facing ablation tables |
| `DiagnosticOnlyFlag` | Marks metrics/results that cannot support thesis claims | Required when keys, metrics, source records, validation, or claim boundaries are incomplete | Evaluation/claim-safety governance artifact | Required fail-closed mechanism |
| `NegativeResultNote` | Preserves non-improvement, simpler-baseline sufficiency, failures, skipped runs, and diagnostic outcomes | Must link to affected comparison where relevant | Evaluation scripts, producing layers, Layer 10, or final reporting | Required when a metric/comparison fails, underperforms, or is non-thesis-ready |
| `ClaimEvidenceMatrix` / `ClaimEvidenceManifest` | Links claims to metrics, source records, limitations, and dashboard/card/export lineage | Requires matched-comparison status for improvement claims | Layer 0/final reporting; naming/schema ambiguity remains | Required; `CL-L01-002` remains open |
| `DashboardMetricRecord` | Dashboard-ready metric bridge with source links, metric dictionary references, diagnostic status, warning flags, and export references | Displays matched comparison and filter state but does not create primary evidence | Layer 10 derived record | Required for dashboard metric display; `MC-007` and `MC-011` boundaries preserved |
| `DashboardViewRecord`, `CardRecord`, `ReproducibilityManifest`, `ReproducibilityPackage` | Derived presentation/export/reproducibility artifacts | Must retain matched keys, source links, configs, seeds, and warning status | Layer 10 | Required for thesis-ready dashboard/export use |

---

### 6. Execution/Evidence-Plan Role and Phase Relationship

| Phase | Metric-family responsibility | Matched-comparison responsibility | Status in this protocol-wide section |
|---|---|---|---|
| Phase 0 | Prepares schemas, validators, mock fixtures, metric dictionary templates, matched-comparison templates, diagnostic-only flags, negative-result templates, claim-evidence placeholders, run/seed/config conventions | Defines and validates the inherited matched-key envelope in fixtures | Required foundation; no real empirical metric production |
| Phase 1 | Produces public-data/protocol records, source identifiers, validation reports, Layer 1 manifest, and ablation-readiness artifact | Supplies source/protocol keys and readiness warnings for downstream matching | Required upstream source-readiness gate |
| Phase 2 | Produces baseline decoder predictions/metrics and ordinary-control records where implemented | Produces A0/A4 source/evaluation records and comparison keys | Required for A0 and A4 metric families |
| Phase 3 | Produces calibration, threshold, uncertainty, selective-prediction, reliability, and leakage artifacts | Produces A1/A2/A3 matched operating-point keys | Required for A1–A3 metric families |
| Phase 4 | Produces IHARQ-lite decision/evidence-verification records | Produces A5 decision/evidence matching fields | Required for A5 metric families |
| Phase 5 | Produces RegimeRisk temporal records where implemented | Produces A7 temporal trust/regime matching fields | Required for A7 where implemented |
| Phase 6 | Produces learned evidence-quality, readiness context, supervised Adaptive-IHARQ policy/action artifacts, pseudo-label/target-construction lineage, action-space and cost-configuration evidence; it must not pre-create Phase 7 `DeferralRecord` outputs | Produces A6/A9 policy and feature-lineage keys; hands off context for A8 | Required for A6/A9 where implemented; A8 deferral outputs remain Phase 7-owned |
| Phase 7 | Produces learning-to-defer records, deferral targets, fallback-source metadata, direct-versus-defer cost/burden evidence, and validated `DeferralRecord` outputs where implemented | Produces A8 deferral matching fields while consuming Phase 6 context/action/cost lineage; preserves policy/source matching before simulation | Required for A8 where implemented and for downstream Phase 8 simulation inputs |
| Phase 8 | Produces closed-loop simulation transitions, episodes, rollouts, reward traces, and safety-event proxies where implemented | Produces A10/A11 simulation matching fields | Required for A10/A11 where implemented |
| Phase 9 | Produces StressForge profiles/schedules and stress-conditioned evaluation evidence | Produces A12 clean/stressed matching fields | Required for A12 where implemented |
| Phase 10 | Produces contextual-bandit simulation/update evidence where implemented | Requires `PolicyUpdateTrace`, reward/cost config, and frozen/update separation | Required for A10 where implemented |
| Phase 11 | Produces RL simulation/update evidence where implemented | Requires transition/reward/episode matching and frozen held-out rollout separation | Required for A11 where implemented |
| Phase 12 | Produces Layer 9 embodiment prototype/static-replay artifacts where implemented | Produces embodiment mode, command mapping, simulator config, and demo-manifest keys | Required for A13 where implemented |
| Phase 13 | Produces optional OpenSim or extended embodiment/replay evidence where implemented | Preserves embodiment matching and simulator configuration lineage | Conditional / optional; exact scope requires confirmation |
| Phase 14 | Produces Layer 10 dashboard, cards, figures/tables, exports, warnings, and reproducibility package | Exposes match status, missing keys, diagnostic flags, and export lineage | Required derived/read-only presentation phase |
| Phase 15 | Integrates final thesis evidence, claim-evidence matrix/manifest, limitations, and final protocol handoff | Uses matched status to allow, weaken, diagnose, block, or invalidate claims | Required final integration phase |

### 7. Affected A0–A13 Contexts and Metric-Family Map

A0–A13 remain global evaluation-use identifiers, not implementation phases and not artifact producers. The following map defines which metric families are permitted for each context in v0.1. Exact formulas and final display names require `MetricDictionaryEntry` confirmation before thesis-facing use.

| A-context | Correct identity | Primary metric families | Key required records | Claim boundary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A0 | Raw decoder / accept-all raw decoder reference | Baseline decoder performance, confusion lineage, low-label/budget sensitivity, seed/CI summaries, failure/skipped-run transparency | `PredictionRecord`, `ModelRegistryRecord`, `BaselineMetricRecord`, `LowCalibrationCurveRecord`, `SubjectProfileRecord`, `FailureCaseIndex`, Layer 1 source records | Public EEG decoder-baseline reliability only |
| A1 | Calibrated decoder / calibration visibility | ECE-style calibration error, Brier, NLL, reliability diagrams, confidence histograms, high-confidence wrong visibility, raw-vs-calibrated deltas | `CalibrationRecord`, `ReliabilityAuditReport`, `CalibrationDashboardMetricRecord`, `HighConfidenceWrongTable`, A0 source records | Probability reliability visibility only |
| A2 | Simple registered threshold / confidence-threshold baseline | Coverage at registered threshold, accepted/retained accuracy or error, rejection/no-decision rate, threshold burden, high-confidence wrong after threshold | `ThresholdRegistryRecord`, `SelectivePredictionRecord` where used, `CalibrationRecord` if calibrated confidence is used | Simple threshold baseline only; not uncertainty/selective-prediction identity |
| A3 | Uncertainty and selective prediction | Risk-coverage, retained accuracy/error, uncertainty score behavior, entropy/margin summaries, rejection/coverage tradeoff, selective high-confidence wrong rate | `UncertaintyRecord`, `SelectivePredictionRecord`, `ThresholdRegistryRecord`, `Layer3MatchedOperatingPointTable` | Uncertainty/selective-prediction reliability evidence only |
| A4 | Longer-window, multi-window voting/averaging, and ordinary ensemble controls | Majority-vote/probability-average performance, window aggregation effects, model-family ensemble effects, disagreement, delay burden, ordinary-control sufficiency | `EnsembleControlRecord`, `PredictionRecord`, `BaselineMetricRecord`, `ModelRegistryRecord` | Ordinary comparison-control evidence only |
| A5 | IHARQ-lite / rule-based evidence verification | Accepted accuracy, wrong-accept rate, evidence-request burden, wait/fallback/uncertain/unsafe rates, reason-code distribution, evidence-combine behavior | `IHARQDecisionRecord`, `IHARQAblationRecord`, `IHARQTraceRecord`, `EvidenceQualityRecord` where rule features are present | Rule-based evidence-verification / readiness-proxy evidence only |
| A6 | IHARQ plus evidence-quality estimator | Evidence-quality score calibration/utility, estimator contribution, feature legality, wrong-accept or burden deltas against A5 | `EvidenceQualityRecord`, `IHARQDecisionRecord`, `EvaluationOutcomeRecord`, estimator config | Evidence-quality estimator evidence only; producer/variant status must be visible |
| A7 | IHARQ plus RegimeRisk temporal trust | Regime-risk score behavior, trust-state transitions, temporal stability, stop-loss activation, recovery markers, regime-aware vs regime-unaware deltas | `RegimeStateRecord`, `TrustStateRecord`, `regime_timelines.csv`, `IHARQDecisionRecord` | Temporal trust/proxy degradation evidence only; not clinical fatigue diagnosis |
| A8 | Learning-to-defer / deferral comparison | Deferral rate, routing/action distribution, cost/utility, burden, wrong-accept change, fallback/no-action behavior | `DeferralRecord`, `PolicyActionRecord`, `ReadinessContextRecord`, cost config | Proxy deferral-policy evidence only |
| A9 | Supervised Adaptive-IHARQ / adaptive readiness policy | Proxy policy accuracy, cost-sensitive utility, action distribution, class imbalance, pseudo-label quality, coverage/burden/wrong-accept deltas | `PolicyActionRecord`, `ReadinessContextRecord`, pseudo-label manifest, cost config, `EvidenceQualityRecord` where used | Supervised proxy-policy evidence only |
| A10 | Contextual bandit | Immediate reward/cost, regret where defined, exploration/update diagnostics, action switching, unsafe proxy events, seed sensitivity, frozen evaluation performance | `PolicyUpdateTrace`, `PolicyActionRecord`, `TransitionRecord`, `RewardTraceRecord`, `ClosedLoopSessionRecord` | Simulation-bounded immediate-reward policy evidence only |
| A11 | Reinforcement-learning policy | Sequential return, delayed reward/cost, rollout success, transition stability, held-out episode performance, unsafe proxy events, update/frozen separation | `PolicyUpdateTrace`, `TransitionRecord`, `EpisodeSummaryRecord`, `RewardTraceRecord`, `ClosedLoopSessionRecord` | Simulation-bounded sequential-policy evidence only |
| A12 | StressForge stress tests / controlled stress robustness | Stress exposure, clean/stressed degradation, robustness drop, stress sensitivity, stress-conditioned readiness/policy/embodiment effects, failure taxonomy | `StressProfileRecord`, `StressScheduleRecord`, stress run manifest, `EvaluationOutcomeRecord`, source records for stressed module | Controlled stress robustness only, not real physiological validation |
| A13 | Layer 9 MyoSuite/OpenSim/static-replay embodiment demo / simulated embodiment consequence | Command coverage/burden, endpoint/task proxy, unsafe/wrong-action proxy, delay/timing, smoothness/stability proxy, reward terms where enabled, stress-conditioned embodiment outcomes, demo completeness | `EmbodimentStateRecord`, `EmbodimentOutcomeRecord`, `Layer9EmbodimentDemoManifest`, command mapping, simulator config, `SafetyEventRecord` / safety-event log | Simulated embodiment-proxy only, not real BCI-FES or rehabilitation evidence |

### 8. Protocol-Wide Metric-Family Rules

#### 8.1 Required metric dictionary fields

Every thesis-facing metric must have a metric dictionary entry before it can support a supported or weakened claim. A valid v1.0-ready entry must include at least:

| Field | Required rule |
|---|---|
| `metric_dictionary_id` | Stable ID referenced by evaluation records, matched reports, dashboard records, cards, exports, and claim-evidence rows |
| `metric_name` | Human-readable name that does not imply forbidden clinical/device/deployment claims |
| `metric_family` | One of the protocol-approved families or a confirmed later extension |
| `definition` | Formula or algorithm; exact formula may be `requires_confirmation` in v0.1 but must be fixed before thesis use |
| `directionality` | Higher-is-better, lower-is-better, target-range, descriptive-only, or not-applicable |
| `units` | Required where numeric units exist; use `unitless` or `count/rate` when applicable |
| `required_source_fields` | Source records and fields required to compute the metric |
| `aggregation_unit` | Dataset, subject, session, trial, window, episode, stress profile, embodiment run, card/export, or another confirmed unit |
| `split_role` | Training/calibration/validation/test/held-out simulation/stress split role where applicable |
| `ablation_scope` | A0–A13 global ID and local sub-ablation ID where applicable |
| `matched_comparison_requirement` | Full/partial/not-applicable key requirements |
| `diagnostic_only_downgrade_rule` | Concrete missingness or leakage condition that downgrades the metric |
| `claim_boundary` | Allowed claim class, limitation label, and forbidden wording class |
| `layer_10_display_rule` | Whether Layer 10 may display/export it and what warning appears if incomplete |
| `layer_0_review_rule` | Claim-safety review required before thesis use |

#### 8.2 Approved metric families and status

| Metric family | Applicable A-contexts | Required source basis | Metric status in v0.1 | Forbidden interpretation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Source/protocol completeness | A0–A13 | Layer 1 records, validation reports, manifests, readiness artifacts | Source-supported family; exact completeness scoring requires dictionary entry | Do not treat completeness as performance improvement |
| Baseline decoder performance | A0, A4 context | `PredictionRecord`, `BaselineMetricRecord`, `ModelRegistryRecord`, Layer 1 keys | Source-supported family; exact metrics require dictionary entries | No readiness, safety, or clinical validity claim |
| Calibration/probability quality | A1, A2/A3 context where calibrated confidence is consumed | `CalibrationRecord`, `ReliabilityAuditReport`, bin tables, source predictions | Source-supported family; exact binning/statistics require confirmation | No safety or treatment claim |
| Threshold/operating-point behavior | A2, A3 context | `ThresholdRegistryRecord`, `SelectivePredictionRecord`, calibration/uncertainty records where applicable | Source-supported family; threshold selection must be split-safe | Do not merge A2 thresholding with A3 uncertainty identity |
| Uncertainty/selective-prediction behavior | A3 | `UncertaintyRecord`, `SelectivePredictionRecord`, matched operating-point table | Source-supported family; curve definitions require confirmation | No clinical abstention/safety guarantee |
| Ordinary combination/control behavior | A4 | `EnsembleControlRecord`, prediction/model records, delay-burden fields | Source-supported family; aggregation and delay formulas require confirmation | Do not represent ordinary controls as IHARQ evidence |
| IHARQ readiness/evidence-verification behavior | A5–A7, A12/A13 context | `IHARQDecisionRecord`, `IHARQAblationRecord`, `IHARQTraceRecord`, evidence-quality/regime records where applicable | Source-supported family; exact denominators require dictionary entries | No real patient-safety or real-time deployment claim |
| Evidence-quality estimator behavior | A6, A9 context | `EvidenceQualityRecord`, estimator config, source decision records | Source-supported where branch lineage exists; `MC-002` preserved | No oracle-quality or real readiness-label claim |
| Temporal trust / RegimeRisk behavior | A7, A12 context | `RegimeStateRecord`, `TrustStateRecord`, regime timelines, temporal source IDs | Source-supported where implemented; exact trust formulas require confirmation | No clinical fatigue diagnosis |
| Learning-to-defer behavior | A8 | `DeferralRecord`, `PolicyActionRecord`, `ReadinessContextRecord`, deferral targets, fallback-source metadata, direct-versus-defer cost configuration | Source-supported where Phase 7 is implemented; exact cost and deferral-target definitions require confirmation | No real expert fallback, real online controller, or clinical routing claim |
| Supervised Adaptive-IHARQ policy behavior | A9 | `PolicyActionRecord`, `ReadinessContextRecord`, pseudo-label/target-construction manifest, cost configuration, `EvidenceQualityRecord` where used | Source-supported where Phase 6 supervised policy evidence exists; exact pseudo-label and class-imbalance metrics require confirmation | No real online controller, patient-readiness, or deployment-safety claim |
| Simulation policy-learning behavior | A10, A11, A12/A13 context | `TransitionRecord`, `ClosedLoopSessionRecord`, `RewardTraceRecord`, `PolicyUpdateTrace`, episode summaries | Simulation-supported; exact reward/regret formulas require confirmation | No deployed adaptive controller or medical-device readiness claim |
| Stress robustness behavior | A12 and stressed variants of A0–A13 | `StressProfileRecord`, `StressScheduleRecord`, stress run manifest, source/evaluation records | Source-supported controlled-stress family; exact intensities deferred | No real-world robustness or physiological validation claim |
| Embodiment-proxy behavior | A13 | `EmbodimentStateRecord`, `EmbodimentOutcomeRecord`, demo manifest, command mapping, simulator config, safety-event proxy logs | Simulation/proxy-supported; exact MyoSuite/OpenSim configuration deferred | No real muscle stimulation, rehabilitation, patient-safety, or clinical control claim |
| Dashboard/export/reproducibility completeness | A0–A13 | `DashboardMetricRecord`, `DashboardViewRecord`, `CardRecord`, `ReproducibilityManifest`, export logs | Required reporting family; derived/read-only | Do not treat dashboard generation as primary empirical evidence |
| Claim-safety and limitation coverage | A0–A13 | `ClaimEvidenceMatrix` / manifest, limitation tags, negative-result notes | Required governance family; exact schema unresolved | Do not convert claim-audit pass into empirical validation |

#### 8.3 Metric readiness states

| Metric readiness state | Meaning | Claim consequence |
|---|---|---|
| `metric_dictionary_confirmed` | Metric has source records, formula, directionality, aggregation, matched requirements, limitation tags, and claim boundary | May support bounded claims if matched comparison and Layer 0 review also pass |
| `metric_dictionary_required` | Metric family is source-supported, but exact dictionary entry is not finalized | Diagnostic or provisional until confirmed |
| `inferred_candidate` | Metric is scientifically plausible but not registry/framework-confirmed as official | Diagnostic-only unless later confirmed |
| `dashboard_derived_only` | Metric is a Layer 10 presentation/summary of saved source records | Usable for visibility/export, not primary evidence |
| `not_applicable` | Metric family does not belong to this A-context | Must not be forced into local section |
| `forbidden_metric_class` | Metric name or interpretation implies clinical/device/deployment/patient-safety/rehabilitation/real-control claim | Blocked/invalid |

#### 8.4 Forbidden metric classes

The following metric classes are blocked across the whole protocol, even if values can be computed from proxy data:

| Forbidden class | Prohibited interpretation |
|---|---|
| Clinical BCI-FES validation | Any metric implying validated clinical use of EEG-to-FES or BCI-FES control |
| Real patient safety | Any rate/score claiming real patient-safe behavior |
| Medical-device readiness | Any score implying regulatory, device, or deployment readiness |
| Real rehabilitation efficacy | Any outcome implying therapy success, motor recovery, or treatment effectiveness |
| Real-time deployment safety | Any metric implying deployed real-time safety guarantees |
| Real muscle stimulation control | Any metric implying actual FES stimulation correctness or muscle-safety validation |
| Clinical fatigue diagnosis | Any RegimeRisk/stress metric interpreted as clinical fatigue diagnosis |
| Real-world embodied control validation | Any MyoSuite/OpenSim/static-replay metric interpreted as real assistive-device or biomechanics validation |

Allowed replacements must use bounded language such as `public-data reliability behavior`, `proxy readiness evidence`, `controlled stress robustness`, `simulation-only policy behavior`, `simulated embodiment-proxy outcome`, `dashboard traceability`, or `diagnostic-only result`.

### 9. Protocol-Wide Matched-Comparison Discipline

#### 9.1 Comparison status vocabulary

| Status | Definition | Thesis consequence |
|---|---|---|
| `fully_matched` | All required keys for the comparison context are present, equal where required, or explicitly justified as not applicable; metrics have dictionary entries; source records validate; claim boundaries are present | May support bounded comparative claims after Layer 0 review |
| `partially_matched` | Some keys are missing, lower-granularity, or not exactly comparable, but the limitation is explicit and does not invalidate the comparison | Weakened or diagnostic-only depending on missing key severity |
| `unmatched_diagnostic` | Key mismatch or missingness prevents fair improvement/sufficiency comparison, but values are still useful for debugging or qualitative analysis | Diagnostic-only; no comparative claim |
| `invalid` | Leakage, future/outcome leakage, source mutation, test-tuned operating point, hidden update contamination, missing split validity, or forbidden claim interpretation | Invalid/blocked; must not support thesis claims |
| `not_applicable` | Key family genuinely does not apply to a given A-context, and the reason is recorded | May proceed if all applicable keys pass |

#### 9.2 Required matched-key envelope

Every comparison must record the following metadata, marking each key as required, not applicable, missing, candidate, or confirmation-dependent.

| Key family | Required keys | Applies to | Diagnostic-only / invalid trigger |
|---|---|---|---|
| Source/protocol keys | `dataset_id`, `subject_id`, `session_id`, `run_id`, `trial_id`, `window_id`, `split_id`, `split_role`, `preprocessing_id`, `label_map_id`, `label_budget_id`, `artifact_flag_id`, protocol version | A0–A13 | Missing source lineage or split identity downgrades to diagnostic-only; leakage invalidates |
| Model/decoder keys | `model_id`, `decoder_id`, `model_family_id`, checkpoint/artifact ID, `score_type`, `class_order`, seed, config hash | A0–A13 where predictions are consumed | Unmatched model/score schema blocks direct performance comparison unless declared as model-family comparison |
| Calibration keys | `calibration_id`, calibration method/config, calibration split, calibration budget | A1–A3 and downstream consumers of calibrated confidence | Missing calibration lineage makes calibration-dependent comparisons diagnostic-only |
| Threshold/operating-point keys | `threshold_registry_id`, threshold selection split, operating-point rule, coverage/cost target where applicable | A2–A5, A8–A13 where thresholded behavior is compared | Test-selected or undocumented threshold invalidates threshold claims |
| Uncertainty/selective keys | uncertainty feature ID, selective rule ID, risk/coverage target, retained/rejected scope | A3 and downstream uncertainty-aware comparisons | Missing uncertainty provenance downgrades A3/selective claims |
| Ordinary-control keys | aggregation rule, window length, multi-window rule, vote/average rule, ensemble membership, delay-burden definition | A4 and IHARQ/control comparisons | Unmatched delay or aggregation rule makes A4 comparisons diagnostic-only |
| IHARQ/evidence keys | `iharq_config_id`, decision-record ID, action-token vocabulary version, reason-code version, evidence request/combine/fallback config, unsafe/uncertain rule config | A5–A7, A12/A13 where IHARQ gates behavior | Missing decision lineage or unmapped action aliases downgrades or invalidates |
| Evidence-quality keys | estimator ID/config, feature set, target construction, branch/variant tag, producer module/phase | A6, A9, downstream policy contexts | Missing branch/producer lineage triggers `MC-002` diagnostic-only risk |
| Regime/trust keys | `regime_config_id`, regime timeline ID, trust-state ID, temporal window/horizon, stop-loss config | A7, A12/A13 temporal contexts | Unmatched temporal horizon or missing source timeline downgrades temporal comparison |
| Deferral/supervised-policy keys | `policy_id`, `policy_config_id`, `readiness_context_id`, pseudo-label or deferral-target manifest, cost config, action-space version, fallback-source metadata where deferral is active | A8–A11 | Missing policy/cost/pseudo-label/deferral-target provenance blocks supervised or deferral policy claims |
| Simulation/update keys | simulator/environment ID, `transition_id`, episode/session ID, reward config, `policy_update_trace_id`, frozen/update mode, horizon, seed | A10–A11 and simulation contexts in A12/A13 | Hidden updates or absent disabled-update audit invalidates frozen-evaluation claims |
| Stress keys | `stress_profile_id`, `stress_schedule_id`, stress intensity/config hash, clean/stressed pair ID, stress seed, target record/field | A12 and stress-conditioned variants | Unmatched clean/stressed pairs or post-hoc stress selection downgrades or invalidates |
| Embodiment keys | `embodiment_mode_id`, command mapping ID, simulator config/version, demo manifest ID, safety-event log ID, optional OpenSim/MyoSuite config | A13 | Missing command mapping or simulator lineage blocks embodiment-proxy claims |
| Metric/reporting keys | `metric_dictionary_id`, `matched_comparison_id`, `evaluation_outcome_id`, `negative_result_note_id`, `diagnostic_only_flag`, `claim_evidence_id` | A0–A13 | Missing metric dictionary or matched report blocks thesis-facing metric/comparison claims |
| Dashboard/export keys | dashboard metric/view/card/export ID, reproducibility manifest ID, artifact manifest ID, figure/table lineage, warning status | A0–A13 in Layer 10 outputs | Missing source links make dashboard/card/export diagnostic-only |

#### 9.3 Minimum comparison metadata schema

Every comparison row or report must be representable by the following conceptual schema. Exact storage path and field-level schema remain v1.0 / registry-confirmation items where unresolved.

```yaml
comparison_id: ""
comparison_status: "fully_matched | partially_matched | unmatched_diagnostic | invalid | not_applicable"
source_ablation_id: "A0-A13 or local child ID where applicable"
target_ablation_id: "A0-A13 or local child ID where applicable"
source_records: []
target_records: []
dataset_id: ""
subject_session_scope: ""
trial_or_window_scope: ""
split_id: ""
split_role: ""
preprocessing_id: ""
label_map_id: ""
model_id_or_family: ""
seed_policy: ""
config_hash: ""
calibration_id: "required_if_applicable"
threshold_registry_id: "required_if_applicable"
iharq_config_id: "required_if_applicable"
regime_config_id: "required_if_applicable"
policy_config_id: "required_if_applicable"
reward_config_id: "required_if_applicable"
policy_update_trace_id: "required_if_applicable"
stress_profile_id: "required_if_applicable"
stress_schedule_id: "required_if_applicable"
embodiment_mode_id: "required_if_applicable"
command_mapping_id: "required_if_applicable"
metric_dictionary_id: ""
matched_comparison_id: ""
negative_result_note_id: "required_if_negative_or_failed"
diagnostic_only: false
missing_key_warnings: []
claim_safety_tags: []
layer_10_export_lineage: []
layer_0_claim_boundary: ""
```

#### 9.4 Matched comparison by A-context

| Comparison context | Minimum fully matched requirement | Partial/diagnostic examples |
|---|---|---|
| A0 raw decoder comparisons | Same dataset/split/preprocessing/label map/model-family policy/seed policy/metric dictionary; failed/skipped runs visible | Comparing different split roles or hidden model selection is diagnostic/invalid depending on leakage |
| A0 vs A1 | Same A0 source predictions plus legal calibration split and calibration ID | Missing calibration split or post-hoc calibration method selection downgrades/invalidates |
| A2 threshold comparisons | Same source predictions/calibration scope plus registered threshold ID and selection split | Threshold chosen on final test invalidates |
| A3 uncertainty/selective comparisons | Same source/calibration/uncertainty feature IDs plus matched coverage/cost/risk target where applicable | Different coverage targets without matched-cost/coverage framing are diagnostic only |
| A4 ordinary controls | Same source/model family policy plus aggregation/vote/window/ensemble/delay-burden definitions | Unmatched delay burden or model family membership weakens or downgrades |
| A5 IHARQ-lite vs A0–A4 | Same source records and matched operating point/cost/coverage where applicable; IHARQ config, action-token vocabulary, reason-code version | Missing reason-code/action-token mapping or unmatched cost makes improvement claims diagnostic-only |
| A6 estimator vs A5 | Same IHARQ base and source records; estimator features/target construction/producer variant visible | Missing `EvidenceQualityRecord` branch/producer lineage preserves `MC-002` risk and downgrades |
| A7 regime-aware vs regime-unaware | Same source/decision/policy context plus temporal horizon, regime config, trust timeline, stop-loss config | Unmatched temporal windows or regime labels are diagnostic only |
| A8 deferral comparisons | Same source/policy context plus deferral action space and cost function | Missing cost config blocks utility comparisons |
| A9 supervised policy vs baselines | Same readiness context, pseudo-label/cost manifest, source splits, and policy config | Pseudo-label leakage invalidates; missing pseudo-label manifest downgrades |
| A10 bandit | Same simulator/environment, reward/cost config, seed policy, horizon, update trace, and frozen evaluation status | Training curves alone are diagnostic, not thesis-ready held-out policy evidence |
| A11 RL | Same transition/reward/session/episode context, held-out rollout split, frozen/update separation, seed policy | Mixed training and evaluation without trace invalidates |
| A12 stress | Same clean source records plus declared stress profile/schedule/intensity/seed and clean/stressed pair IDs | Unmatched stress schedules are diagnostic; post-hoc stress tuning invalidates |
| A13 embodiment | Same upstream readiness/policy records plus embodiment mode, command mapping, simulator config, demo manifest, safety-event proxy log | Missing command mapping or simulator config blocks embodiment-proxy claim |

---

### 10. Validation Requirements

| Validation gate | Required check | Failure consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Source validation gate | Layer 1/2/3/etc. source records pass schema and split validation before metrics are computed or displayed | Affected metrics and comparisons diagnostic-only or invalid if leakage exists |
| Metric dictionary gate | Every reported metric has `MetricDictionaryEntry` with formula/status/direction/fields/claim boundary | Metric cannot support thesis-facing claim; display only as diagnostic if shown |
| Matched comparison gate | Required key envelope is complete or non-applicability is justified | Improvement/sufficiency comparison blocked or downgraded |
| Split/leakage gate | No train/test overlap, test-tuned thresholds/calibration/policies, future reward/outcome leakage, or source mutation | Invalid; not merely diagnostic |
| Frozen/update gate | Frozen evaluation has disabled-update audit; update-enabled runs have `PolicyUpdateTrace` and separate reporting | Policy/simulation claims invalid or diagnostic-only |
| Stress clean-source gate | Stress produces derived stressed views/runs and does not overwrite clean source records | Stress comparison invalid if clean records are mutated |
| Embodiment mapping gate | Command mapping and simulator config are registered before evaluation | Embodiment outcome claims blocked if mapping/config missing |
| Negative-result visibility gate | Failed, skipped, non-improving, sufficient-baseline, or diagnostic-only results have `NegativeResultNote` where applicable | Overclaim risk; affected comparison weakened or diagnostic-only |
| Layer 10 lineage gate | Dashboard/card/export records cite source records, metric dictionary entries, configs, seeds, warnings, and export manifests | Dashboard output diagnostic-only and cannot support claims |
| Layer 0 claim gate | Claim-evidence row links metric, comparison, limitation, warning, and allowed wording | Claim blocked until reviewed |

---

### 11. Layer 10 Dashboard, Card, Export, and Reproducibility Obligations

Layer 10 must expose metric and matched-comparison information as read-only derived reporting from saved records. It may summarize, filter, visualize, card, export, warn, and package. It must not train models, tune thresholds, recalibrate, create pseudo-labels, alter policy behavior, change stress schedules, mutate records, hide negative results, or promote diagnostic-only outputs.

| Layer 10 output | Required content | Missingness warning |
|---|---|---|
| Metric dictionary view/export | Metric ID, family, formula/status, direction, source fields, aggregation unit, A-context, limitation, claim boundary | `metric_dictionary_missing_or_unconfirmed` |
| Matched-comparison table/export | Comparison ID, A-context pair, key status, missing keys, metric IDs, diagnostic flag, negative-result link | `matched_comparison_incomplete_or_unmatched` |
| Ablation comparison dashboard | A0–A13 filter state, local sub-ablation IDs where applicable, metric values, match status, warnings, claim boundary | `ablation_result_not_thesis_ready` |
| Metric cards | Source-record IDs, metric dictionary ID, config/seed, interpretation, limitation, negative-result note where applicable | `metric_card_source_lineage_incomplete` |
| Failure/negative-result cards | Failed/skipped/negative/sufficient-baseline result, affected comparison, limitation, follow-up diagnostic note | `negative_result_note_missing` if absent |
| Dashboard metric records | `DashboardMetricRecord` entries with source layers, source records, metric dictionary, matched comparison, diagnostic status, warnings, export references | `dashboard_metric_is_derived_only` must remain visible |
| Reproducibility package | Run registry, artifact manifest, configs, seeds, source records, metric dictionary, matched reports, cards/figures/tables, warnings, checksums where feasible | `reproducibility_manifest_incomplete` |
| Claim-evidence export | Claim-evidence matrix/manifest rows linking metrics, comparisons, limitations, negative results, and allowed/forbidden wording | `claim_evidence_link_missing` |

---

### 12. Layer 0 Claim-Safety Boundaries

| Claim class | Allowed wording examples | Required evidence | Forbidden wording |
|---|---|---|---|
| Public-data decoder reliability | “Under the declared public EEG protocol, this decoder baseline shows bounded reliability behavior.” | A0 source records, metric dictionary, matched keys, Layer 1 validation | “Clinically reliable BCI-FES decoder” |
| Calibration visibility | “Calibration improves or clarifies probability reliability under split-safe evaluation.” | A1 calibration records, split-safe calibration ID, metric dictionary | “Safe confidence for patient control” |
| Threshold/selective-prediction behavior | “Registered thresholding/uncertainty changes coverage-risk tradeoffs under declared operating points.” | A2/A3 records, threshold/uncertainty IDs, matched operating-point report | “Safe abstention for real deployment” |
| Ordinary-control sufficiency | “Longer windows, voting, averaging, or ensembles are sufficient/insufficient under matched delay and aggregation assumptions.” | A4 records, delay-burden fields, matched report | “Ensemble proves readiness safety” |
| IHARQ evidence verification | “Rule-based evidence verification reduces or exposes wrong-accept/burden tradeoffs under proxy readiness constraints.” | A5 records, decision lineage, reason codes, metric dictionary | “IHARQ is clinically safe” |
| Evidence-quality / RegimeRisk / policy behavior | “Estimator, temporal trust, or policy branch changes proxy readiness behavior under declared feature/cost/simulation limits.” | A6–A11 records, feature/cost/policy/update lineage | “Real adaptive controller is safe for patients” |
| Stress robustness | “Controlled stress testing reveals robustness boundaries and failure modes.” | A12 stress records, clean/stressed matched report | “Validated real-world physiological robustness” |
| Embodiment proxy | “Readiness gating affects simulated MyoSuite/OpenSim/static-replay command outcomes under declared proxy mappings.” | A13 embodiment records, command mapping, simulator config, safety-event proxy log | “Real rehabilitation efficacy” or “real muscle stimulation safety” |
| Dashboard/reproducibility | “Dashboard/card/export lineage makes evidence traceable and reproducible.” | Layer 10 records, manifests, source links | “Dashboard proves empirical result independently of source records” |

Layer 0 must block, downgrade, or mark invalid any metric/comparison that lacks source provenance, metric dictionary definition, matched-comparison status, negative-result visibility, limitation label, or allowed claim wording.

---

### 13. Negative-Result, Missingness, and Baseline-Sufficiency Handling

| Situation | Required handling | Claim consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Advanced method fails to outperform simpler baseline | Preserve result with `NegativeResultNote`; report simpler-baseline sufficiency where matched | Claim narrows to sufficiency, transparency, or boundary finding |
| A2 threshold is sufficient relative to A3/A5 | Do not hide result; analyze whether uncertainty/IHARQ adds burden, traceability, or failure visibility | Advanced contribution weakened but not invalid if honestly reported |
| A4 ordinary controls match IHARQ | Preserve matched-cost/coverage/delay result; report ordinary-control sufficiency | IHARQ claim narrows to reason codes, controllable evidence, or traceability if supported |
| Calibration worsens one metric while improving another | Report mixed result; avoid single scalar ranking unless metric priority predeclared | Claim becomes metric-specific or weakened |
| Policy learning underperforms frozen/simple baselines | Preserve simulation-only negative result; inspect reward/cost, leakage, class imbalance, update stability | Policy branch may be diagnostic-only or future-work-only |
| Stress causes all methods to fail | Report robustness boundary rather than architecture collapse | Controlled stress limitation; not proof of real-world failure |
| Embodiment simulator fails/skips/unsupported | Preserve adapter/simulator failure note and demo-manifest status | A13 may be diagnostic-only/future-work-only, not clinical evidence |
| Metric dictionary missing | Mark metric diagnostic-only or blocked from thesis use | Metric claim blocked |
| Matched keys missing | Mark comparison unmatched diagnostic unless missing key is justified not applicable | Comparative claim blocked |
| Negative-result note missing | Add warning; do not silently omit failure | Claim-safety risk; dashboard warning required |

---

### 14. Diagnostic-Only, Blocked, and Invalid Triggers

| Trigger | Status | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| Missing `MetricDictionaryEntry` for thesis-facing metric | `diagnostic_only` or `blocked_for_claim` | A0–A13 |
| Missing required source-record lineage | `diagnostic_only`; `invalid` if lineage cannot be recovered and claim is made | A0–A13 |
| Missing or inconsistent `matched_comparison_id` for comparative claim | `unmatched_diagnostic` | A0–A13 |
| Split leakage, train/test contamination, or test-tuned threshold/calibration/policy | `invalid` | A0–A13 |
| Hidden policy/model/threshold updates in frozen evaluation | `invalid` | A6–A13 where policies/adaptation are active |
| Missing `PolicyUpdateTrace` for update-enabled bandit/RL policy | `diagnostic_only` or `blocked` | A10–A11, downstream A12/A13 contexts |
| Missing disabled-update audit for frozen policy evaluation | `invalid_for_frozen_claim` | A8–A13 where policies are used |
| Missing clean/stressed pair identity | `diagnostic_only` | A12 |
| Post-hoc stress profile/intensity selection using final outcomes | `invalid` | A12 |
| Missing embodiment command mapping or simulator config | `blocked_for_embodiment_claim` | A13 |
| Dashboard metric without source-record and metric-dictionary lineage | `dashboard_diagnostic_only` | Layer 10 outputs |
| Claim-evidence row missing limitation/claim boundary | `claim_blocked` | Phase 15/final thesis use |
| Forbidden clinical/device/deployment/patient-safety wording | `forbidden` / `invalid` | All claim-facing outputs |

**Target protocol version:** `v0.1`

### 0. Document-Control and Revision Note for This Second Pass

This second-pass revision keeps the previous cumulative protocol body intact and appends a corrected governance addendum. The main correction made in this pass is that governance completeness indicators are no longer treated as confirmed metric families. They are status, warning, coverage, and lineage checks unless a future `MetricDictionaryEntry` explicitly defines a quantified formula, denominator, units, directionality, and aggregation rule. This prevents a subtle metric-definition hallucination risk and better matches the registry and framework requirement that exact metric dictionaries remain deferred at protocol v0.1 unless source-fixed.

### 4. Scientific Purpose and Core Question

This governance addendum answers one cross-protocol question:

> When a result, ablation comparison, dashboard view, card, export, figure, table, or thesis claim is incomplete, unmatched, untraceable, unsupported, candidate-only, simulation-only, stress-only, embodiment-proxy-only, or otherwise claim-limited, how must the protocol downgrade it, expose it through Layer 10, and bound it through Layer 0?

The addendum prevents three protocol failures:

1. treating Layer 10 dashboards, cards, or exports as hidden primary empirical evidence;
2. treating incomplete, leaked, unregistered, unmatched, or metric-undefined outputs as thesis-ready evidence;
3. converting public EEG proxy evidence, simulated closed-loop results, controlled stress tests, or MyoSuite/OpenSim/static-replay embodiment demos into clinical, patient-safety, medical-device, real-time deployment, real muscle-stimulation, or therapeutic-efficacy claims.

| Layer 0 — Claim-Safety and Scope Governance | Owns claim status classification, limitation inheritance, diagnostic-only downgrade logic, invalid/forbidden claim blocking, and final claim-safety review | Does not produce empirical performance evidence and does not mutate source records |
| Layer 1 — Public-Data and Protocol Anchor | Supplies dataset, protocol, split, validation, and public-data limitation lineage | No downstream output may silently rewrite Layer 1 source records or hide split/leakage warnings |
| Layer 2 — Decoder and Baseline Measurement Spine | Supplies A0/A4 source predictions, model registry entries, baseline metrics, ordinary ensemble-control evidence, and readiness/failure artifacts | Baseline evidence remains public-data/offline proxy evidence, not clinical readiness evidence |

| Layer 4 — IHARQ Evidence Verification | Supplies IHARQ decision/evidence verification records and reason-coded action outcomes | IHARQ evidence verification is not real BCI-FES safety or therapeutic validation |
| Layer 5 — RegimeRisk Temporal Trust Monitoring | Supplies temporal trust, regime, drift-risk, and fatigue-like proxy records where implemented | Fatigue-like or drift-risk evidence remains proxy/stress/temporal evidence, not clinical fatigue diagnosis |
| Layer 6 — Adaptive Readiness Policy Layer | Supplies deferral, supervised policy, evidence-quality, and readiness-policy outputs where implemented | Policy training/adaptation must remain separated from frozen evaluation and cannot be deployment-safety evidence |
| Layer 7 — Simulated Closed-Loop Readiness Environment | Supplies simulated sessions, transition, reward, safety-event, and environment diagnostic records | Simulation-only results cannot become real-world closed-loop or real-patient claims |
| Layer 8 — StressForge-Lite Stress Generator | Supplies bounded stress profiles, schedules, clean/stressed pairings, and stress robustness evidence | Stress evidence remains controlled stress robustness, not real physiological stress validation |
| Layer 9 — MyoSuite/OpenSim Embodiment Demo | Supplies embodiment state/outcome, adapter, mapping, safety-event, screenshot/video/reference, and demo-manifest evidence where implemented | Embodiment outputs remain simulated embodiment/proxy consequence, not real-world embodied control or rehabilitation efficacy |
| Layer 10 — Dashboard, Cards, and Reproducibility Layer | Reads saved records; validates completeness; summarizes; visualizes; generates cards; exports figures/tables; packages reproducibility; surfaces warnings and claim traceability | Must not train, tune, create pseudo-labels, update policies, mutate stress schedules, repair records, or silently recompute hidden empirical evidence |

Phase 0 does not produce real A0--A13 empirical evidence |

### 9. Baselines, Comparators, and Matched-Comparison Consequences

This governance component does not add a new baseline. It defines when existing baselines/comparators may be interpreted as thesis-ready, weakened, diagnostic-only, blocked, or invalid.

| Comparison condition | Required governance decision | Layer 10 obligation | Layer 0 claim consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| A0--A4 baseline/comparator is matched, metric-defined, source-linked, split-safe, and exported with limitations | May be thesis-ready if all other gates pass | Show source lineage, matched report, metric dictionary, uncertainty/limitation tags, and export manifest | Allow bounded public-data/proxy evidence claim |
| Advanced component does not beat A0--A4 under matched keys | Preserve as negative or baseline-sufficiency result | Show `NegativeResultNote`, baseline-sufficiency card/warning, and affected figures/tables | Claim must state that simpler baseline was sufficient or advanced component was not supported |
| Comparison lacks matched keys, source IDs, config hash, seed, metric dictionary entry, or split safety | Diagnostic-only or blocked | Show missingness warning and prevent thesis-ready export labeling | Comparative claim blocked or diagnostic-only |
| Comparison uses post-hoc thresholds, leaked calibration, contaminated test data, or hidden dashboard recomputation | Invalid unless rerun with valid lineage | Show invalid/leakage warning and exclude from thesis-ready cards/exports | Claim forbidden until repaired through new valid evidence |
| Simulation/stress/embodiment evidence is compared to public-data baselines without declared mode separation | Diagnostic-only or invalid depending on severity | Separate pages/filters for public-data, simulation, stress, and embodiment-proxy modes | Claim must not imply real-world embodied or clinical validation |

### 10. Matched-Comparison Key Requirements

All claim-facing comparisons must preserve the strictest matched-key envelope already defined in the cumulative protocol. At protocol-wide level, the minimum required key families are:

| Key family | Required because | Missingness consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Dataset/protocol/split/label-budget lineage | Prevents cross-protocol or cross-split comparisons | Comparative claim diagnostic-only or invalid |
| Subject/session/run/trial/window or aggregation-level identity | Prevents unpaired or incompatible rows | Comparison weakened, diagnostic-only, or blocked |
| Model/decoder/score/class-order lineage | Prevents hidden score/schema mismatches | Metric or comparison invalid until reconciled |
| Calibration/threshold/operating-point lineage | Required for A1--A3 and threshold/selective comparisons | Threshold/selective claim blocked |
| Evidence/action/reason-code/fallback/unsafe lineage | Required for A5--A7 and IHARQ-related comparisons | IHARQ claim diagnostic-only |
| Policy/training/update/reward/cost/frozen-evaluation lineage | Required for A8--A11 | Policy claim diagnostic-only or invalid if update/evaluation curves are mixed |
| Stress profile/schedule/clean-pairing lineage | Required for A12 | Stress robustness claim diagnostic-only or blocked |
| Embodiment mode/adapter/mapping/simulator/static-replay/demo-manifest lineage | Required for A13 | Embodiment-proxy claim diagnostic-only or blocked |
| Dashboard/export/card/figure/table/claim-evidence lineage | Required for all thesis-facing outputs | Layer 10 export and Layer 0 claim cannot be thesis-ready |

### 11. Metric Families and Metric-Dictionary Status

This governance addendum does not create new final quantitative metric families. It enforces metric-governance conditions over the metric families already defined elsewhere in the cumulative protocol.

| Item | Status | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| Existing task/performance/calibration/selective/policy/stress/embodiment metrics | Source-supported where already defined in prior sections and higher-authority docs | Must have `MetricDictionaryEntry` support before thesis-facing use |
| Governance completeness indicators such as diagnostic-label coverage, dashboard-lineage completeness, negative-result visibility, claim-evidence linkage, and export-package completeness | `status_or_coverage_check`, not a confirmed metric family at v0.1 | May be displayed as pass/warning/fail or completeness status; if quantified, each requires a future metric dictionary entry with formula, denominator, units, directionality, and aggregation |
| Dashboard display values | Derived/read-only display artifacts | Must reference source/evaluation metric records and metric dictionary IDs; Layer 10 must not invent hidden metric definitions |
| Final statistical tests, confidence intervals, exact aggregation rules | `requires_confirmation: true` unless already source-fixed | Cannot be represented as final v1.0 run-matrix decisions in this v0.1 addendum |
| Forbidden clinical/deployment/therapeutic metrics | Blocked | Must not be introduced or implied by dashboard, table, figure, or thesis wording |

### 12. Split, Leakage, Threshold, Policy, Simulation, Stress, Embodiment, and Dashboard Constraints

| Constraint class | Protocol-wide rule | Downgrade if violated |
|---|---|---|
| Split and leakage | Train/calibration/threshold/validation/test roles must be preserved; no hidden test-set tuning or duplicate contamination | `invalid` for leaked results; `diagnostic_only` if incomplete but not leaked |
| Threshold and calibration | Thresholds and operating points must be registered and validation-split grounded | Threshold/selective claims blocked or diagnostic-only |
| Metric dictionary | Every claim-facing metric must have a dictionary entry or explicit unresolved status | Metric value diagnostic-only; comparative claim blocked |
| Matched comparison | Comparisons must preserve required matched keys and exclusions | Comparison diagnostic-only or invalid |
| Policy learning | Training/adaptation curves must be separated from frozen-policy evaluation; update traces and reward/cost configs must be visible | Policy result diagnostic-only or invalid |
| Simulation | Simulation-only results must remain labeled as simulation-only | Real-world, clinical, or deployment claim invalid |
| Stress | Stress profiles/schedules and clean/stressed pairings must be linked | Stress claim diagnostic-only or blocked |
| Embodiment | Simulator/static-replay mode, adapter/mapping, demo manifest, safety-event/outcome lineage, and proxy limitation must be visible | Embodiment claim diagnostic-only or blocked |
| Dashboard/export | Layer 10 may read/export/render/package but may not silently recompute, repair, tune, train, mutate, or approve claims | Dashboard output diagnostic-only, blocked, or invalid |

### 13. Local Sub-Ablation Policy

`not_applicable`. This section is protocol-wide governance, not an A0--A13 ablation section. It does not introduce A14 or any other top-level ID. If later protocol work introduces local diagnostic subchecks, they must be labeled as local governance checks rather than global ablation IDs, and any quantified form must remain `requires_confirmation: true` until the metric dictionary resolves it.

### 14. Diagnostic-Only Downgrade Rules

#### 14.1 Status vocabulary

| Status | Meaning | Claim effect |
|---|---|---|
| `thesis_ready` | Fully source-linked, schema-valid, metric-defined, matched where compared, split-safe, exported through Layer 10, and approved within Layer 0 boundaries | May support bounded thesis claim |
| `weakened` | Some evidence exists, but scope, precision, matchability, or completeness limits claim strength | Only cautious bounded claim allowed |
| `diagnostic_only` | Useful for debugging, exploratory interpretation, sanity checking, failure analysis, or future repair, but not confirmatory thesis evidence | No confirmatory claim; may appear as diagnostic appendix/card if labeled |
| `optional_only` | Optional/stretch branch not required for core validity | Optional branch claim only; no core dependency |
| `future_work_only` | Conceptual or planned item not implemented/evaluable in current evidence package | Future-work discussion only |
| `blocked` | Required source, schema, validation, metric, match, export, or claim-evidence element missing | No claim until repaired |
| `invalid` | Leakage, hidden mutation/recomputation, forbidden evidence use, unsupported source mutation, or prohibited claim wording | Exclude from thesis-ready evidence; repair requires valid rerun or rewritten claim |

#### 14.2 Specific diagnostic-only or blocked triggers

| Trigger | Minimum downgrade | Required record/warning | Repair or continuation rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| Required source record missing, orphaned, or schema-invalid | `blocked` or `diagnostic_only` | `DiagnosticOnlyFlag`; dashboard missingness warning | Add/repair source record through owning phase; dashboard cannot patch it |
| Source lineage lacks record IDs, schema version, split ID, config hash, seed where required, or validation state | `diagnostic_only` | `DiagnosticOnlyFlag`; export warning | Restore lineage or remove thesis-ready claim |
| Metric lacks `MetricDictionaryEntry` or has undefined denominator/directionality/units | `diagnostic_only` | Metric dictionary warning | Define metric dictionary entry before claim-facing use |
| Matched-comparison keys are missing, incompatible, or unmatched | `diagnostic_only`; `invalid` if misleading comparison is presented as fair | `MatchedComparisonReport` warning | Rebuild comparison under matched keys or label as unmatched diagnostic |
| Split leakage, test-set threshold tuning, calibration leakage, duplicate contamination, or hidden post-hoc operating-point selection | `invalid` | Leakage/invalid warning and claim block | Rerun under valid split lineage |
| Threshold/selective prediction claim lacks `ThresholdRegistryRecord` or operating-point validation | `blocked` or `diagnostic_only` | Threshold/operating-point warning | Register threshold and validation lineage |
| Failure, non-improvement, collapse, or baseline sufficiency lacks `NegativeResultNote` | `weakened` or `blocked` for final claim | Negative-result missingness warning | Add negative-result note and interpretation |
| Dashboard/card/export lacks source lineage, metric dictionary IDs, matched report links, diagnostic state, limitation tags, or export manifest | `diagnostic_only` for presentation artifact | Layer 10 warning | Re-export from saved records with complete manifest |
| Dashboard performs hidden recomputation, record repair, threshold tuning, policy mutation, stress mutation, or simulator mutation | `invalid` | Invalid dashboard-evidence warning | Recompute only through proper upstream phase with new run/config/record IDs |
| Claim lacks claim-evidence linkage or inherits unresolved `ClaimEvidenceMatrix`/`ClaimEvidenceManifest` alias/schema gap | `blocked` or `weakened` | Claim-evidence warning | Finalize claim-evidence row/schema or bound claim as unresolved |
| Candidate/unresolved registry item is silently promoted to official | `invalid` for affected claim | Registry-status warning | Restore original candidate/unresolved status |
| Strictest inherited limitation tag is removed or weakened | `invalid` for affected claim | Limitation-inheritance warning | Restore strictest limitation tag |
| Clinical, real-patient, medical-device, real-world deployment, real muscle-control, clinical fatigue-diagnosis, real physiological stress, or therapeutic-efficacy wording appears | `invalid` | `InvalidClaimFlag` where implemented; manual Layer 0 block otherwise | Rewrite as public-data/proxy/simulation/stress/embodiment-only claim or remove |
| Policy update/adaptation curves are mixed with frozen evaluation | `invalid` or `diagnostic_only` depending on claim | Policy update/frozen separation warning | Separate update trace from frozen evaluation exports |
| Stress result lacks stress schedule/profile or clean/stressed pairing | `diagnostic_only` | Stress lineage warning | Add stress-profile/schedule and pairing lineage |
| Embodiment result lacks simulator/static-replay mode, adapter mapping, demo manifest, or proxy limitation | `diagnostic_only` | Embodiment lineage/non-clinical warning | Add manifest/mapping/mode/limitation or move to future work |
| Exact v1.0 run-matrix value is asserted without source support | `weakened` or `blocked` | v0.1/v1.0 boundary warning | Mark as `requires_confirmation: true` |

### 15. Layer 10 Dashboard, Card, Export, and Reproducibility Obligations

Layer 10 is an observability, dashboard, card, export, warning, and reproducibility layer. It is not an empirical producer for upstream records and not a claim-approval authority.

| Layer 10 obligation | Required output or behavior | Missingness warning |
|---|---|---|
| Read saved records only | Every view/export must reference source records, evaluation records, config hashes, schema versions, and metric dictionary IDs where applicable | `source_lineage_missing` |
| Preserve source-vs-derived boundary | `DashboardMetricRecord` and `DashboardViewRecord` must be derived/reporting artifacts, not hidden primary evidence | `dashboard_source_boundary_violation` |
| Surface matched-comparison state | Views/tables/cards must show matched, unmatched, partial, invalid, or diagnostic-only comparison status | `matched_comparison_state_missing` |
| Surface metric dictionary state | Every displayed metric used in a claim must link to a dictionary entry or unresolved status | `metric_dictionary_link_missing` |
| Surface diagnostic-only flags | `DiagnosticOnlyFlag` status must be visible in dashboards/cards/exports | `diagnostic_only_status_missing` |
| Surface negative results | Negative-result notes, baseline-sufficiency notes, failures, and collapse cases must be visible | `negative_result_visibility_missing` |
| Surface Layer 0 limitation tags | Public-data, proxy, simulation-only, stress-only, embodiment-proxy, optional-only, future-work-only, and forbidden-claim warnings must remain visible | `limitation_tag_missing` |
| Produce cards where source-supported | Dataset/protocol cards are read-only source-layer cards; Layer 10 cards summarize source-linked evidence without claim inflation | `card_lineage_incomplete` |
| Export static figures/tables/screenshots | Every exported figure/table must have source record, metric, matched-comparison, claim-evidence, limitation, and checksum lineage | `export_manifest_incomplete` |
| Build reproducibility package | `ReproducibilityManifest` must include configs, seeds, environment/tool versions, scripts/commands where finalized, records, artifacts, checksums, and warnings | `reproducibility_manifest_incomplete` |
| Keep policy update/frozen evaluation separated | Policy views must expose update/adaptation versus frozen-evaluation filters | `policy_update_filter_missing` |
| Keep stress and embodiment limitations visible | Stress/embodiment pages must show stress schedule, clean/stressed pairing, simulator/static-replay mode, mapping, and non-clinical/proxy limitation | `stress_or_embodiment_limitation_missing` |

Layer 10 must not perform these actions: train models, calibrate/tune thresholds, create pseudo-labels, update policies, alter reward definitions, mutate stress profiles, run or mutate simulator state as hidden evidence, repair upstream records, overwrite source records, approve claims, hide diagnostic-only flags, or promote diagnostic-only outputs to thesis-ready claims.

### 16. Layer 0 Claim-Safety Boundaries

Layer 0 governs claim wording, limitation inheritance, diagnostic-only downgrades, forbidden-claim blocking, and final claim-evidence traceability. It does not create empirical performance evidence.

#### 16.1 Allowed claim classes

| Allowed bounded claim class | Required wording boundary |
|---|---|
| Public-data reliability behavior | Must state public EEG/offline/proxy-data scope and dataset/split limitations |
| Decoder, calibration, uncertainty, and threshold comparison | Must state metric dictionary, matched-comparison, and split-safe status |
| IHARQ evidence verification | Must state proxy-readiness/evidence-verification scope, not medical safety |
| RegimeRisk or fatigue-like temporal trust behavior | Must state temporal/stress/proxy wording, not clinical fatigue diagnosis |
| Adaptive readiness / deferral / policy evidence | Must state simulation/offline/frozen-evaluation scope where applicable |
| Bandit/RL policy evidence | Must state simulation-only policy-learning scope and frozen-evaluation separation |
| StressForge robustness | Must state controlled stress robustness, stress schedule, and clean/stressed pairing |
| MyoSuite/OpenSim/static-replay embodiment demo | Must state simulated/proxy embodiment consequence and non-clinical/non-rehabilitation scope |
| Layer 10 dashboard/export/reproducibility | Must state read-only traceability, inspection, export, and reproducibility-package scope |
| C0--C4 capability-tier statement | Must state highest completed evidence tier and associated limitations |

#### 16.2 Forbidden claim classes

The following claim classes are blocked unless future source documents explicitly redefine the project scope; under this v0.1 protocol they are forbidden:

| Forbidden class | Required action |
|---|---|
| Clinical BCI-FES validation | Remove or rewrite as public-data/proxy evidence |
| Real patient safety | Remove or rewrite as simulation/proxy safety-event evidence where supported |
| Medical-device readiness | Remove |
| Real rehabilitation efficacy or therapeutic effectiveness | Remove |
| Real-time deployment safety | Remove or rewrite as simulated/offline/replay readiness where supported |
| Real muscle stimulation control | Remove or rewrite as simulated/proxy embodiment mapping where supported |
| Real-world embodied control validation | Remove or rewrite as MyoSuite/OpenSim/static-replay/proxy demo where supported |
| Clinical fatigue diagnosis | Remove or rewrite as fatigue-like proxy/stress/temporal degradation where supported |
| Real physiological stress validation | Remove or rewrite as controlled synthetic/stress-profile robustness where supported |
| Implanted control readiness or real patient outcome improvement | Remove |

#### 16.3 Limitation-inheritance rule

Every claim must inherit the strictest limitation tag attached to any cited source record, metric, matched comparison, negative-result note, dashboard/card/export, stress profile, embodiment artifact, or claim-evidence row. A claim becomes invalid if it drops or weakens the strictest inherited boundary.

Required limitation labels include, where applicable: `public_data_only`, `proxy_readiness_only`, `proxy_label_based`, `offline_or_pseudo_online`, `split_safe_offline_evaluation_only`, `simulation_only`, `controlled_stress_only`, `stress_conditioned`, `embodiment_proxy_only`, `MyoSuite_OpenSim_demo_only`, `dashboard_derived_read_only`, `diagnostic_only`, `optional_only`, `future_work_only`, `not_clinical_validation`, `not_real_patient_safety`, `not_medical_device_readiness`, `not_real_rehabilitation_efficacy`, `not_real_muscle_stimulation_control`, and `not_deployment_readiness`.

### 17. Negative-Result and Baseline-Sufficiency Interpretation

Negative results are required scientific evidence, not failures to hide.

| Scenario | Required interpretation | Layer 10 handling | Layer 0 claim boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| A0 or a simpler A0--A4 baseline is sufficient | Simpler baseline sufficiency is a valid finding | Show baseline-sufficiency note and matched comparison | Claim must state that advanced method was not needed under tested conditions |
| Advanced IHARQ/policy/stress/embodiment component fails to improve | Component-specific hypothesis is weakened or not supported | Show `NegativeResultNote`, failure/collapse card, and limitations | Claim cannot assert superiority; may discuss diagnostic insight |
| Policy learning is unstable | Simulation-only policy-learning evidence identifies instability | Separate update/adaptation and frozen-evaluation exports | No deployment or safety claim; possible future-work discussion |
| Stress robustness collapses | Controlled stress robustness is limited under declared stress profile | Show stress schedule and clean/stressed pairing | No real physiological stress or safety claim |
| Embodiment demo fails or is incomplete | Proxy embodiment consequence is unsupported/incomplete | Show simulator/static-replay/mapping/demo-manifest missingness | No real-world embodiment or rehabilitation claim |
| Dashboard/export package is incomplete | Traceability/reproducibility claim is weakened; upstream evidence is not automatically invalid unless lineage itself fails | Show missingness and export/reproducibility warnings | Claim must not rely on missing figure/card/export as evidence |

### 18. Layer 10 and Layer 0 Handoff Rules

| Handoff | Required content | Failure consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Evaluation to Layer 10 | Source records, metrics, matched reports, diagnostic flags, negative notes, limitations, configs, seeds, schema versions, source paths | Dashboard output diagnostic-only or blocked |
| Layer 10 to Phase 15 | Figures, tables, cards, dashboard views, export manifests, metric dictionary exports, negative-result index, claim-evidence views, reproducibility package | Thesis claim weakened or blocked |
| Evaluation/Layer 10 to Layer 0 | Claim IDs, evidence artifacts, limitations, metric/match state, diagnostic-only state, negative-result state, warning inheritance | Claim cannot become thesis-ready |
| Layer 0 to thesis/final protocol | Allowed wording, forbidden wording, downgrade label, limitation statement, unresolved issue notes | Claim must be rewritten, downgraded, blocked, or removed |

### 19. Open Issues and Requires-Confirmation Items

| Issue | Type | Current status | Handling in this protocol |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ClaimEvidenceMatrix` vs `ClaimEvidenceManifest` | Alias/schema/ownership ambiguity | Unresolved / requires confirmation | Use both names where needed; do not silently merge or treat either as fully resolved |
| `ClaimLedger`, `InvalidClaimFlag`, `ScopeLabel`, `LimitationStatement` exact schemas/paths | Layer 0 schema gap | Normalized candidate / requires confirmation | Preserve candidate status; manual Layer 0 review remains required if schema is absent |
| `DashboardMetricRecord` source-vs-derived boundary | Dashboard ownership / source-output reconciliation risk | Unresolved boundary risk | Treat Layer 10 dashboard records as derived/read-only; source metrics remain owned by their producer/evaluation layer |
| `FigureTableManifest` and export manifest exact schemas/paths | Schema/path gap | Requires confirmation | Require lineage and checksums at v0.1; defer exact filenames/paths to v1.0 |
| Metric dictionary exact formula catalog | Metric-definition gap | Requires confirmation | No new quantitative governance metrics introduced here; any quantified governance check needs future dictionary entry |
| Matched-comparison report storage/schema | Schema/storage gap | Requires confirmation | Matching discipline required now; exact storage path deferred |
| `TrialRecord` standalone status | Registry ambiguity | Inferred candidate / unresolved | Use `WindowRecord` trial fields unless final registry confirms standalone record |
| Exact dashboard route IDs and final page names | Dashboard route gap | Requires confirmation | Define obligations, not final route names |
| Exact final seeds, run counts, statistical tests, tables, figures, commands, hyperparameter grids, stress intensities, MyoSuite/OpenSim configuration | v1.0 run-matrix gap | Requires confirmation | Defer exact run matrix while preserving required evidence/claim controls |

### 20. v0.1 versus v1.0 Boundary

Protocol v0.1 defines governance rules, records/artifacts required for traceability, downgrade logic, Layer 10 obligations, Layer 0 claim boundaries, negative-result interpretation, matched-comparison requirements, and open issues.

Protocol v0.1 does not finalize exact v1.0 choices unless already fixed by supplied sources. The following remain `requires_confirmation: true`: exact dataset list, exact final seeds, exact number of runs, exact final statistical test, exact table/figure numbering, exact command-line execution, exact dashboard routes, exact metric dictionary enumeration, exact hyperparameter grids, exact stress intensities, exact MyoSuite/OpenSim configuration, exact final export filenames, and exact claim-evidence schema/path.

| New canonical record | Not introduced; only source-supported/candidate names are referenced with status |
| New confirmed metric family | Not introduced |
| v0.1/v1.0 boundary | v0.1 rule contract completed; exact v1.0 run matrix, formulas, routes, commands, paths, and final thesis table/figure numbering remain deferred |

### 1. Target Identity and Purpose

This addendum defines the final protocol-wide interpretation and assembly rules needed after the A0--A13 sections and the earlier governance sections. It answers three final questions:

1. how negative, null, missing, failed, weaker-than-baseline, or baseline-sufficient results must be interpreted;
2. how local sub-ablations may be named, recorded, compared, and claimed without becoming new global ablation IDs;
3. whether the cumulative Protocol `v0.1` body is assembled consistently enough for later v1.0 run-matrix and thesis-integration work.

| Field | Protocol-wide value |
|---|---|
| Target type | Protocol-wide rule component and final assembly audit |
| Selected components | Negative-result interpretation rules; sub-ablation policy; full protocol assembly / final audit |
| Affected global ablations | A0--A13 as evaluation-use metadata only |
| Affected layers | Layers 0--10, with Layer 0 and Layer 10 having direct governance duties |
| Affected phases | Phase 0--15 as evidence-production and integration sequence |
| Primary evidence owners | The producing layer/phase for each source record; never the ablation ID itself |
| Layer 10 role | Read-only dashboard, card, export, warning, reproducibility, and lineage packaging |
| Layer 0 role | Claim-safety, limitation inheritance, forbidden-claim blocking, diagnostic-only downgrade, and final claim wording governance |
| Completion status | `v0_1_protocol_rule_contract_complete_with_open_issues` |
